review_content: If you are looking for a pump that is quiet and you could pump without people noticing, this isn't it. review_summary: 吸力好、佩戴方便，但噪音大、不隐蔽，外形会显得胸部夸张；想要安静不引人注意的吸奶器则不合适，若需要不固定在墙上且能完成吸奶的款式可能合适。操作不太直观，但熟悉并调好设置后效果很好。

review_content: You do not need the expensive brand! This is great and works just as well. Easy to clean. Has many different levels and settings. review_content_ch:
绝对物超所值！
你不需要买那些昂贵的品牌！这款产品很棒，效果一样好。易于清洁。具有多种不同的档位和设置。我强烈建议你单独购买更适合你的法兰，而不是使用随附的法兰。这样效果会好得多，而且不会引起任何疼痛。我还建议你在电池充满电后、使用前先学习如何将其取下。你最不希望看到的情况就是，在取下电池时不小心打开了容器，导致乳汁全部流失。
review_summary: 用户认为非常值得购买，无需买昂贵品牌，效果一样好；易清洗，档位和设置多。建议另购更合身的法兰以避免疼痛并提升效果，并提前学会满电时拆卸电池，否则拆电池时打开容器可能损失全部母乳。

review_content: Portable, long battery life, works well. 4 stars because i did notice that it is less efficient as it used to be. Might need to change pump parts? my medela that i use everyday still works fine. I have been using it longer and haven’t replaced its parts
review_content_ch:
喜欢它的便利性

review_content: I purchased this in hopes to use for overnight pumps, when I'm away from home and busy, and when I return to work. I used this for less than a month and the motor went bad. Thankfully I purchased the additional coverage for if something happened. I filed my claim but because it was still under the manufacturer warranty I had to go through momcozy. I Had sent an email with the requested photos and videos. It took them 3 days to respond to that email with links to the same troubleshooting I had already done. I sent them more images an requested they replace the pump promptly, again another 2 and a half days go by before I get a response. When I see the response they offer to replace it with lesser value pumps (not even offering to replace with the one I have) or a refund. Due to delays I had to spend more money and buy a completely different pump because I couldn't go without a wearable pump over the busy weekend. Do Not purchase this product you will eventually be disappointed. Sadly I absolutely loved this pump in the beginning. Spend the money and get a nice quality wearable pump....this is not it.

我购买这款吸奶器是希望用于夜间吸奶、外出忙碌时以及重返职场时使用。我用了不到一个月，电机就坏了。幸好我购买了额外的延保服务。我提交了理赔申请，但由于产品仍在制造商保修期内，我必须通过 Momcozy 处理。我按照要求发送了包含照片和视频的电子邮件。他们花了3天时间才回复，提供的链接却是我已经做过的故障排除步骤。我再次发送了更多图片，并要求他们尽快更换吸奶器，结果又过了两天半才收到回复。在回复中，他们提出用价值较低的吸奶器进行更换（甚至不提供与我手中同款的替换），或者退款。由于延误，我不得不花更多的钱购买了一款完全不同的吸奶器，因为在繁忙的周末我不能没有可穿戴式吸奶器。不要购买这款产品，你最终会失望的。遗憾的是，我起初非常喜欢这款吸奶器。还是花钱买一款质量好的可穿戴式吸奶器吧……这款不是。

review_content: These changed the pumping game for me. I was tired of feeling like I was leashed to the pump that plugs into the wall and it was taking a toll on my mental health. With these I can move around and get things done. The suction is super strong so it can be uncomfortable until you get used to it. It comes with different inserts which is nice. The battery lasts about three 30 minute pumps the month I’ve had it, and the charging cords that came with it already had to be replaced but I had some on hand already. Parts are easy to wash but there are 8 total parts between the two that have to be washed. It is quite loud and they stick out a bunch so if you’re looking for something discrete, this probably isn’t it. But if you’re just looking for something to use at home it works great. I also use it in the car when picking up grocery orders. It’s not too loud where it wakes my baby up and sometimes I think the noise helps her fall asleep. I’m able to hold my baby while they’re on but only upright, not cradled in my arms because they do get in the way. It’s also hard so that wouldn’t be comfortable for baby. I don’t know if this is common knowledge but you can’t bend over too far or it will leak out the top. Also when dumping sometimes one of the back removable pieces falls off and can spill milk. Nothing worse than pumping for an hour and having some spill especially when you’re struggling to produce. Overall it’s a great product. To be fair it’s the only portable pump I’ve tried but I use this one way more than my spectra pump!
review_content_ch:
效果很好
这款吸奶器改变了我的吸奶体验。我厌倦了被拴在需要插电的吸奶器上的感觉，这对我的心理健康造成了影响。有了它，我可以四处走动，把事情做完。吸力非常强，所以一开始可能不适应，直到习惯为止。它配有不同尺寸的插入件，这点不错。在我使用的一个月里，电池大约能支撑三次30分钟的吸奶，但附带的充电线已经需要更换了，不过我自己手头有备用的。零件容易清洗，但两个吸奶器总共有8个零件需要清洗。它声音挺大，而且突出很多，所以如果你想要隐蔽性好的，可能不太合适。但如果你只是在家使用，它效果很好。我还会在开车去取杂货订单时使用它。它声音不会大到吵醒我的宝宝，有时我觉得噪音反而有助于她入睡。我可以抱着宝宝时使用它们，但只能直立抱，不能抱在怀里，因为它们会碍事。而且它们很硬，宝宝会不舒服。我不知道这是不是常识，但你不能弯腰太深，否则会从顶部漏出来。另外，倒出时，有时后面的某个可拆卸部件会掉下来，导致奶洒出来。没有什么比吸了一个小时奶却洒了一些更糟糕的了，尤其是当你产奶困难时。总的来说，这是个很棒的产品。公平地说，这是我尝试过的唯一一款便携式吸奶器，但我使用它的频率远高于我的Spectra吸奶器！
review_summary: 产品解放了用户行动自由，吸力强劲但初期不适，配有多种尺寸配件。电池续航约3次30分钟使用，原装充电线一个月内损坏。清洗涉及8个部件，工作时噪音明显且体积突出。使用时不能过度弯腰否则会漏奶，倒奶时后盖可能脱落导致洒奶。虽然体积大但能边抱娃边使用（仅限竖抱），噪音不会吵醒婴儿反而可能有助眠效果。用户认为这是款优秀产品，使用频率远超其他品牌。

review_content: Love that the app allows for tracking milk production and control so you don’t have to reach for the manual controls on the pumps like other models. The app also provide status of your pumping session including time remaining. The flange design makes it very comfortable and relieves pressure during pumping sessions. A travel case is included and holds all components of the pump and accessories including the charging cables. The default flange size is 24 mm but 21, 19 and 17 mm sizes are also included. An extra pair of duck bill valve is included. You will need a milk storage container after pumping.
review_content_ch:
吸奶器的进阶功能
令人满意的是，应用程序可以追踪产奶量并进行控制，这样你就不需要像其他型号那样伸手去操作吸奶器上的手动控制。该应用还会显示吸奶过程的状态，包括剩余时间。法兰设计让吸奶过程非常舒适，并缓解了吸奶时的压力。附赠一个旅行收纳包，可以容纳吸奶器及其所有配件，包括充电线。默认的法兰尺寸是24毫米，但也附带了21、19和17毫米的尺寸。还额外附赠了一对鸭嘴阀。吸奶后你需要一个储奶容器。
review_summary: 优点：App可追踪产奶量并远程控制，无需手动操作；法兰设计舒适，缓解压力；附赠多种尺寸法兰（21/19/17mm）、额外鸭嘴阀和旅行包。缺点：需自备储奶容器。

review_content_ch:
绝对解放双手
我喜欢我可以随意移动，不用插在墙上，组装非常简单，使用也非常方便。但它无法将我排空。我用它进行了一次夜间吸奶，平时我能吸出5-6盎司，但用这款只吸出了将近3盎司。之后我不得不再用我的Pump In Style吸奶器继续吸，又吸出了2盎司。我不喜欢还得再用另一台吸奶器来完成工作。我会像使用Medela吸奶器那样在吸奶过程中切换模式，而且我把Momcozy吸奶器调到了最高档位。很遗憾，它们的效果不如我所愿，我本想奖励一下自己，因为我在喂养/吸奶方面一直做得很好。
2024年12月7日更新：这些吸奶器完全无法将我排空，我只能吸出极少甚至几乎吸不出奶，只有几毫升。我折腾了30分钟，毫无收获，现在我在哺乳后用Pump In Style吸奶器吸出了将近3盎司。我联系了客服，他们提供了一些建议让产品正常工作，但到目前为止没有任何方法奏效。我再次给他们发了消息，正在等待回复。
review_summary: 用户称该吸奶器免手扶、可自由移动，组装和使用简单；但排空效果差：夜间通常可吸5-6盎司，使用该产品仅约3盎司，还需用Pump In Style补吸2盎司。后续更新称几乎吸不出奶，仅几毫升，尝试30分钟无效，客服建议也未奏效，正在等待再次回复。

review_content: Love this product let me tell you why: I’ve had this pump for 4 months now and it still works great. My 3rd child and i wanted to try a hands free pump. I had a Medela, Lansinoh,and Spectra. Lansinoh my favorite. When i first opened it i followed all the directions and sized my boob/nipple as instructed. I placed the proper inserts and have been getting a good amount of milk each time. I had a spectra and it was giving me 1-3 ounces per boob and i still felt full after, so i bought this product. My left is and has always been 1-2 ounces. My right is 4-6. The charge is great. I charge it before my 12 hour shift and i’m able to use it all night plus half my shift on the next day. It’s medium volume, sounds like someone snoring lol. Doesn’t bother me. Cleaning and taking apart the pieces is super simple. If and when this one breaks, i’ll be buying another.
review_content_ch:
得到很多奶
喜欢这个产品，让我告诉你为什么：我用了这款吸奶器4个月了，它仍然很好用。这是我的第三个孩子，我想试试免提吸奶器。我买过Medela、Lansinoh和Spectra的。Lansinoh是我最喜欢的。第一次打开时，我按照所有说明，并按要求测量了我的乳房/乳头尺寸。我放入了合适的插入件，每次都能吸出不少奶。我之前用过Spectra，每侧乳房只能吸出1-3盎司，而且吸完后我还觉得胀，所以我就买了这个产品。我的左侧乳房一直只有1-2盎司，右侧是4-6盎司。充电效果很好。我在12小时轮班前充好电，就能整晚使用，还能用到第二天半个班次。声音中等，像有人在打呼噜哈哈。不打扰我。清洁和拆卸部件超级简单。如果这个坏了，我会再买一个。
review_summary: 使用4个月，出奶量好：左胸1-2盎司，右胸4-6盎司。充电一次可支撑12小时夜班加半天班。音量中等（像打鼾），不介意。清洁简单。如果坏了会再买。

review_content: Terrible pump. I write this at 4am after using this pump for 2 weeks. Insufficient ability to "empty" my milk. Typically I average pumping +32oz a day between my Spectra and Tsrete wearable but with this Paruu my output was HALF. I had high hopes due to reviews but don't waste your money. I bought this because my Tsrete died on me and i can't find the Tsrete on Amazon anymore. Milk collector design is ridiculous it's like the want you to dump your milk all over the counter when it comes time to pour it out, and it's hard to clean. Silicone parts already need replacement and it's only been 2 weeks. At first I thought maybe it was just a hormone issue as I have been pumping for 6 months but I switched to the Medela manual pump to protect my supply from dipping, was able to get back to my average. I do alternate between my Spectra and wearables for more freedom and this pump caused more stress. I don't understand how it could have great suction power but TERRIBLE output results AND TERRIBLE design to pour out milk. Definitely only going to use this pump in emergency situations because I'm closer to ending my pumping journey to justify buying another wearable pump. Definitely don't believe the hype on this pump it's not good. This is baby number two and I have tried the Medela harmony, Tsrete, Spectra and Medela hand pump. The worst of it really is design of the milk collector. Difficult to clean and spilt milk guaranteed each pour due to the way the silicone diaphragm. Only way to make sure you don't end up with milk on the counter is to pour out with the motor in place but that's not great for the motor. I wish I could give zero stars I'm so disappointed because the first time I used it the suction was so strong and had high hopes to be able to empty faster or at least stay at my average milk removal and instead it almost ruined my supply due to inadequate removal. I tried every setting and various levels for 2 weeks before writing this review. Try a different product.
review_content_ch:
集奶器设计糟糕透顶
吸奶器太差劲了。我在凌晨4点写下这条评论，这款吸奶器我已经用了两周。它无法有效“排空”我的乳汁。通常我使用 Spectra 和 Tsrete 穿戴式吸奶器，日均吸奶量超过32盎司，但用这款 Paruu 吸奶器时，出奶量只有原来的一半。因为看到好评我曾寄予厚望，但大家别浪费钱了。我买这款是因为我的 Tsrete 坏了，而且在亚马逊上再也找不到 Tsrete 了。集奶器的设计简直荒谬，倒奶的时候好像故意让你把奶洒得到处都是，而且很难清洗。硅胶部件才用了两周就需要更换。起初我以为可能是激素问题，毕竟我已经吸奶6个月了，但我换成了 Medela 手动吸奶器以保护奶量不下降，结果奶量恢复到了平均水平。我通常在 Spectra 和穿戴式吸奶器之间交替使用以获得更多自由，但这款吸奶器带来了更多压力。我不明白为什么它吸力很强，但出奶效果却极差，而且倒奶的设计也糟糕透顶。鉴于我快要结束吸奶历程了，为了证明再买一款穿戴式吸奶器是合理的，我决定只在紧急情况下使用这款吸奶器。绝对不要相信这款吸奶器的宣传，它并不好。这是我的第二个孩子，我试过 Medela Harmony、Tsrte、Spectra 和 Medela 手动吸奶器。其中最糟糕的确实是集奶器的设计。由于硅胶吸力碗的结构，每次倒奶都保证会洒出来，而且很难清洗。确保不把奶洒在台面上的唯一方法是在电机就位的情况下倒出，但这对电机不好。我真希望能给零分，我太失望了，因为第一次使用时吸力非常强，我曾满怀希望它能更快排空或至少保持我的平均排奶量，结果反而因为排奶不足差点毁了我的奶量。在写这条评论之前，我尝试了各种设置和级别长达两周。试试其他产品吧。
review_summary: 用户使用Paruu吸奶器两周，认为吸力虽强但排空不足，奶量仅为平时一半，几乎影响奶量；储奶收集器设计差，倒奶易洒且难清洗，硅胶件两周就需更换。因原Tsrete损坏且亚马逊买不到才购买，试用所有档位后仍失望，仅打算应急使用，并考虑提前结束泵奶以换其他可穿戴吸奶器。

review_content: Sooo I was a bit apprehensive. But I’m pleasantly surprised. I prayed this pump would work for me. As a mother of 2 under 2 trying to breastfeed a wearable pump is a must but I had the Elvie stride with the first and it was an absolute dud I was getting less than 2 oz after 30 mins and they hurt. I tried the tseret from Amazon which is actually ranked higher than these but I got less milk and they were way more noticeable. This pump is great. I thought I wanted it because of the different modes but I stick with the tradition let down/expression combo and just go back and forth between those two. There are some nuances that I don’t feel are worth mentioning because they don’t dim the quality or effectiveness of this pump. I’m just hoping they last for the full duration of my breastfeeding journey and that there’s some means to get replacement parts seeing as this pump is discontinued/ no longer avail on the paruu sight, therefore no diagrams or valves are listed for purchase. Also! Super easy to clean and assemble only the 3 parts plus the motor which is awesome. This won’t replace your wall pump imo but the suctions strong and this can def empty you once you find the right settings. It may take a bit longer than a session with a traditional hospital grade pump. For me I have to power pump to get my regular amount, but I don’t mind as I’m trying to increase my supply anyway and this allows me to keep doing whatever I was doing before needing to pump.
review_content_ch:
唯一真正好用的穿戴式吸奶器！
说实话我本来有点担心。但结果让我惊喜。我一直祈祷这款吸奶器能适合我。作为有两个不满两岁宝宝的哺乳期妈妈，穿戴式吸奶器是刚需。之前用Elvie stride简直是灾难——30分钟连60毫升都吸不到还疼得要命。后来试了亚马逊上评分更高的tseret，结果出奶量更少而且明显更显眼。这款吸奶器太棒了。本以为会喜欢它的多种模式，结果发现最常用的还是传统刺激/泌乳模式来回切换。有些小细节不值一提，完全不影响使用效果。只希望它能撑过整个哺乳期，毕竟paruu网站已经下架这款产品，连购买替换阀门或查看结构图的渠道都没有了。对了！清洗组装超方便，就3个零件加主机。虽然不能完全替代壁挂式吸奶器，但吸力够强，调对模式后完全可以排空乳房。可能比医用级吸奶器耗时稍长些。我得多用强力模式才能达到平常的奶量，不过反正我在追奶，边泵奶边做其他事也挺好。
review_summary: 优点：效果好，吸力强，能排空乳房；清洁和组装简单，仅3个部件加马达。缺点：可能比传统壁挂式泵耗时更长，需要power pump才能达到常规量；该型号已停产，官网无法购买替换零件，存在配件获取风险。

review_content: I’ve been using the Paruu breast pump for several months, and it has been a very convenient and comfortable option—especially as a busy mom. It’s lightweight, easy to assemble, and the suction is effective without being uncomfortable. The parts are easy to clean and sanitize. This is the only wearable pump, after my Spectra wall pump, that was able to fully empty my breasts. The only drawback is that it can be a little loud- but I didn’t mind the noise. At one point, I had an issue with one of the motors losing suction. I contacted customer support, and they responded quickly and went above and beyond by sending me a full replacement set. Their customer service was truly excellent and made the experience stress-free. I’m now almost at the end of my breastfeeding journey, and this pump has been a reliable companion. I would definitely recommend it to other moms looking for an affordable, wearable pump with great customer support.

review_content: This is baby #3 for me and I’ve never had a wearable pump before. I decided to order one because even the occasional pump with 3 little ones at home is downright impossible with my plug in Spectra. I didn’t want to break the bank since I only pump once per day & nurse the remainder of the time. So I did my research and ordered this one. It is incredible. I get more milk output than I ever get from my Spectra and in half the time! I love that it comes with multiple flange sizes which makes it more comfortable. It’s totally changed my opinion of pumping which I used to hate because I was tethered to my Spectra. I cannot recommend this pump enough. I’ve never tried any of the expensive brands (Elvie or Willow) but I can’t imagine it doing anything more than this one. Only potential cons (which don’t honestly bother me) are that it’s not all that quiet and there’s no timer, so you just have to watch the clock.

review_content: The **Momcozy Air 1 Ultra‑Slim Breast Pump** has been a total game changer for my wifes pumping routine! If you’re looking for a hands‑free, discreet, and comfortable pumping solution, this wearable pump delivers on nearly every front. --- ## 🤱 **Hands‑Free & Wearable Design** What makes this pump stand out is the **hands‑free wearable design**. It fits comfortably inside a nursing bra, so you can pump while you go about your day—whether you’re working, cooking, or just relaxing. No more balancing flanges and parts or being tethered to a bulky unit! The **ultra‑slim shape** feels lightweight and unobtrusive. I barely noticed I was wearing it, and that freedom made pumping *so much less stressful*—especially during repeat sessions. --- ## 🔋 **Wireless Charging Case — Brilliant Addition** The **wireless charging case** is incredibly convenient. It’s compact and easy to carry in a diaper bag or purse, and it keeps the pump charged without fumbling with cords. When I’m running low on battery mid‑day, I just pop the pump into the case and go. It’s so simple and thoughtful. --- ## ⭐️ **Comfort & Performance** * **Gentle suction** is adjustable so it never feels painful * Comfortable seal with good stimulation and expression modes * Quiet operation — perfect for discreet pumping at work or in public * Strong enough to produce a solid flow without being harsh The suction cycles feel natural and mimic a baby’s rhythm well, so I don’t feel sore afterward. And unlike some wearable pumps, it didn’t leave me with plugged ducts or discomfort. --- ## 📌 **What I Love Most** ✅ **True hands‑free pumping** — finally free to multitask ✅ **Wireless charging case** — no tangled cords or searching for plugs ✅ **Compact and portable** — ideal for travel or work ✅ **Quiet, comfortable, and effective** ✅ **Easy to assemble and clean** --- ## ⚠️ **Minor Cons** 🔹 **Milk collection cups** are a bit smaller than traditional pumps 🔹 **Takes a few tries to get the perfect seal** at first 🔹 Wireless charging case adds a little bulk (but worth it overall) --- ## 🧠 **Final Verdict** The **Momcozy Air 1 Ultra‑Slim Breast Pump** is one of the most *practical and user‑friendly* wearable pumps I’ve used. It combines **comfort, freedom, and performance** in a way that makes pumping a lot less of a chore. If you want a pump that lets you stay hands‑free without sacrificing effectiveness, this one is definitely worth it!

review_content: I am a believer! Ive used the Medela Symphony since hospital discharge and it’s worked SO well, so I’ve been dreading going back to work after maternity leave ends because I’d need to transition to wearables, which of course can reduce your output. This pump’s massage and warmth really helped my output and I got what I usually get with the Symphony in a SHORTER time! I am so impressed. It felt really comfortable. I think the display is a little confusing with all of the programming options but I don’t consider that a downside- I just need to learn the different options they have. It is bulky but weirdly not heavy, so while I certainly look like I’m wearing wearables, it doesn’t bring my bra down with weight like this cheaper wearable I tried did. Overall, I am thrilled and would recommend you try this wearable.
review_content_ch:
媲美 Medela Symphony
我彻底被圈粉了！自从出院后我一直使用 Medela Symphony，效果非常好，所以我一直很害怕产假结束后重返职场，因为那时我得换用穿戴式吸奶器，而这通常会降低奶量。这款吸奶器的按摩和热敷功能真的帮助提升了我的奶量，而且我用比平时更短的时间就达到了使用 Symphony 时的产量！印象太深刻了。佩戴起来非常舒适。我觉得显示屏上的各种编程选项有点让人困惑，但我不认为这是个缺点——我只是需要时间去熟悉它的不同功能。它体积较大，但奇怪的是并不重，所以虽然我看起来确实像戴着穿戴式设备，但它不会像我试过的某款较便宜的穿戴式吸奶器那样因为重量把内衣往下坠。总的来说，我非常满意，推荐大家试试这款穿戴式吸奶器。
review_summary: 用户称该吸奶器可与美德乐Symphony媲美：按摩和温热功能帮助在更短时间内达到往常奶量，佩戴舒适；显示屏选项多略难懂但不视为缺点，机身虽笨重但不重，不像此前更便宜的穿戴式产品那样下拉胸罩。用户非常满意并推荐尝试。

review_content: I got this pump in the beginning of March and have been using it in rotation with my wall pump since then. It’s great to put on while I’m getting ready or taking a drive. I got a Ceres for the milk when we are out a lot during the day. Grabbed some of the pump wipes and these three things have made a world of difference for days that are unavoidable and we are out and about. I have other wearable pumps but I feel like this one is so far the best at emptying. It has one extra piece for cleaning but I haven’t found it to be bothersome for the one extra piece, especially since it feels like I get the same results as the walk pumps. The only downside is it’s a little deep while in a pumping/nursing bra sometimes but with a flowy top it’s not super noticeable unless someone is really looking. The noise is however noticeable but again I’m mainly using it to get ready and save time, pump while driving, or to get stuff around the house done so the noise isn’t really a factor for me. If this one were to no longer work I would definitely purchase another, it’s a good price point and has helped my quality of life while pumping for my baby.
review_content_ch:
非常适合多任务处理！
我在三月初买了这款吸奶器，从那以后一直和我的壁挂式吸奶器轮换使用。它很适合在我准备出门或开车时戴上。白天我们经常外出时，我买了一个Ceres来装母乳。还拿了一些吸奶器清洁湿巾，这三样东西对那些不可避免要外出的日子起了巨大作用。我还有其他可穿戴吸奶器，但我觉得这款目前是排空效果最好的。它多了一个清洗零件，但我并不觉得麻烦，尤其是感觉它和壁挂式吸奶器效果一样。唯一的缺点是它放在吸奶/哺乳内衣里有点深，但配上宽松的上衣不会太显眼，除非有人特意盯着看。不过噪音是明显的，但我主要是在准备出门时用它来节省时间，或者开车时吸奶，或者做家务时用，所以噪音对我来说不算什么问题。如果这款坏了，我肯定会再买一个，它价格合理，而且在我为宝宝吸奶期间提高了我的生活质量。

review_content: The Momcozy M5 wearable breast pump is a great option for moms who need the flexibility to pump while staying productive. The hands-free, cordless design fits discreetly inside a bra, making it convenient for working, traveling, or simply getting things done around the house without being attached to tubes. One of my favorite features is the app control. Being able to switch modes, adjust the intensity, control each side independently, and even view pumping history from my phone is incredibly convenient. It eliminates the need to fumble with buttons while wearing the pump. The suction feels gentle and is designed to mimic a baby’s natural latch, making pumping more comfortable while still encouraging good milk output. The added micro-vibration is a nice touch and seems to help stimulate milk flow. With three pumping routines and nine intensity levels, it’s easy to customize each session to what feels best. I also appreciate that it comes with multiple flange sizes, making it easier to find a comfortable and effective fit without needing to purchase additional inserts. Cleanup is simple thanks to the snap-apart design, and the food-grade silicone parts feel soft and well made. Overall, this is a thoughtfully designed wearable pump that combines comfort, convenience, and technology. It’s a great investment for busy moms looking for a discreet and customizable pumping experience.
review_content_ch:
值得花钱
Momcozy M5 可穿戴吸奶器是那些需要灵活泵奶同时保持高效工作的妈妈们的绝佳选择。免提、无线的设计可以巧妙地隐藏在胸罩内，方便在工作、旅行或在家做家务时使用，无需连接管子。我最喜欢的功能之一是应用程序控制。能够切换模式、调节强度、独立控制每侧，甚至通过手机查看泵奶历史，这非常方便。它消除了佩戴吸奶器时摸索按钮的需要。吸力感觉温和，设计模仿婴儿的天然含接，使泵奶更舒适，同时仍能促进良好的出奶量。增加的微振动是一个不错的细节，似乎有助于刺激奶流。三种泵奶程序和九种强度级别，很容易根据感觉定制每次泵奶。我还喜欢它配有多种尺寸的法兰，更容易找到舒适有效的贴合，无需额外购买配件。清洁很简单，得益于卡扣式设计，食品级硅胶部件感觉柔软且做工精良。总体而言，这是一款精心设计的可穿戴吸奶器，结合了舒适、便利和技术。对于寻求隐蔽且可定制泵奶体验的忙碌妈妈来说，这是一项很好的投资。
review_summary: 用户高度评价Momcozy M5穿戴式吸奶器，认为其无绳设计便于工作或家务时使用，特别赞赏手机APP控制功能可调节模式和强度。吸力温和模拟婴儿自然吸吮，附带微振动促进泌乳。提供多种尺寸法兰和易清洗设计，整体设计兼顾舒适性与科技感。

review_content: Very disappointed. I got this as a second pump I would alternate with my eufy s1 pumps. I liked that it has less parts than most, and was curious if I’d get a different output being that I used the eufy so much I thought it’s motor might have been wearing down on me however the idea of only having 3 parts is only true if you are a 24mm girl as it’s really still 4 parts because of the flange inserts and the suction is more comfortably but probably less than the eufy. And without the heat that my eufy uses, I think it’s still bringing out less than my trusty eufy. It is very easy to put together. Lightweight. But not as quiet as I was hoping and upon arrival I noticed one of the tubes were bent, making for that annoying have to pinch it straight when you use it situation or you get less suction. And ultimately why I ended up returning this thing because in less than a week, the suction on one completely gave out because the backflow/duck bill valve became too loose and kept falling off the diaphragm of the device so I’m just irritated now.
review_content_ch:
不到一周就退货了
非常失望。我买这款吸奶器是作为第二台，打算和我的 Eufy S1 吸奶器交替使用。我喜欢它的部件比大多数产品都少，也很好奇产量会不会有所不同，因为我之前用 Eufy 用得太多，以为它的电机可能在我身上磨损了。然而，“只有3个部件”的说法仅适用于使用24毫米法兰的用户，因为加上法兰内衬，实际上还是有4个部件。吸力虽然更舒适，但可能不如 Eufy。而且没有 Eufy 那样的热敷功能，我觉得它的出奶量还是不如我那台可靠的 Eufy。它组装起来非常容易，重量也很轻。但没有我期望的那么安静，而且收到货时我发现其中一根管子弯了，导致使用时必须把它捏直，否则吸力会减弱。最终我决定退货的原因是，在不到一周的时间里，一侧的吸力完全失效了，因为回流/鸭嘴阀变得太松，不断从设备的吸力碗上脱落，所以我现在很恼火。
review_summary: 用户为与eufy s1交替使用而购买。认为仅24mm时才是3个零件（带法兰插件实为4件），组装简单、轻便，吸力较舒适，但可能弱于eufy且无加热，噪音也比预期大。到货时一根软管弯曲，需捏直否则吸力下降；不到一周一侧吸力完全失效，因回流/鸭嘴阀过松反复从隔膜脱落，故退货并感到恼火。

review_content: I have liked this pump so far. It makes it easy to pump in the car, on breaks, and when I'm cooking or doing dishes. This pump does however have an automatic shut off **Edit: auto shut off can be turned off in the app** if you lean even a littlle too far forward which has made it a bit inconvenient and obnoxious in some aspects. They fit pretty well in your bra and aren't too noisy for most settings. The app is also a bit inaccurate with how much has actually been pumped but not by too much. Sometimes it takes a while to get the pumps actually connected to the app to start them but you can also use them without it by pushing the plus or minus buttons on the physical pumps. A few days ago, I put this at a low score on account of the charging case not working after getting it less than a month ago. I had plugged it into many different cords and outlets but it just wouldn't turn on or charge the pumps when the pumps worked just fine with their own charging cord. Since then, I had decided to plug it in to see if anything would happen and after a few hours it finally began to charge back up and work as it did before. I highly recommend you keep it from dying fully if you can help it. That being said, I mostly feed straight from my breasts and only need to pump bottles for preschool throughout the week so my pumping schedule is a bit different from most. I pump in the car to my workplace, again on my lunch, and again on car ride home. I produce enough to get through the day with at least a bottle left over for the next (though I am finally producing enough to store for emergencies etc.) and I latch him when we're home. This pump works for me and this schedule so far, though I can understand why it won't work for everyone.
review_content_ch:
别让充电盒完全没电..
目前为止我对这款吸奶器挺满意的。它让我在车上、休息时、做饭或洗碗时都能轻松吸奶。不过这款吸奶器有个自动关机功能**编辑：可在APP中关闭自动关机**，只要身体稍微前倾就会触发，这在某些情况下确实有点麻烦和恼人。它们能很好地贴合文胸，在大多数环境下噪音也不大。APP显示的实际吸奶量有点不准，但偏差不大。有时需要花点时间才能让吸奶器连接上APP启动，但你也可以通过按实体吸奶器上的加减按钮直接使用。几天前因为充电盒故障（购买不到一个月就坏了），我给了低分。我试过各种数据线和插座，它就是无法开机或给吸奶器充电，而吸奶器用自带的充电线却完全正常。后来我决定再插电试试，几小时后它终于开始充电并恢复正常。强烈建议尽量避免让它完全耗尽电量。话说回来，我主要是亲喂，只需在工作日给幼儿园准备瓶喂奶，所以我的吸奶安排和多数人不同。我在上班路上、午休时和下班路上各吸一次，产量足够当天使用还能剩至少一瓶备用（现在终于能存些应急储备了），回家后就直接亲喂。这款吸奶器目前很适合我和这个作息，当然我理解它未必适合所有人。

review_content: MAMAS: THIS IS A MUST HAVE!! If you are questioning whether or not to buy these pumps, DO IT. I own a Spectra pump and these hand free pumps work better in my opinion. They suck more milk out! I was a little skeptical at first because of how much cheaper they are compared to other hand free pumps. However, they actually work amazing! Each pump only has 4 parts, so super easy to take apart, clean, and put back together. I can’t speak for how well these work compared to Momcozy or other “elite” hand free pumps, but I feel as though these pumps empty me completely! I do want to add: 1. The battery life is only about 30 minutes or so. I think that’s perfect because you really shouldn’t pump for longer than that, but I did want to mention. 2. I’ve seen a lot of reviews regarding the noise. It does make noise. However, it’s really not that loud. I guess it depends on the person, but my children are able to sleep through it! It does not seem to bother them and it does not bother me. You can easily talk over the sound or watch television. I guess it just depends on the person, but don’t let the sound discourage you! Still a wonderful buy. Overall 10/10 and I’m even considering buying another to have as backup!
review_content_ch:
方便，吸力强，设计简单
妈妈们：这是必备品！！如果你还在犹豫是否要买这些吸奶器，那就买吧。我自己有一台Spectra吸奶器，但在我看来，这些免提吸奶器效果更好。它们能吸出更多奶！一开始我有点怀疑，因为它们比其他免提吸奶器便宜很多。不过，它们实际上效果惊人！每个吸奶器只有4个部件，所以拆卸、清洗和重新组装都非常简单。我无法与Momcozy或其他“高端”免提吸奶器比较它们的效果，但我觉得这些吸奶器能完全排空我的乳房！我想补充两点：1. 电池续航大约只有30分钟左右。我觉得这很完美，因为你不应该吸奶超过那么长时间，但我还是想提一下。2. 我看到很多关于噪音的评论。它确实会有声音。不过，其实并没有那么大声。我觉得这因人而异，但我的孩子们能在它工作时睡着！它似乎不会打扰到他们，也不会打扰到我。你可以轻松地说话或看电视。我想这取决于个人，但别让声音影响你的决定！仍然是一次很棒的购买。总体评分10/10，我甚至考虑再买一个作为备用。
review_summary: 优点：方便、吸力强、设计简单，比Spectra泵更好用，吸奶更多，价格便宜但效果惊人，仅4个部件易拆洗，能完全排空乳房。缺点：电池续航约30分钟，有噪音但不算太响，不影响孩子睡觉或交谈。

review_content: These pumps are super convient and easy to use. I’ve found that my supply has increased. I’ve tried other wearable pumps like the mom cozy but I would barely get any milk out. I also tried the medella but I hate being plugged to the wall and they are also uncomfortable. I’ve honestly tried many pumps aside from those and came to the conclusion that no pump is perfect. Although these pumps are great they do leak A LOT and they make SO much noise I can’t even pump in the room when my baby is sleeping so I have to go somewhere else and can’t watch over her. These are also not convincing if you’re someone who’s planning on using them while they nurse because they are simply too loud for your baby. The suction is very good though. Also, if you’re a good producer these aren’t the pumps for you because they don’t hold a lot of milk and once you get to like 6oz they start to leak pretty bad. The battery life isn’t great. These are good for the price but maybe not the best out there.

review_content: First, I used my insurance company to get a breast pump that was wireless now that I have more than one child. It became more important to have one that I could be mobile with. I paid 50 extra dollars for the zombie breast pump. Shortly after getting it may be a month into using it Silicone funnels started to wear away. The grooves cracked on the cup that holds the milk. I had to request for replacement parts to be shipped. A month after that, the pumps began to not suck out the milk as strong as they used to. First it was one side then I began using one of them on each breast at a time, but that only lasted a day before the other ones started to not work as well either. I requested for replacements, and somehow the order was never processed. After calling back again and explaining the situation with the baby in the Nicu they were supposed to expedited. However, there was a delay in the product being picked up from UPS and then actually getting it to the home. Taking about two weeks to have been received. After receiving this product, it was transforming. It has worked so well I just can’t say enough about how much I am in love with it. I didn’t even realize that it has a feature with a whole at the top of the pump that allows you to take it off of your breast, and pour directly into a bottle. My first impression was that it was cheap because it didn’t have hard plastic and it used some type of latex or silicone material to cut the outside, which is actually where the milk is held. However, as I began to use it, I realize that this was a really cool design and works very well. I love it very very much .
review_content_ch:
最棒的吸奶器，超级满意！
首先，我通过保险公司获得了一款无线吸奶器，因为现在我有不止一个孩子。能够移动使用变得更重要了。我多花了50美元买了这款僵尸吸奶器。使用约一个月后，硅胶漏斗开始磨损。盛奶杯的凹槽出现裂纹，不得不申请更换配件。又过一个月，吸力开始不如从前。先是单侧出现问题，后来我尝试两侧轮流使用单泵，但仅维持一天另一侧也出现故障。虽然申请了换货，但订单始终未处理。再次致电说明NICU婴儿的情况后，对方承诺加急处理。然而UPS取件和实际送达家中出现延误，耗时约两周才收到。收到新产品后简直脱胎换骨——效果太好让我爱不释手！甚至发现泵头顶部有个开口设计，可以直接取下倒入奶瓶。最初觉得它廉价，因为外壳不是硬塑料而是某种乳胶/硅胶材质（实际储奶部位），但使用后发现这个设计非常巧妙且高效。我太太太喜欢它了！

review_content: I wanted so badly to love these- I compared so many versions and hemmed and hawed over them for WEEKS. Finally, I used what was left of my registry’s completion discount and even with that AND the company’s 10% off, they weren’t worth the money at all. The biggest reason for wanting these was that they’re “wearable” so I wouldn’t be locked in my recliner while pumping- let me tell you I had greater mobility with tubes and flanges and glass bottles attached to me than these. The SLIGHTEST movement, no matter how much milk is in the collection cups, and they shut off. Even when I was sitting with them, I couldn’t lean over in any direction, let alone accomplish a task. While you can push a button on the devices to turn them back on, they go out of sync when you do, so really you need to have your phone on you to constantly turn them back on; however, when you do that, it resets your program from the beginning rather than picking up where you left off. I now completely understand the reviews that say you need the app to control them, because while you can turn them on and off with their buttons, you can do very little else. Speaking of the app, I already had a different app to track my baby / milk supply, etc. and hated that I couldn’t disable the prompts to record my milk collection, which became super annoying to dismiss every single time- not only that, but their reading of what was collected was never correct, and for someone struggling with supply, it was a huge let down when I realized they’d overestimated (pun intended). Another negative is how long it takes to disassemble, clean, and reassemble them, especially compared to their own products. All the tiny pieces were such a pain, and not only was it time consuming to clean them, it was super frustrating that so much milk was wasted getting caught in all these little crevices. If you have an over supply, you might not mind, but I know I’m not the only one who feels like every damn drop is precious, and these are terrible if that’s the case. Speaking of case, it is a super sleek look with the wireless charging, that was just about the only positive thing I have to say about these. Unfortunately, the devices themselves, while looking sleek, were so heavy with the individual motors that they felt very cumbersome, especially when I tried to move around. I wish my experience had been as positive as others, but if you’re on the fence, I’d save the money and go with the V1 or V2- they’re so much lighter, easier to clean, and affordable in comparison!
review_content_ch:
省省钱吧，这根本算不上“可穿戴”。
我本来非常想喜欢这款产品——比较了好多版本，犹豫了好几周。最后用了注册表完成折扣的剩余额度，再加上公司的10%优惠，结果完全不值这个价。最想要它的原因就是“可穿戴”特性，以为用吸奶器时不用被困在躺椅里——结果告诉你，我挂着软管、法兰和玻璃瓶都比用这玩意儿活动自如。只要稍微动一下，不管集乳杯里有多少奶，机器就会停机。就算坐着不动，往任何方向倾身都不行，更别提做事了。虽然可以按机器按钮重新启动，但会失去同步，所以必须随时带着手机不停重启——而且每次重启都会从头开始程序，不能续接。现在完全理解那些说必须用APP控制的评价了，因为除了开关机，按钮几乎没用。说到APP，我本来就有其他应用记录宝宝喝奶量等数据，特别讨厌不能关闭记录挤奶量的提示，每次都要手动关闭烦死了——更糟的是，它的收集量读数从来不准，对奶量不足的妈妈来说，发现它虚报时简直崩溃（双关梗）。另一个缺点是拆洗组装太耗时，尤其和自家其他产品比。那么多小零件特别麻烦，不光清洗费时，更让人抓狂的是大量奶水残留在缝隙里浪费掉。如果你是奶量过剩可能无所谓，但我知道不是只有我觉得每一滴都珍贵，这种情况千万别买。说到外观，无线充电设计确实很酷——这大概是我唯一能夸的了。可惜机器本身虽然看着时髦，但独立马达让机身重得离谱，活动时特别笨重。真希望我的体验能和别人一样好，但如果你在犹豫，建议省钱买V1或V2——轻便得多，好清洗，价格也更合理！
review_summary: 产品宣称的'可穿戴'功能名不副实，轻微移动就会导致设备关闭且无法自动恢复。操作依赖手机APP且程序会重置，清洁过程繁琐且浪费母乳。设备笨重，唯一优点是无线充电设计。

review_content: I was really excited to try the newly announced Momcozy Air 1 Ultra-Slim Breast Pump, and it has been a great addition to my pumping routine so far. It’s surprisingly discreet — not very noticeable under clothing — and quiet enough that I can use it even while my baby is sleeping. The milk output has been similar to my Momcozy M5, which I was happy to see. To access all of the features, you do need to download the app. Since the pump itself doesn’t have a screen, things like mode selection and battery level are only shown in the app. Each side has five parts to clean, and while there’s a slight learning curve at first, the installation becomes easy once you get used to it. Comfort-wise, it’s excellent. It feels light, and I almost forget I’m pumping. I also appreciate the small cap that seals the milk during expressing — very helpful since I tend to move around a lot. Overall, I’m really glad I tried this new release. It’s comfortable, convenient, and fits seamlessly into my day. Definitely recommend!
review_content_ch:
超薄、静音且出奇便利
我对试用新推出的Momcozy Air 1超薄吸奶器充满期待，目前它已成为我吸奶日常的优秀补充。其隐蔽性令人惊喜——穿着衣物时几乎不可察觉——静音效果极佳，甚至能在宝宝睡觉时使用。出奶量与我的Momcozy M5相当，这让我非常满意。要使用全部功能需下载配套应用，由于吸奶器本身没有屏幕，模式选择和电量显示等操作仅能通过APP完成。每侧有五个需清洁的部件，虽然初次使用稍有学习成本，但习惯后组装非常简便。舒适度方面表现卓越，机身轻盈到几乎忘记正在吸乳。还配有密封盖防止吸乳时乳汁洒漏——对我这种经常走动的人非常实用。总体而言，这次新品尝试让我十分欣喜。它舒适便携，能完美融入日常生活。强烈推荐！
review_summary: 产品轻薄静音，穿戴隐蔽不打扰宝宝睡眠，出奶量与M5型号相当。需下载APP操作模式选择和查看电量，初次安装稍有难度但很快适应。佩戴舒适几乎无感，附带密封盖防止溢奶。

review_content: Got these for a cheap pump option before having my first baby, thinking I was going to breastfeed and just have this for pumping at work after going back. Well my son unfortunately could not breastfeed to save his life so I became pumping exclusively with combo feeding. On literal day 6 of my sons life, one of these pumps - RIGHT when I was starting to get up to ~4oz each pump session - one of the motors straight up stops working properly (in the middle of the night when I was painfully encouraged and hormonal as hell of course). It turned on, but vibrated like a cell phone, nothing to actually pump, just noise. I LOVED this pump for the 6 days it worked, but not even getting a week of use out of it pissed me off beyond belief. review_content: Le compré este extractor de leche Paruu P10 a mi esposa porque quería que tuviera algo práctico, cómodo y que no le hiciera pasar más trabajo del necesario. De verdad ha sido una excelente compra. Ella siempre andaba buscando algo que no fuera ruidoso, que no doliera y que le permitiera moverse sin estar conectada a cables, y este modelo cumple todo eso. La succión es bastante fuerte y eficiente, pero lo que más valoramos es que es manos libres. Mi esposa puede seguir haciendo sus cosas, descansar o estar con el bebé sin tener que quedarse sentada y limitada. Además, tiene varios modos y niveles, así que ella ajusta la potencia a lo que le resulta más cómodo. También nos gustó que se limpia rápido, se arma fácil y no ocupa nada de espacio. La extracción es constante y no le causa molestias, algo que para mí era muy importante porque quería que tuviera una experiencia lo más tranquila posible. Si eres esposo y quieres ayudar a que el proceso de extracción de tu esposa sea más fácil, discreto y sin estrés, este extractor vale completamente la pena. Fue una compra muy acertada.
review_content_ch:
非常好用
我给我妻子买了这款Paruu P10吸奶器，因为我想让她拥有一个实用、舒适且不会给她带来额外麻烦的东西。确实是一次很棒的购买。她一直在寻找噪音小、不疼、并且能让她自由活动而不受电线束缚的产品，这款型号完全符合要求。吸力很强且高效，但我们最看重的是它可以解放双手。我妻子可以继续做自己的事情、休息或陪伴宝宝，而无需一直坐着受到限制。此外，它还有多种模式和档位，所以她可以根据自己最舒适的程度来调节吸力。我们也喜欢它清洁快、容易组装、而且不占空间。吸乳过程稳定，不会引起不适，这对我来说非常重要，因为我想让她拥有尽可能轻松舒适的体验。如果你是丈夫，想帮助妻子让吸乳过程更轻松、更私密、更无压力，这款吸奶器完全值得购买。这是一次非常明智的购买。
review_summary: 买家为妻子购入 Paruu P10 吸奶器，认为非常实用。优点包括：静音、不痛、无线免提、吸力强且高效、多模式多档位可调、易清洁、易组装、不占空间、吸奶稳定无不适，妻子可自由活动，体验舒适。强烈推荐给其他丈夫。

review_content: These pumps are easily my favorite, and I have used these so much more than I ever used my wall pump. These are portable, comfortable, and quiet. By far my favorite thing about these is the output I get from the mixed expression mode, I get so much more than I could ever get from my wall pump no matter what flange I used! review_content: Review of Momcozy Breast Pump V2 Pro Ultra-Lightweight, Hands-Free & Portable Wearable Pump with Upgraded Integrated DoubleFit Flange, Quiet & Leak-Proof Electric Pump, 3 Modes|9 Levels, 17/19/21/24mm: I wanted to love this portable breast pump - I really did. review_content_ch:
效果不佳
Momcozy 吸奶器 V2 Pro 超轻便、免手持便携式穿戴式吸奶器评测，配备升级版集成 DoubleFit 法兰，静音防漏电动吸奶器，3 种模式 | 9 档力度，17/19/21/24mm：我本想喜欢这款便携式吸奶器——真的。遗憾的是，它的效果并不好。它佩戴舒适，因为免手持所以很方便，也容易穿戴……但是，它就是不太好用。使用 20 分钟后总共只吸出了 1.5 盎司。随后改用常规吸奶器，在 10 分钟内又吸出了 5 盎司。

review_content: I bought the Momcozy M9 in March while preparing for the arrival of our baby. Now that our baby is here and we have been able to use it, I can say that the pump itself works very well. It has more than enough suction power and extracts milk effectively. We also own a Spectra S1 Plus, and so far my wife has not even needed to use it. My main complaint is the process of removing the milk and taking the container apart for cleaning. The seals are extremely tight and require far too much force to separate. After only four days of helping my wife disassemble and clean the pump, I ended up with pain in one of my fingers. I have already returned to work, and my finger still hurts from the amount of force required to pull the pieces apart. I consider myself very handy, I use tools regularly, and I definitely do not have delicate hands. Even so, I find it completely unnecessary for a product designed for daily use, especially by mothers who have just given birth, to require this much strength to open. I am honestly concerned that my wife could hurt herself trying to take it apart on her own. Overall, the pump performs its main function very well and has excellent suction, but Momcozy really needs to redesign the seals or the opening system so it is easier and safer to disassemble and clean.
review_content_ch:
使用效果很好，但拆解过程过于困难
我在三月为迎接宝宝出生购买了Momcozy M9吸奶器。现在宝宝出生后实际使用发现，吸奶器本身性能出色。吸力完全够用，挤奶效率很高。我们家还有Spectra S1 Plus，但至今我妻子都没需要用上它。主要不满在于取奶和拆解容器清洗的过程。密封圈过紧，分离时需要使的力气太大。才帮妻子拆洗四天，我一根手指就疼了。虽然我已复工，但拆解时使的劲仍让手指作痛。我自认动手能力强，经常使用工具，绝非手无缚鸡之力。即便如此，这款日常用品——尤其面向产后妈妈的设计——需要这么大劲才能打开，实在没必要。说实话我担心妻子自己拆解时会受伤。总体而言吸奶器核心功能优秀，吸力强劲，但Momcozy真该重新设计密封圈或开启系统，让拆洗更轻松安全。
review_summary: 吸奶器吸力充足且效果良好，但密封过紧导致拆洗困难，需要很大力气才能分开部件，使用四天后手指疼痛，担心产妇独自操作可能受伤。

review_content: The pump is a little bigger than others I have used in the past. It comes with a charger for each pump and assorted sized flags that range from 24mm=19mm along with a flange guide. There is no way of pausing the pump without turning it off and it does not come with any storing container/bag or any extra parts, making this an ideal back up pump. It is easy to take apart and put back together after washing all parts. It took me a few uses to get the right suction level and mode. I recommend skipping the let down setting and testing all modes and suction levels your first time using the pumps. It has 12 suction levels and i had to go up higher than any other pumps I have. I also had to pump for a lot longer than i am used to but they fit comfortably in my pumping bra. It is a decent quality pump to have on hand.

review_content: I absolutely love this pump! The design is so sleek and comfortable, and it fits perfectly in my bra without feeling bulky. I especially love the curved design because it makes it much more comfortable to wear. I was really impressed with how much milk I was able to remove in less time, which is a huge plus when you’re a busy mom! It has 4 different modes with 12 levels on each mode, so there are plenty of options to find what works best for you. I also have to mention how beautiful the packaging was! Everything was so thoughtfully organized, and I loved that the flange inserts had their own little box underneath one of the pumps. The included bag is also gorgeous and makes it so easy to keep everything together when I’m on the go. The instruction booklet was another thing I really appreciated. It has pictures and is super easy to understand, which made setting everything up so simple. Overall, I’m genuinely so happy with this pump! It’s comfortable, easy to use, beautifully designed, and affordable without feeling cheaply made. I would definitely recommend it to any mom looking for a quality wearable pump!

review_content: I also own a Spectra, and I’ll start by saying that this wearable pump does not give me quite the same output as my Spectra. But honestly, the convenience has completely won me over. Being able to pump while doing things around the house, working, or even driving has made such a difference in my daily routine. It may not have the same suction as a hospital/medical-grade style pump, but it absolutely gets the job done, and the heating and massage features are AMAZING. They make pumping much more comfortable for me. I also feel comfortable and confident using Momcozy products, which was another reason I chose this one. My only complaint is the number of parts that need to be washed. Like most wearable pumps, there are quite a few pieces, and if you don’t have a bottle washer, cleaning everything can get a little tedious. This is one of those products I wish I didn’t need, but somehow I ended up using it every single day and now I can’t imagine my routine without it. If convenience and being able to move around while pumping are important to you, this is absolutely worth considering.
review_content_ch:
真希望我不需要它…但现在却离不开它
我也有一台Spectra吸奶器，首先要说的是这款穿戴式吸奶器的出奶量不如Spectra。但说实话，它的便捷性彻底征服了我。能边做家务、工作甚至开车边吸奶，彻底改变了我的日常生活。虽然它的吸力可能比不上医院级吸奶器，但完全能满足需求，而且加热和按摩功能太棒了，让我吸奶时舒服多了。使用Momcozy的产品也让我感到安心放心，这也是我选择它的另一个原因。唯一不满的是需要清洗的零件太多。和大多数穿戴式吸奶器一样，部件相当多，如果没有奶瓶清洗器，清洁起来会有点麻烦。这就是那种我本希望不需要，却不知不觉每天都用，现在完全无法想象没有它的生活。如果吸奶时的便捷性和活动自由对你很重要，这款绝对值得考虑。

review_content: The Momcozy M9 has a convenient wearable design that makes hands-free pumping much more practical. The 24mm flange provides a comfortable fit when properly sized, and the wearable design sits securely without requiring you to hold the pump in place. Pricey but good quality The multiple modes and 15 intensity levels make it easy to adjust the settings for personal comfort and pumping preferences. The app control is another nice feature, allowing settings to be changed without having to reach under clothing or handle the pump directly. The compact design fits nicely inside a nursing bra, although getting the positioning right is important for a good seal and comfortable fit. The advertised 42dB noise level also makes it reasonably discreet for use around others. Overall, this is a well-designed wearable pump with a comfortable fit, plenty of adjustment options, convenient app controls, and the freedom of hands-free pumping.
review_content_ch:
舒适贴合且方便的无束缚设计，价格偏高
Momcozy M9吸奶器采用便捷的可穿戴设计，使无束缚吸乳更加实用。24mm法兰在尺寸合适时能提供舒适的贴合度，可穿戴设计稳固无需手持吸奶器。价格偏高但品质优良，多种模式和15档吸力强度便于根据个人舒适度和吸乳偏好调整设置。应用程序控制是另一亮点，无需伸手到衣物下或直接操作吸奶器即可更改设置。紧凑设计完美贴合哺乳文胸，但正确定位对确保良好密封和舒适贴合很重要。广告宣传的42分贝噪音水平使其在他人周围使用时相对隐蔽。总体而言，这是一款设计精良的可穿戴吸奶器，具有舒适贴合、丰富的调节选项、便捷的应用程序控制以及无束缚吸乳的自由度。
review_summary: 舒适贴合，免提设计方便实用，多种模式和强度可调，App控制便捷，噪音低，但价格较高。

review_content: Plenty of controls work without reaching into my bra. My phone runs the app. It starts pumping, then pauses. Settings change there. Pumping history stays saved. review_content: These pumps worked very well initially, but unfortunately, that only lasted about two months. I primarily use them while traveling, and at first I was very impressed with the suction strength, especially since I need stronger suction for effective pumping.After about two months, however, the suction significantly decreased. Even on the highest setting, the suction is now very weak and the pumps no longer empty me efficiently. I replaced the wearable parts to rule out normal wear and tear, but that did not resolve the issue.I also received a replacement pump set, but unfortunately, I began experiencing the same loss of suction within just a few weeks.I really wanted to like these pumps because they worked extremely well in the beginning and were convenient for travel. However, considering that I have now experienced the same issue with two separate sets, I’m disappointed with their long-term reliability and durability. For a product that is intended to be used regularly and costs as much as they do, I expected the suction performance to last much longer than a few weeks to two months.
review_content_ch:
花这么多钱却这么快就坏了
这些吸奶器最初非常好用，但可惜只维持了大约两个月。我主要在旅行时使用，一开始对吸力强度印象深刻，尤其因为我需要更强的吸力才能有效吸奶。然而大约两个月后，吸力明显下降。即使调到最高档位，现在吸力也非常弱，吸奶器无法有效排空乳汁。我更换了可穿戴部件以排除正常磨损，但问题并未解决。
我还收到了一套替换吸奶器，但不幸的是，仅仅几周后就开始出现同样的吸力下降问题。
我真的很喜欢这些吸奶器，因为它们一开始非常好用且便于旅行携带。但考虑到我已经在两套不同的设备上遇到同样的问题，我对它们的长期可靠性和耐用性感到失望。对于一个需要定期使用且价格不菲的产品，我预期吸力性能应该能维持远超过几周到两个月的时间。
review_summary: 吸奶器初始吸力强劲，但两个月后吸力明显下降，更换配件和新机后问题依旧，长期可靠性差。

review_content: the main issue i ran into was with the duckbill valve. initially, i was pulling it straight out, which put too much pressure on the small plastic clips and caused them to break. i later learned that the valve should be rotated about 45 degrees before pulling it down. once i started doing this, the parts lasted much longer. my flange ended up lasting more than six months compared with only a few weeks before i learned the proper technique. the plastic pieces will still eventually wear out with regular use, but that is fairly typical for breast pump parts. i was also surprised that the box did not include clear instructions explaining how to properly remove and assemble the valve. the instructions are available through the momcozy app, but i would have preferred having this information included in the packaging. overall, i think the quality of the m9 is very good. it provides strong suction, feels comfortable, and has been reliable enough for everyday use. while the replacement parts can be a little frustrating, proper handling makes a big difference in how long they last. considering the convenience and the improvement i have seen in my milk output, i think the momcozy m9 offers good value for the money. i keep an extra flange available just in case, and i would definitely recommend this pump to someone looking for a convenient hands free option
review_content_ch:
吸力很大，也很方便，但阀门需要一点时间适应。
我遇到的主要问题是鸭嘴阀。一开始，我是直接把它拔出来，这给小塑料卡扣施加了太大的压力，导致它们断裂。后来我了解到，在往下拔阀门之前，应该先将其旋转大约45度。开始这样做之后，配件的使用寿命大大延长了。我的喇叭罩最终使用了六个多月，而在我学会正确技巧之前只能用几周。塑料件在常规使用下最终还是会磨损，但这对于吸奶器配件来说是很正常的。我也很惊讶包装盒里没有附带清晰的说明，解释如何正确拆卸和组装阀门。说明可以在Momcozy App上找到，但我更希望这些信息能包含在包装里。总的来说，我认为M9的质量非常好。它吸力强劲，佩戴舒适，日常使用也非常可靠。虽然更换配件有时会让人有点沮丧，但正确的操作方式对它们的使用寿命有很大影响。考虑到它的便利性以及我看到的奶量提升，我认为Momcozy M9性价比很高。我会多备一个喇叭罩以防万一，如果有人正在寻找一款方便的免提吸奶器，我绝对会推荐这款产品。
review_summary: 吸力强且方便，但鸭嘴阀需适应。用户起初直拉导致小塑料卡扣受压断裂；学会先旋转约45度再下拉后，配件更耐用，法兰从仅用几周延长到六个月以上。塑料件仍会随日常使用磨损，属吸奶器配件常见情况。包装未附清晰的阀门拆装说明，需通过Momcozy App查看，用户希望随盒提供。整体M9质量很好，吸力强、舒适、日常可靠；替件略烦，正确操作可延长寿命，性价比高，会推荐给需要免手扶便利方案的人。

review_content: The Paruu P20 wearable breast pump comes as a two-pack, which is convenient for parents who want to pump from both sides or keep a second unit available. Its hands-free design is intended to fit inside a nursing bra, offering more flexibility than a traditional pump that requires holding bottles and flanges in place. The pump offers four modes and 12 suction levels, allowing users to adjust the settings according to their comfort and pumping needs. The LED display shows the selected mode, suction level, elapsed time, and milk volume, making it easier to monitor each session. It also includes three flange sizes—19 mm, 21 mm, and 24 mm—which provide some flexibility for finding a suitable fit. The transparent milk container is useful for checking collected milk, while the anti-backflow design and protective cover or stand help make handling and storage more convenient. The compact construction and rechargeable battery are also practical for pumping during the day, at work, or while traveling. With only four detachable parts, assembly and cleaning should be relatively straightforward, provided all milk-contact components are cleaned according to the manufacturer's instructions. Overall, this wearable pump has several convenient features, particularly its adjustable settings, display, and hands-free design. However, comfort, milk output, and noise level can vary from person to person, and wearable pumps may not work equally well for everyone. Correct flange sizing is important for comfort and effective milk removal, so check the fit carefully and follow the manufacturer's guidance for use, cleaning, and sterilization. The advertised battery runtime will also depend on the settings and frequency of use.
review_content_ch:
Paruu P20 可穿戴吸奶器双支装，具备可调节吸力和 LED 显示屏
Paruu P20 可穿戴吸奶器以双支装形式提供，方便希望同时从两侧吸奶或备用第二台设备的父母。其免手持设计旨在放入哺乳文胸内，相比需要用手固定奶瓶和法兰的传统吸奶器，提供了更高的灵活性。该吸奶器提供四种模式和 12 级吸力，允许用户根据个人舒适度和吸奶需求调整设置。LED 显示屏显示所选模式、吸力等级、已用时间和奶量，便于监测每次吸奶过程。它还包含三种尺寸的法兰——19 毫米、21 毫米和 24 毫米——为找到合适的贴合度提供了一定的灵活性。透明的储奶容器便于检查收集到的乳汁，而防回流设计以及保护盖或支架则使处理和储存更加便捷。紧凑的结构和可充电电池也非常适合白天、工作时或旅行期间吸奶。由于只有四个可拆卸部件，只要按照制造商的说明清洁所有接触乳汁的组件，组装和清洁应该相对简单。总体而言，这款可穿戴吸奶器拥有多项便捷功能，特别是其可调节设置、显示屏和免手持设计。然而，舒适度、出奶量和噪音水平因人而异，可穿戴吸奶器可能并不适用于所有人。正确的法兰尺寸对于舒适度和有效排乳至关重要，因此请仔细检查贴合度，并遵循制造商关于使用、清洁和消毒的指导。 advertised 电池续航时间也将取决于设置和使用频率。
review_summary: Paruu P20 穿戴式吸奶器为双支装，免手扶可置于哺乳内衣；有4种模式和12档吸力，LED显示模式、吸力、时间和奶量；含19/21/24mm三种喇叭罩，透明奶瓶、防回流及保护盖/支架；紧凑可充电，仅4个可拆卸部件，便于组装清洗。优点是调节、显示和免手扶设计；但舒适度、奶量和噪音因人而异，穿戴式吸奶器未必适合所有人，需选对喇叭罩，续航受设置和使用频率影响。

review_content: These are fantastic for the price. I used a Lansinoh pair and had to replace them because the milk would overflow if I wasn’t paying attention and the way they were made, the milk would soak into the buttons and they wouldn’t charge. I had to throw out 3 out if 4 of them because of this issue. The way the Paruu pumps are made, even if the milk overflows, it doesn’t soak into the buttons! I never had an issue with these in the last 5 months of me pumping. I had to pump exclusively, which is annoying enough, so having an effective pump is a game changer. These are also fast! I had them set on level 5 and I would fill them in 5 minutes. The other pumps I had sometimes took 20 minutes to fill. They aren’t painful, I think because the flange is longer/deeper so the suction isn’t so intense. Either way, they aren’t uncomfortable, but you may need to work your way up to the speed you like. The components feel a little thinner and cheaper, but that doesn’t affect my high opinion of these. Very easy to clean too. For the price, these are a huge win. I’d buy these again and again if I need to pump again. (Hopefully never haha)
review_content_ch:
超棒的吸奶器！！！不用再找了！
这个价格能买到这么棒的产品，太值了。我之前用过一对兰思诺的，不得不换掉，因为如果我不注意，奶就会溢出来，而且由于它们的设计，奶会渗进按键里导致无法充电。因为这个问题，我4个里不得不扔掉了3个。Paruu吸奶器的设计就不一样，就算奶溢出来，也不会渗进按键里！在过去5个月的吸奶过程中，我用这些从来没出过问题。我不得不完全靠吸奶器吸奶，这已经够烦人了，所以有一款高效的吸奶器简直是救星。而且吸奶速度也很快！我把它调到5档，5分钟就能吸满。我以前用的其他吸奶器有时要花20分钟才能吸满。用起来不疼，我觉得是因为法兰更长/更深，所以吸力没那么强烈。总之，用着不会不舒服，但你可能需要慢慢调到你喜欢的档位。配件摸起来感觉有点薄，显得稍微廉价些，但这并不影响我对它们的高度评价。清洗也非常方便。就这个价格而言，买到它们真是赚到了。如果以后还需要吸奶，我还会一次又一次地买它们。（希望永远不需要了，哈哈）

review_content: the overall quality is excellent. the pumps feel well made, assemble easily, and the milk collection containers are made from bpa free material and can be used for storing or freezing milk. everything fits neatly into the included carrying case, which is helpful when taking the pumps with me. the m9 is also impressively quiet. it is not completely silent, but the noise is low enough that i feel comfortable using it at work or around the house without drawing much attention. the pumps are fairly discreet under looser clothing, although they can be more noticeable under a fitted shirt. once positioned correctly, they stay in place well enough for light activities. the rechargeable battery provides enough power for several pumping sessions, and usb c charging is convenient. the app connectivity, portability, multiple settings, and hands free operation all add to the overall experience. the price is definitely higher than some basic breast pumps, but i think the quality and convenience make it a good value for someone who pumps frequently. being able to move around and continue with my normal routine while pumping is something i really appreciate. overall, this is a high quality, convenient, and thoughtfully designed breast pump. i would recommend the momcozy m9 to mothers who pump regularly and want more freedom and flexibility without giving up comfort or useful features
review_content_ch: 免提设计让吸奶变得轻松许多。整体质量非常出色。吸奶器做工精良，组装简便，集乳杯采用不含BPA的材料制成，可用于储存或冷冻母乳。所有配件都能整齐地放入附带的收纳包中，外出携带吸奶器时非常方便。M9的静音效果也令人印象深刻。它并非完全无声，但噪音足够低，让我在办公室或家里使用时感觉很自在，不会引起太多注意。在宽松的衣服下，吸奶器相当隐蔽，不过在紧身衬衫下可能会明显一些。一旦正确佩戴，它们在进行轻度活动时也能很好地固定原位。可充电电池提供足够的电量，可支持多次吸奶，USB-C充电也很方便。APP连接、便携性、多种模式以及免提操作都提升了整体体验。价格确实比一些基础款吸奶器高，但我认为其品质和便利性使其对经常吸奶的人来说物有所值。能够在吸奶时自由活动并继续日常事务，这一点让我非常满意。总而言之，这是一款高品质、便捷且设计贴心的吸奶器。我会向经常吸奶、想要更多自由和灵活性，同时又不牺牲舒适度或实用功能的妈妈们推荐这款 Momcozy M9。

review_content: Yeah this design really baffles me. It works for pumping, I guess, but I'd cannot and would not wear it outside that purpose. Here's the thing: where the inner fabric section meets the outer fold fabric, there's a tight elastic seam line and presses right into my nipple vertically. I've tried adjusting it, but I always end up with a tight, uncomfortable elastic band pressing into me, which also distorts the visual shape of my boob. Think like, the cut line on the top of a loaf of bread. Now, I do have size G boobs during nursing. Maybe this bra works better for someone with a smaller chest. But then, after washing, the bra's other elastic now folds over on itself and doesn't lay flat. Ugh. I regret this purchase sadly!
review_content_ch:
对我来说是大大的不。
是啊，这个设计真让我困惑。它用来吸奶器吸奶，我想，但我不能也不愿意为了那个目的之外穿它。问题是：内层面料和外层折叠面料的接缝处有一条紧的弹力缝线，垂直地压在我的乳头上。我试过调整，但最终总有一条紧而难受的弹力带压着我，还破坏了我胸部的视觉形状。就像面包顶部的那道切痕。另外，我在哺乳期间有G罩杯的胸部。也许这款文胸对胸部较小的人效果更好。但洗过之后，文胸的其他弹力带现在自己卷起来，不平整。唉，我后悔这次购买了，真遗憾！
review_summary: 该哺乳内衣设计存在缺陷：内层与外层面料接缝处的弹性线垂直压迫乳头，造成不适且使乳房形状扭曲（如面包顶部切痕）；洗涤后弹性部分折叠不平。用户为G罩杯，认为可能只适合小胸人群，后悔购买。

review_content: I purchased this in hopes to use for overnight pumps, when I'm away from home and busy, and when I return to work. I used this for less than a month and the motor went bad. Thankfully I purchased the additional coverage for if something happened. I filed my claim but because it was still under the manufacturer warranty I had to go through momcozy. I Had sent an email with the requested photos and videos. It took them 3 days to respond to that email with links to the same troubleshooting I had already done. I sent them more images an requested they replace the pump promptly, again another 2 and a half days go by before I get a response. When I see the response they offer to replace it with lesser value pumps (not even offering to replace with the one I have) or a refund. Due to delays I had to spend more money and buy a completely different pump because I couldn't go without a wearable pump over the busy weekend. Do Not purchase this product you will eventually be disappointed. Sadly I absolutely loved this pump in the beginning. Spend the money and get a nice quality wearable pump....this is not it.
review_content_ch:
千万别买……以我的教训为戒
我买这个，是希望能在夜间吸奶时用、在我离家在外又很忙的时候用，以及回去上班时用。我用了不到一个月，马达就坏了。还好我买了额外保障，以防万一出什么事。我提交了理赔申请，但因为还在厂家保修期内，我不得不走 momcozy 的流程。我按他们的要求发了一封附上照片和视频的邮件。他们过了 3 天才回复那封邮件，而且发来的还是我已经做过的那些故障排查链接。我又发了更多图片，并要求他们尽快更换吸奶器，结果又过了两天半我才收到回复。我看到回复里，他们提出给我换成价值更低的吸奶器（甚至都不是换成我这款），或者退款。由于这些拖延，我不得不花更多钱买了一台完全不同的吸奶器，因为那个忙碌的周末我不能没有可穿戴吸奶器。别买这个产品，你最终会失望的。遗憾的是，我一开始真的特别喜欢这款吸奶器。花钱买一台品质好的可穿戴吸奶器吧……这款不是。

review_content: Después de probar varios sacaleches, este modelo de Momcozy me ha parecido de los más cómodos para el día a día. Al ser manos libres, permite moverte con bastante libertad mientras realiza la extracción, algo que se agradece mucho cuando tienes mil cosas que hacer.Se conecta fácilmente al móvil mediante una aplicación desde la que puedes controlar los modos y la intensidad, aunque también se puede manejar directamente desde el propio dispositivo. Tiene diferentes programas y 15 niveles de succión, así que es fácil encontrar la configuración que te resulte más cómoda.Por otro lado, es súper silencioso. Comparado con otros modelos que he probado, hace bastante menos ruido y se puede usar con discreción. La batería también da para varios usos sin necesidad de estar cargándolo constantemente.Además, se adapta bien al sujetador y resulta cómodo de llevar. Los recipientes incluidos vienen muy bien para almacenar la leche y las tapas ayudan a conservarla de forma segura. Lo que menos me gusta es la limpieza, porque hay que desmontar varias piezas después de cada uso, aunque una vez le coges el truco se hace bastante rápido.En general, me ha parecido una opción muy práctica para hacer más llevaderas las extracciones y ganar algo de comodidad en el día a día.
review_content_ch:
安静、实用且易于使用

通过手机应用可以轻松连接并控制模式和吸力强度，不过也能直接在设备上操作。它提供多种程序和15档吸力调节，因此很容易找到最适合自己的舒适设置。

review_content: Ho avuto una bambina da pochi mesi e se c’è una cosa che sto usando davvero tantissimo è il tiralatte, non mi limito ad usarne uno solo ma alterno diversi modelli ed i miei preferiti sono i Momcozy.Chi chi me usa il tiralatte in maniera intensa per fare una bella scorta di latte ed allo stesso tempo ci tiene che il tiralatte sia sempre ben pulito e sterilizzato sa benissimo che dovrebbe praticamente passare tutta la giornata a tirare il latte per poi pulire, lavare e sterilizzarle il tiralatte di continuo e questo ovviamente con un solo tiralatte diventa impossibile. Da qui la necessità di averne diversi a disposizione. Questo è un tiralatte singolo, quindi lo utilizzo insieme ad un altro tiralatte singolo della stessa marca perché preferisco ottimizzare i tempi. È un modello ottimo, di fascia alta, che svolge il proprio dovere in modo eccellente e risulta molto confortevole una volta indossato.Vorrei precisare una cosa, per quanto riguarda la mia esperienza personale per quanto un tiralatte possa essere pubblicizzato come piccolo, discreto e invisibile non potrà mai essere indossato senza che si veda che lo si indossa. Ci sono persone a cui non importa assolutamente nulla e persone un po’ più pudiche ed è bene che entrambe sappiano che per quanto il singolo tiralatte possa essere piccolo e anatomico non sarà mai invisibile all’interno del reggiseno.Detto questo torno a parlare del modello in questione. La modalità di suzione è molto buona, il display mostra chiaramente da quanto è in funzione il tira latte e questo è molto utile durante il Power Pumping, dove si rispettano alcuni tempi precisi.È molto importante per ogni donna che si approccia ad un tiralatte, capire che il corretto utilizzo è garantito dalla scelta della flangia più adatta alla propria conformazione fisica. In questa confezione ne vengono fornite diverse misure che dovrebbero adattarsi più o meno tutte le fisicità ma la cosa più importante con contenuta all’interno della confezione è il cartoncino per misurare l’ampiezza del proprio capezzolo e quindi scegliere la flangia più adatta. Solo per questo “optional” questo tiralatte guadagna una stella in più da parte mia. È bene che il capezzolo sia libero di muoversi all’interno della flangia e che quest’ultima non sia troppo stretta o troppo larga, perché altrimenti la funzione del tiralatte viene inevitabilmente compromessa.In conclusione Momcozy per me resta sempre una garanzia e finora non ho trovato alcun brand che lo superasse!
review_content_ch:
Momcozy总是很出色！
我几个月前生了一个女儿，如果说有什么东西是我用得最多的，那就是吸奶器。我不只用一个，而是交替使用不同型号，我最喜欢的是Momcozy。
任何像我一样经常使用吸奶器来储备母乳，同时又希望吸奶器始终保持清洁和消毒的人，都很清楚自己几乎要整天不停地吸奶，然后不断清洁、清洗和消毒吸奶器，而只有一个吸奶器显然是不可能的。
因此就需要同时拥有多个吸奶器。
这是一个单边吸奶器，所以我搭配另一个同品牌的单边吸奶器一起使用，因为我喜欢优化时间。
这是一款优秀的高端型号，它出色地完成了自己的任务，佩戴起来也非常舒适。
我想说明一点，根据我的个人经验，无论吸奶器被宣传得多么小巧、隐蔽和隐形，它都不可能被佩戴而不被察觉。
有些人完全不在意，有些人则比较害羞，双方都应该知道，即使单边吸奶器再小巧、再贴合人体工学，也不可能在文胸内完全隐形。
说完这些，我回到这款型号本身。
吸乳模式非常好，显示屏清晰显示吸奶器已运行的时间，这在Power Pumping（密集吸奶）时非常有用，因为需要遵循精确的时间安排。
对于每个使用吸奶器的女性来说，理解正确使用取决于选择最适合自己身体构造的吸乳护罩，这一点非常重要。
这个包装中提供了多种尺寸，应该能适应大多数体型，但包装内最重要的东西是测量乳头直径的卡片，以便选择最合适的吸乳护罩。
仅仅因为这个“附件”，这款吸奶器就赢得了我的额外一颗星。
乳头应该在吸乳护罩内自由移动，护罩既不能太紧也不能太松，否则吸奶器的功能必然会受到影响。
总之，对我来说Momcozy始终是一个保证，到目前为止我还没有找到任何品牌能超越它！

Se siete alla ricerca di un tiralatte elettrico ed automatico, utilizzabile da app, semplice da regolare, silenzioso e comodo da indossare allora siete nel posto giusto.

🚀 🚀RESA🚀 🚀

review_content: La lactancia y la vuelta al trabajo o el ritmo diario pueden ser muy difíciles de compaginar. Este extractor de leche manos libres Momcozy S9 Pro cambia las reglas del juego por completo. Pasar de estar "atada" a un enchufe con un sacaleches tradicional a poder moverte libremente por casa no tiene precio.A continuación, detallo mis conclusiones tras analizar su rendimiento y usabilidad:Lo que más me ha gustado:Diseño manos libres real: Te lo colocas dentro del sujetador de lactancia y te olvidas. Puedes cocinar, trabajar frente al ordenador o recoger la casa mientras funciona. No sobresale de forma exagerada y te da una autonomía brutal.Potencia de succión eficiente: Cuenta con 2 modos (estimulación y expresión) y 9 niveles de intensidad. La succión es suave pero muy efectiva; vacía el pecho tan rápido como los extractores tradicionales de hospital gracias a su motor optimizado.Pantalla LED muy útil: La pantalla superior te muestra de manera clara el modo que estás usando, el nivel de intensidad y el estado de la batería. Además, tiene función de memoria para empezar siempre en tu configuración favorita.Batería mejorada (Pro): La autonomía es excelente. Con una sola carga completa da perfectamente para 5 o 6 sesiones de unos 20 minutos, lo que te permite pasar todo el día fuera de casa sin preocuparte por los enchufes. Se carga mediante cable USB-C.Kit de medición de pezón incluido: Un gran acierto de Momcozy. Usar la copa del tamaño incorrecto es la causa número uno de dolor y baja producción. Que incluyan la regla de medición de silicona y diferentes adaptadores de embudo asegura que encuentres tu ajuste perfecto desde el primer día.A tener en cuenta:Limpieza meticulosa: Como cualquier sacaleches, consta de varias piezas de silicona y plástico que deben desmontarse, lavarse y esterilizarse después de cada uso (excepto el motor, lógicamente). Al principio puede dar pereza, pero es muy intuitivo de montar y desmontar una vez que le pillas el truco.Cuidado al verter la leche: Para pasar la leche extraída del depósito al biberón o bolsa de almacenamiento hay que tener un poco de cuidado y hacerlo despacio por el orificio superior para evitar derramar gotas valiosas.Conclusión:Un sacaleches fantástico que regala tiempo y libertad a las madres. Es eficiente, silencioso (hace un zumbido muy discreto que no despierta al bebé), tiene una batería magnífica y cuida la salud del pecho gracias a sus múltiples niveles de ajuste. Una inversión en comodidad 100% amortizada desde el primer día.
review_content_ch:
日常生活的绝对自由：出色的吸力、持久的电池和非常舒适
母乳喂养和重返工作或日常生活节奏可能很难兼顾。这款Momcozy S9 Pro免手扶吸奶器彻底改变了游戏规则。从被传统吸奶器“拴在”插座上，到可以在家里自由移动，这是无价的。
下面，我详细说明在分析其性能和可用性后的结论：
我最喜欢的地方：
真正的免手扶设计：你把它放在哺乳文胸里面，然后就可以忘了它。你可以一边工作一边做饭、在电脑前工作或收拾屋子。它不会过分突出，给你极大的自由度。
高效的吸力：它有2种模式（刺激和吸乳）和9个强度级别。吸力柔和但非常有效；由于其优化的电机，它像传统医院吸奶器一样快速排空乳房。
非常有用的LED屏幕：顶部的屏幕清晰地显示你正在使用的模式、强度级别和电池状态。此外，它还有记忆功能，可以始终从你喜欢的设置开始。
升级版电池（Pro）：续航能力极佳。充满一次电完全可以满足5到6次约20分钟的吸乳，让你整天在外也不用担心插座。通过USB-C线充电。
包含乳头测量工具：Momcozy的一个巨大成功。使用错误尺寸的喇叭罩是导致疼痛和产量低的第一大原因。他们包含硅胶测量尺和不同的漏斗适配器，确保你从第一天起就能找到完美贴合。
需要注意：
细致的清洁：像任何吸奶器一样，它由多个硅胶和塑料部件组成，每次使用后都需要拆卸、清洗和消毒（当然，电机除外）。一开始可能会觉得麻烦，但一旦掌握窍门，安装和拆卸都非常直观。
倒奶时要小心：要从储奶器中把吸出的奶转移到奶瓶或储奶袋时，需要小心一点，从顶部开口慢慢倒，以免洒出宝贵的奶滴。
结论：
一款极好的吸奶器，为妈妈们带来时间和自由。它高效、安静（发出非常轻微的嗡嗡声，不会吵醒宝宝），电池出色，并且通过多个调节档位呵护乳房健康。从第一天起就完全值得的舒适投资。
review_summary: 优点：真正解放双手，可自由活动；吸力高效，2种模式9档强度，排空快；LED屏幕清晰显示模式、档位和电量，有记忆功能；电池续航优秀，一次充电可进行5-6次20分钟吸乳；附带乳头测量尺和不同尺寸喇叭罩，避免疼痛和产量低。缺点：部件多，需每次拆洗消毒，初用时麻烦；倒奶时需小心避免洒漏。

review_content: This M9 breast pump comes neatly presented with a hard storage case for carrying around in a hygienic way.  The pumping unit itself comes from a reputable brand in MomCozy, which is a top performing brand in the field and this product certainly lives up to expectations.  It comes as a very discreet piece and despite having the cozy red colour mildly blended into the unit, one of the best features is how impressively quiet the operation is, to the point that you have your hands free, and no-one will know you’re pumping without you telling them.  Out of the box, the product is easy to setup, with a simple flange size selection (following the instructions provided), and then putting into position.  The rest of the controls are from the mobile app, which the device pairs up with easily and this allows you to easily control the power level and extraction method, to find your optimal level of comfort balance.  You can choose between simulating a baby sucking or stimulating a further supply chain of milk here (or even a mix of both) in different pulsating motions.  The milk extracted is stored directly in the unit and can remain there or be transferred for better long-term storage if required.  The unit itself is powered on an integrated battery that gives a full day of power to it, which is more than suffice for multiple pumping cycles and when required, it can easily be recharged on a provided USB-C cable.  When you’re finished using the device, you can wash it down or sterilise most of the components, before putting it away for next usage.  Despite its hefty price tag, it’s certainly a top performing breast pump here and I’d have no hesitation in recommending this accordingly.
review_content_ch:
强劲的吸奶主机
这款M9吸奶器包装精美，附带一个硬质收纳盒，便于卫生携带。吸奶主机本身来自知名品牌MomCozy，该品牌在该领域表现卓越，这款产品也确实不负众望。它设计得非常隐蔽，尽管主机上融入了温和的舒适红色，但最好的特点之一是其运行非常安静，以至于你可以解放双手，而且如果不告诉别人，没人会知道你在吸奶。开箱后，产品很容易设置，只需按照说明简单选择法兰尺寸，然后安装到位。其余控制通过手机应用进行，设备与手机轻松配对，让你可以轻松控制吸力强度和吸乳模式，找到最适合自己的舒适平衡点。你可以选择模拟宝宝吸吮或刺激进一步泌乳（甚至两者混合），通过不同的脉动模式。吸出的乳汁直接储存在主机中，可以留在那里，或者如果需要更好的长期储存，可以转移出来。主机由内置电池供电，可支持一整天的使用，足以满足多次吸乳循环，需要时可以通过附带的USB-C数据线轻松充电。使用完毕后，你可以清洗或消毒大部分部件，然后收好以备下次使用。尽管价格不菲，但这无疑是一款性能卓越的吸奶器，我毫不犹豫地推荐它。

review_content: Für die nächtlichen Abpump Einheiten wollte meine Partnerin nicht jedes Mal das helle Deckenlicht anschalten müssen, eine freihändige Milchpumpe mit eingebautem Nachtlicht sollte dafür genau die richtige Ergänzung sein.Das eingebaute Licht ist tatsächlich so schwach gehalten, dass es beim nächtlichen Abpumpen nicht aus dem Schlaf reißt, gleichzeitig aber hell genug, um den Füllstand im Behälter noch zu erkennen. review_content: I’ve been using the Momcozy M9 wearable breast pump as a hands-free option around the house, and it feels like a very well-made, premium set. The pumps are fairly lightweight in use and sit comfortably enough once positioned properly, so it is much easier to get on with small jobs rather than being stuck in one place with a traditional pump. The suction feels consistent, and I like that there are plenty of modes and levels to adjust rather than being locked into one basic setting. It is also quieter than I expected, which makes it feel more discreet and less intrusive during regular use. The app control is a nice extra because it lets me change settings and keep track without constantly fiddling with the pumps themselves, although it does take a little getting used to at first. Cleaning and assembly are straightforward once you know how everything fits together, and the carry case is useful for keeping the parts organised. The biggest downside is the price, as this is a serious investment compared with simpler wearable pumps, and I think that will be the deciding factor for most people. Overall, it is a smart, comfortable and convenient pump with strong performance, but the cost keeps it from being an automatic five stars for me.

review_content:
Coming from the original M5 means this review comes with proper context rather than a first impression. The baseline was already high — reliable, comfortable, effective — and that's the standard the Smart version needs to meet before the app upgrade even becomes the conversation. It meets it, which means the app is genuinely additive rather than compensating for something that regressed elsewhere. The app upgrade sounds like a convenience feature until you're mid-session with one hand occupied and the pump needs adjusting. The physical button sequence on the original — holding the pump steady with one hand, cycling through modes with the other, trying to remember which combination does what — is manageable but not elegant. Opening the app and tapping a setting with one free finger while everything else continues undisturbed is a different experience entirely. Not revolutionary, just noticeably better in the specific moments that count.
Suction levels, pumping modes, pulse settings all accessible without touching the pump — for anyone who's developed preferences through extended use the ability to fine-tune without interruption is a meaningful quality of life improvement. The app working reliably rather than dropping connection or requiring constant pairing is the baseline that makes it actually useful rather than theoretically useful. Two pumps in the set remains the practical decision that changes the daily routine. No waiting, no scheduling around a single unit, just both available whenever needed — the same advantage the M5 two-pack offered and the Smart version continues.
review_content_ch:
M5原本就很出色——配套应用让它更上一层楼 作为原版M5的用户，这篇评测基于充分的使用经验而非初次印象。它的基础表现已经很高——可靠、舒适、高效——这正是智能版在应用升级成为讨论点之前需要达到的标准。它做到了，这意味着应用是真正的增值功能，而非用来弥补其他方面的退步。应用升级听起来像是便利功能，直到你单手持握吸奶器需要调节时才会体会其价值。原版的物理按键操作——一手稳住吸奶器，另一手切换模式，还要记住组合键功能——虽能应付但不够优雅。而用空闲手指打开应用轻点设置，同时其他操作不受干扰，则是完全不同的体验。虽非革命性改变，但在关键时刻明显更优。
吸力级别、吸乳模式、脉冲设置均可通过应用调节——对于长期使用形成偏好的用户，无中断的微调能力显著提升了使用体验。应用连接稳定不掉线、无需反复配对，这些基础要求才使其真正有用而非纸上谈兵。套装保留双吸奶器设计依然是改变日常流程的实用决策。无需等待，不用围绕单个设备安排时间，随时取用——这正是M5双装版的优势，智能版延续了这一优点。
review_summary: 用户从M5升级到Smart版本，认为原版已经可靠、舒适、有效。Smart版本最重要的改进是app控制，可以在不接触泵体的情况下单手调节吸力、模式和脉动设置，连接稳定，显著提升了使用便捷性。双泵套装设计延续了实用优势，无需等待即可交替使用。

review_content: Die tragbare Milchpumpe ist vor allem dann angenehm, wenn man nicht jedes Mal komplett an einen festen Platz gebunden sein möchte. Gerade mit Baby im Haus passiert ja selten alles nach Plan, und genau da ist es schön, wenn man nebenbei noch ein bisschen Bewegungsfreiheit hat. Das Einsetzen in den BH klappt nach etwas Übung gut, wobei man am Anfang schon kurz sortieren muss, wie alles richtig sitzt. Wenn sie sauber positioniert ist, pumpt sie bei mir zuverlässig und deutlich entspannter als dieses klassische Sitzen mit Kabelsalat und leichtem Robotergefühl. Die verschiedenen Stufen finde ich hilfreich, weil man sich langsam herantasten kann und nicht direkt das Gefühl hat, die Technik übernimmt das Kommando. Die App-Steuerung ist nett, aber für mich eher Zusatz als Muss. Die Reinigung braucht natürlich etwas Zeit, da mehrere Teile ausgespült werden müssen, aber das ist bei Milchpumpen eben normal. Lautlos ist sie nicht, aber auch nicht so laut, dass gleich das ganze Haus aufmerksam wird. Für mich eine angenehme Erleichterung, wenn man flexibel bleiben möchte.
review_content_ch:
更自由、更少线缆困扰的吸奶体验
便携式吸奶器最大的优点在于不必每次都固定在一个地方使用。尤其家里有宝宝时，事情很少按计划进行，这时能保持一定的活动自由就非常贴心。经过几次练习后，穿戴进文胸的操作就很顺畅了，虽然刚开始需要稍微调整确保各部件位置正确。当正确就位后，对我来说它的吸乳过程可靠且明显比那种传统坐着、线缆缠绕还带点机械感的体验更放松。多档位设计很实用，可以循序渐进地适应，不会突然有被科技支配的感觉。APP控制算锦上添花，但对我来说非必需。清洁自然需要些时间，因为要冲洗多个部件，不过这对吸奶器来说很正常。它并非完全静音，但也不至于吵得全家都注意到。对于想保持灵活性的我来说，这是个舒适的解决方案。
review_summary: 便携吸奶器优点：可移动、不束缚，放入文胸后经练习可稳定使用，比传统有线吸奶器更放松；有多档可调。缺点：初次使用需练习正确放置；清洗部件多较耗时；非静音但噪音不大。App控制为附加功能。总体适合追求灵活性的用户。

review_content: Das Milchpumpenset kommt in einem neutralen und schlichten Design daher. Praktisch vollständig in Weiß und Transparent gehalten. Das schaut nicht nur schick und sauber aus, sondern ist auch unauffällig. Ich benutze die Milchpumpe nicht nur in den eigenen vier Wänden, sondern gelegentlich auch unterwegs oder auf der Arbeit. Vor allem im Urlaub kommt man nicht Drumherum, die Milchpumpe im Gepäck mitzunehmen. Es ist zwar gesellschaftlich häufig akzeptiert, die Milchpumpe auch diskret in der Öffentlichkeit, etwa im Park, zu nutzen, doch die Privatsphäre ist mir nach wie vor trotzdem sehr wichtig. Da das Milchpumpenset farblich eher zurücksteckt, schafft es hierdurch ein Gefühl der Sicherheit. Das war mir sehr wichtig.Die Milchpumpe ist jedoch nicht nur aufgrund ihrer Farben recht diskret, sondern ist ebenfalls während der Nutzung nicht auffällig. Doch der Reihe nach. Die Nutzung der Milchpumpe ist relativ simpel. Man legt die Milchpumpen wahlweise an eine oder zwei Brüste an und schaltet sie an. Hierbei werden diese an die Brüste herangesaugt durch einen Unterdruck, was die Milchpumpen auch ohne zusätzliches Festhalten zuverlässig in der Position hält. Dann beginnt das sanfte Abpumpen der Milch. Man spürt zwar, dass die Milchpumpen arbeiten, doch sie sind recht sanft und üben keinen unangenehmen Druck aus. Dabei sind die Milchpumpen verhältnismäßig leise. Wenn man genau hinhört, bekommt man es zwar mit, doch ich habe mich auch schon dabei erwischt, wie ich während der Nutzung der Milchpumpen eingeschlafen bin. Ich war positiv überrascht!Die Milchpumpen stechen zwar während der Nutzung heraus, doch aufgrund ihrer Form und durch den Umstand, dass sie sich den Brüsten anschmiegen, sind sie eigentlich unscheinbar. Man kann sie prima unter einer Jeansjacke verstecken und auch ohne weite Kleidung sind sie meist erst wahrnehmbar, wenn man genau hinschaut.Die Verarbeitungsqualität ist hervorragend. Ich nutze öfter Produkte von Momcozy und wurde auch dieses Mal nicht enttäuscht. Das Design ist intelligent, das Produkt ist leicht zu bedienen und im Zweifel ist auch eine sehr gute Bedienungsanleitung dabei. Der Absaugprozess ist sanft, leise und angenehm. Die Milch wird zum Abschluss im integrierten Auffangbehälter gesammelt und kann dann von dort aus direkt umgefüllt werden. Die Hygiene wird ebenfalls gewahrt, da die Milchpumpe zu großen Teilen zerlegbar und leicht zu reinigen ist. Ich empfehle hier die Reinigung mit der Hand mit der weichen Seite des Schwamms und warmen Spülwasser, doch das ist wohl Geschmackssache.Unterm Strich bin ich super happy mit den Milchpumpen und kann diese uneingeschränkt empfehlen. Gerne wieder!
review_content_ch:
这款吸奶器套装太棒了，安静、低调、使用舒适、易于清洁，超级赞！
吸奶器套装采用中性简约的设计，几乎全白透明，不仅看起来时尚干净，而且不引人注目。我不仅在家里使用吸奶器，偶尔也会在外出或工作时使用。尤其是度假时，不得不把吸奶器装进行李。虽然社会上通常可以接受在公共场所（比如公园）低调使用吸奶器，但我仍然非常重视隐私。由于吸奶器套装颜色低调，营造了一种安全感，这对我来说非常重要。
吸奶器不仅颜色低调，使用时也不显眼。使用起来相对简单：将吸奶器贴在一侧或两侧乳房上，开启后通过负压吸附，无需额外固定就能可靠保持位置。然后开始轻柔地吸乳。虽然能感觉到吸奶器在工作，但相当温和，不会产生不适的压力。同时吸奶器相对安静，仔细听才能察觉，我甚至在使用时睡着了，真是惊喜！
虽然使用时吸奶器会突出，但由于其形状贴合乳房，实际上并不显眼。可以轻松藏在牛仔夹克下，即使不穿宽松衣服，不仔细看也很难注意到。
产品质量出色。我经常使用Momcozy的产品，这次也没让我失望。设计智能，操作简便，还配有非常详细的说明书。吸乳过程轻柔、安静、舒适。最后乳汁会收集在集成容器中，可直接倒出。卫生也有保障，因为吸奶器大部分可拆卸且易于清洁。我建议用海绵软面和温水手洗，但这可能因人而异。

review_content: I received this wearable breast pump through a product review programme, and this review reflects my own genuine experience. I was genuinely impressed by the overall quality of the pump. The materials feel premium, and the DoubleFit flange is soft, comfortable and sits securely, making pumping much more comfortable than I expected. The wearable design fits discreetly inside a nursing bra, allowing much greater freedom to move around while pumping.The suction is strong yet comfortable, with plenty of adjustment levels to find the setting that works best. The app is straightforward to use and makes it easy to switch modes, adjust settings and keep track of pumping sessions. It's also pleasantly quiet, making it much less noticeable during use. Cleaning is simple thanks to the small number of parts, and the battery comfortably lasts through a full day of regular use. My only minor observation is that there are quite a few custom settings to explore at first, but once familiar with them, the pump is easy to use. Overall, it's an excellent-quality, comfortable and thoughtfully designed breast pump that performs brilliantly.

review_content: Un imprescindible para las mamás lactantes que no quieren vivir atadas a un cable ni a un aparato enorme haciendo ruido en la mesita de noche. Este sacaleches Momcozy modelo S12 Pro Quick es una de las mejores inversiones que se pueden hacer. Está pensado para llevarlo metido directamente dentro del sujetador de lactancia, lo que te devuelve la vida y las manos para poder teletrabajar, hacer cosas por casa o simplemente sentarte a descansar tranquila.Lo que más me ha gustado de su funcionamiento es la brida híbrida DoubleFit™️ de 24 mm, que combina una silicona muy blanda en los bordes con una estructura más firme en el centro para que se selle perfectamente al pecho. No se mueve nada, no tiene fugas de leche aunque te agaches un poco y, sobre todo, reduce muchísimo las molestias en el pezón. Tiene 3 modos (masaje, extracción y uno mixto que combina ambos) y 9 niveles de intensidad, así que puedes adaptarlo perfectamente a tu sensibilidad en la zona. La pantalla inteligente de la parte superior viene genial para ver de un vistazo el tiempo que llevas de sesión y la batería que le queda.Si lo comparamos con otro modelo muy conocido de la marca, el Momcozy M5 por ejemplo, la diferencia es clara ya que el M5 gana en discreción porque tiene forma de gota y queda totalmente plano bajo la ropa, pero este S12 Pro Quick le gana de calle en potencia de succión y rapidez. Si lo que buscas es una extracción rápida el S12 Pro es mucho más práctico.Se nota que los materiales son de calidad, se desmonta en un momento y limpiarlo no da nada de pereza porque no tiene mil piezas inaccesibles. Es una inversión que vale la pena hacer.
review_content_ch: 如果你追求舒适，这款产品很理想。对于不想被电源线束缚、也不想在床头柜上放一个巨大噪音机器的哺乳妈妈来说，这是必备品。这款Momcozy S12 Pro Quick吸奶器是你所能做出的最佳投资之一。它被设计为直接放入哺乳文胸内，让你重获自由和双手，可以远程办公、做家务或者只是安静地坐下来休息。它的功能中我最喜欢的是24毫米的DoubleFit™️混合法兰，边缘采用非常柔软的硅胶，中心结构更坚固，能完美贴合胸部。完全不会移动，即使稍微弯腰也不漏奶，最重要的是，大大减少了乳头不适。它有3种模式（按摩、吸乳以及两者结合的组合模式）和9个强度级别，因此你可以根据该区域的敏感度完美调整。顶部的智能屏幕非常方便，可以一目了然地看到当前使用时长和剩余电量。如果将它与该品牌的另一个知名型号（例如Momcozy M5）进行比较，区别很明显：M5在隐蔽性方面胜出，因为它采用水滴形设计，在衣服下完全平坦，但这款S12 Pro Quick在吸力和速度方面明显胜出。如果你追求快速吸乳，S12 Pro实用得多。可以感受到材料质量上乘，拆卸方便，清洗也不费劲，因为没有什么难以触及的零件。这是一项值得的投资。
review_summary: 用户高度评价Momcozy S12 Pro Quick吸奶器，称赞其舒适、解放双手，适合哺乳妈妈。最满意的是24mm DoubleFit™混合法兰，柔软边缘搭配稳固中心，密封好无泄漏且减少乳头不适。具备3种模式9级强度，智能屏幕显示时间和电量。与M5相比，吸力更强、速度更快，但M5更隐蔽。材质质量好，易拆卸清洁。

The only slight drawback is that finding the ideal mode and suction level may take a little experimentation at first.Rather than overcomplicating things, this pump focuses on comfort, flexibility and practicality.
