review_content: As an exclusive pumper, this is my primary pump.After 3 months of use:I wish I’d have bought the 360 Willow Go leakproof pump instead. I can’t bend over AT ALL while pumping, even a slight lean and the milk just spills out. This thing leaks too much to leave a good review but is convenient enough to not leave a bad review.After 3 months, the seal at the bottom of one of the pumps consistently leaks milk under the unit into my bra and shirts. A continuous drip leak, even though I’ve triple checked I’ve got it sealed as best as it will go. This started a week ago, so I have to assume the unit is just wearing out after such a short time of regular use.I do love that its hands free, as opposed to my spectra gold wall unit, that requires a special pumping bra and I’m stuck at the table pumping, this allows me to use regular nursing bras and can move about as long as I don’t lean forward. The suction is pretty good, I am emptied well. I have packed the wall pump away because the hands free one is just as good and has too many perks to attach myself to the wall every 2 hours.If it didn’t leak every time I use with either bending forward or just on its own, this would be a 5 star purchase. Go check out the Willow Go 360 if you’re an exclusive pumper.
review_content_ch:
还行但会漏奶
作为全职吸奶用户，这是我的主力吸奶器。使用3个月后：真该买防漏的360 Willow Go吸奶器。吸奶时完全不能弯腰，稍微前倾乳汁就会漏出。漏奶严重到没法给好评，但便利性又够不上差评。三个月后，其中一个吸奶器底部的密封圈持续漏奶，乳汁会渗到机器下方弄脏内衣和上衣。即便反复确认已密封到位，仍持续滴漏。这情况一周前开始，我只能认为机器在常规使用这么短时间后就老化了。

确实喜欢它的免手持设计，相比需要专用吸奶文胸、必须固定在桌上使用的Spectra Gold壁挂式机型，这款能用普通哺乳文胸，只要不前倾就能自由活动。吸力相当不错，排空效果很好。我已收起了壁挂式，因为免手持款同样高效，且每两小时不必固定在墙上的优势太多。

如果不是每次使用都会因前倾或自发漏奶，本可以打五星。全职吸奶用户建议去看看Willow Go 360款。
review_summary: 吸奶器使用三个月后出现底部密封不严导致漏奶问题，即使轻微前倾也会漏奶。优点是无需专用哺乳文胸且吸力足够，但频繁漏奶影响使用体验。

review_content_ch:
使用效果出色
这款Momcozy M5智能APP控制免手扶吸奶器双包装是新妈妈们的多功能选择。我们选择Momcozy的原因之一是其双泵设计易于使用——配合升级版"MOMCOZY"应用，我的儿媳可以轻松追踪奶量、调节吸力级别和模式，在单侧/双侧吸乳模式间切换，所有操作都能通过手机完成。吸奶器轻量化设计（单只230克）提升舒适度，符合人体工学的造型能自然贴合身体曲线。

虽然吸乳过程辛苦，但SPA级泌乳技术（即"婴儿口腔"模拟）使吸乳动作接近宝宝自然衔乳。儿媳使用这套系统效果很好，完全没有疼痛或不适感。提供3种模式（刺激/泌乳/混合模式）和9档吸力（最大负压280mmHg），还能记忆"偏好设置"——当您熟悉自身泌乳规律后这个功能特别实用。

作为D罩杯用户，儿媳直接选用了24mm尺寸。开箱时附赠测量尺，我还找到了Momcozy的测量指南照片一并附上。采用食品级BPA-Free硅胶材质。套装包含：便携收纳盒、使用手册、快速指南，享1年质保。

这套双包装是Momcozy品牌特有的'温馨红'配色（实际为暖调灰粉色），主机身为白色。每只吸奶器做工精良，边缘圆润无毛刺。

作为18年前生育最后一胎的老一辈妈妈，我必须说现在的吸奶器在贴合度、操作便利性和智能记录功能方面简直是跨时代进步！仅需清洗4个部件，对我的儿媳非常适用——这才是真正需要的产品！
review_summary: 用户称赞这款吸奶器易用、轻便（230g）、人体工学设计贴合；配套App可追踪奶量、调节模式和单/双边切换；SPA泌乳模式模拟婴儿吮吸，无痛感；3种模式9档强度，有偏好记忆；BPA-free食品级硅胶，清洁方便，做工精良。儿媳使用效果很好。

review_content: The Momcozy S9 Pro Hands-Free Wearable Breast Pump is generally reviewed as a strong mid-range option for mums who want portability and hands-free pumping without stepping into the higher price tiers. Users frequently praise the compact, discreet design, noting it sits comfortably inside a bra and is noticeably smaller than older wearable pumps, making it practical for work, travel, or multitasking at home. The LED display and simple button controls are often highlighted as an improvement over earlier models, and many reviewers appreciate the 2 modes and 9 suction levels, which allow decent personalisation for comfort and milk expression. The battery life also gets positive mention, with most users finding the around 2–3 hour runtime per charge (several sessions) genuinely useful for a full day away from a socket.On performance, feedback is mostly positive but not perfect. Many users report good suction and reliable milk output, especially when the flange size is correctly fitted, and they like the leak-resistant design when assembled properly. However, some reviews mention a learning curve with positioning and sealing, and a few users feel the suction, while strong enough for regular use, is not quite as powerful as larger hospital-grade or plug-in pumps. Cleaning is described as manageable but slightly fiddly due to multiple small parts. Overall, it’s commonly reviewed as a convenient, portable solution for everyday pumping, best suited to mums prioritising mobility and convenience over maximum extraction power.
review_content_ch:
出色的品牌
Momcozy S9 Pro免提穿戴式吸奶器被普遍评价为是一款不错的中档选择，适合那些想要便携和免提吸奶但又不想进入更高价格区间的妈妈们。用户经常称赞其紧凑、隐蔽的设计，指出它能舒适地放在文胸内，并且明显比旧款穿戴式吸奶器更小，使其适合工作、旅行或在家多任务处理。LED显示屏和简单的按钮控制常被强调为对早期型号的改进，许多评论者赞赏2种模式和9个吸力档位，这为舒适度和挤奶提供了不错的个性化设置。电池寿命也获得好评，大多数用户发现每次充电约2-3小时的运行时间（可多次使用）对于整天远离电源插座确实有用。在性能方面，反馈大多是正面的，但并非完美。许多用户报告说吸力良好，出奶可靠，尤其是当法兰尺寸合适时，并且他们喜欢正确组装后的防漏设计。然而，一些评论提到定位和密封需要学习曲线，少数用户认为吸力虽然对于日常使用足够强，但不如大型医院级或插电式吸奶器那么强劲。清洁被描述为可管理但有点繁琐，因为有很多小零件。总体而言，它被普遍评价为日常吸奶的便捷、便携解决方案，最适合那些优先考虑移动性和便利性而非最大吸奶力的妈妈们。

review_content: Zwei Pumpen gleichzeitig bedeutet halbe Zeit. Wer viel abpumpt, weiß wie viel das im Alltag ausmacht – und nach ein paar Tagen mit dem 2er-Pack wollte meine Frau zurück zum Einzelpack nicht mehr.Abgesehen vom Zeitvorteil ist es dieselbe M5 die schon im Einzelpack überzeugt: leiser Motor, App-Steuerung, kein Kabel, neun Stufen zum Feineinstellen. Trägt sich unauffällig unter einem normalen BH mit etwas Spannkraft. Die App zeigt beide Pumpen gleichzeitig und lässt sich für jede Seite einzeln einstellen – praktisch wenn eine Seite empfindlicher ist als die andere.Das Rot ist übrigens eine erfrischende Abwechslung zum üblichen klinischen Grau-Weiß das Babyprodukte so gerne haben. Leichter wiederzufinden im Familienchaos, das ist mehr wert als man denkt.Was bleibt: Der Erstaufbau braucht ein Tutorial-Video, die Anleitung alleine reicht nicht. Und die richtige Flanschgröße einmal nachmessen lohnt sich – mit dem falschen Sitz kämpft man sonst ewig.Fazit: Wer ernsthaft und regelmäßig abpumpt, ist mit dem 2er-Pack deutlich effizienter unterwegs. Einmal eingerichtet spart man täglich echte Zeit – und das ist mit Baby Gold wert.
review_content_ch:
双侧同时使用——突然省下一半时间
双泵同时工作意味着时间减半。频繁使用吸奶器的妈妈都明白这在日常生活中的意义——我妻子用了几天双泵套装后，就再也不想换回单泵了。除了省时优势，它依然是那个在单泵时就令人信服的M5：静音马达、APP控制、无线设计、九档精细调节。搭配稍有弹力的普通文胸即可隐蔽佩戴。APP可同时显示双侧吸奶器，并支持每侧单独调节——当一侧比另一侧更敏感时特别实用。
顺便说，这种红色打破了婴儿用品惯用的灰白医疗色调，令人耳目一新。在家庭杂物堆里更容易找到，这价值超乎想象。
需注意：初次组装需要看教程视频，仅靠说明书不够。另外值得重新测量合适的喇叭罩尺寸——用错尺寸会长期困扰。
结论：认真定期吸奶的用户，用双泵套装效率显著提升。一旦设置妥当，每天都能节省实实在在的时间——对有宝宝的家庭来说，这价值堪比黄金。

review_content: As a mum, I've learned that anything which saves time, makes life easier, and helps me multitask is worth its weight in gold. Between school runs, endless laundry, meal times, and everything else that comes with family life, finding time to sit still can feel impossible. That's why the Momcozy Breast Pump with App has become one of those rare products that I genuinely wish I'd had sooner.I've used various baby products over the years, but when it comes to breastfeeding and expressing, Momcozy continues to be the brand I trust the most. They seem to understand what real mums actually need, and this pump is a perfect example of that.The wearable, hands-free design completely changed my expressing experience. Instead of being stuck in one place attached to a traditional pump, I could continue getting on with everyday life. Whether I was tidying up, making dinner, helping the children, or simply enjoying a quiet moment with a cup of tea, I wasn't tied down.What makes this model even more impressive is the app connectivity. Being able to monitor and customise pumping sessions directly from my phone feels incredibly modern and convenient. I can easily adjust settings, track sessions, and personalise the experience without constantly checking the pump itself. As someone who likes to keep organised, this feature has been brilliant.The suction is powerful yet comfortable, which can be difficult to find in a breast pump. It efficiently expresses milk while remaining gentle, making longer sessions much more comfortable. The different settings allow me to find exactly what works best for me, helping to maximise output while maintaining comfort.The design itself is sleek, discreet, and surprisingly lightweight. It fits comfortably inside my nursing bra and doesn't feel bulky or awkward to wear. I was pleasantly surprised by how quiet it is too, allowing me to express without drawing attention or disturbing others around me.Another thing I love is the freedom it gives me. As a busy mum, I often feel like there aren't enough hours in the day. This pump helps me reclaim some of that time. Rather than planning my day around expressing sessions, I can fit expressing around my family's schedule.The battery life is excellent, the parts are easy to clean, and the overall quality feels premium from the moment you open the box. It's clear that a lot of thought has gone into every detail.What really stands out for me is that this isn't just a product for breastfeeding mums—it's a confidence booster. Knowing I can express comfortably wherever I am, without disrupting my day, has made my breastfeeding journey feel far less stressful and much more manageable.If you're expecting a baby, currently breastfeeding, or searching for a pump that genuinely fits into real family life, I cannot recommend this enough. For me, Momcozy remains one of the best brands on the market for maternity and breastfeeding products, and this pump is a perfect example of why.
review_content_ch:
围绕妈妈生活运转的吸奶器，而不是反过来——我的Momcozy必备神器

作为一位妈妈，我深知任何能节省时间、让生活更轻松、帮助我同时处理多项事务的东西都价值连城。在接送孩子上学、无尽的洗衣、做饭以及家庭生活带来的种种琐事之间，要找到时间静坐不动几乎是不可能的。正因如此，带应用程序的Momcozy吸奶器成了我真心希望早点拥有的稀罕产品之一。

多年来我用过各种婴儿产品，但说到母乳喂养和吸奶，Momcozy始终是我最信任的品牌。他们似乎真正理解妈妈们的实际需求，这款吸奶器就是一个完美的例子。

可穿戴、免提的设计彻底改变了我的吸奶体验。我不再被传统吸奶器束缚在一个地方，而是可以继续处理日常事务。无论是整理房间、做晚饭、帮助孩子，还是仅仅享受一杯茶的宁静时光，我都不会被束缚住。

这款型号更令人印象深刻的是其应用程序连接功能。能够直接从手机监控和自定义吸奶过程感觉非常现代和便捷。我可以轻松调整设置、追踪吸奶次数，并个性化体验，而无需不断查看吸奶器本身。作为一个喜欢保持条理的人，这个功能真是太棒了。

吸力强劲而舒适，这在吸奶器中很难得。它能高效吸奶同时又保持温和，让更长时间的吸奶过程更加舒适。不同的设置让我能找到最适合自己的方式，在保持舒适的同时最大化产量。

设计本身时尚、低调，而且出奇地轻巧。它舒适地贴合在我的哺乳文胸内，穿戴起来不显笨重或别扭。我还惊喜地发现它非常安静，让我可以吸奶而不引人注意或打扰周围的人。

我喜欢的另一点是它给我的自由。作为一个忙碌的妈妈，我常常觉得一天的时间不够用。这款吸奶器帮助我找回了一些时间。我不再需要围绕吸奶来规划一天，而是可以根据家人的时间安排来吸奶。

电池续航非常出色，部件易于清洁，从打开盒子的那一刻起就能感受到整体品质的高级感。显然，每个细节都经过了深思熟虑。

对我而言最突出的是，这不仅仅是一款为母乳喂养妈妈设计的产品——它还能增强自信。知道无论身在何处都能舒适地吸奶，而不影响我的一天，这让我的母乳喂养之旅感觉压力小得多，也更容易管理。

如果你正在待产、正在母乳喂养，或者正在寻找一款真正适合现实家庭生活的吸奶器，我强烈推荐这款。对我来说，Momcozy仍然是市场上最好的孕产和母乳喂养产品品牌之一，而这款吸奶器就是最好的证明。

review_content: I have moved to using these entirely! They're the best! I've bought two sets. I've always heard wearables are not as efficient as removing the milk so not to use them full-time or it will mess with supply- entirely the opposite for me using these. Better yield and suction than my insurance covered pump and more convenient, more mobility. I even had a clogged duct once early on and these are so strong I switched to these and it took care of it. I can't sit in a formal meeting or a place like church or anything like that and pump without it being a noise distraction but I don't consider them to be "loud." I wear a nursing cover like a scarf and I can walk around in the halls and breakroom at work, even out and about in public and it doesn't feel like it's at all weird. It's so convenient. For regular pumping, I use it on half power on the second setting and I get 3.5-4 pumps that last 25-30 min each. Sad part- I dropped one and the plastic part broke so I overnighted an entirely new set in a panic (honestly, I'm thrilled to have a second set). When I came to my senses, I looked at replacement parts and you can buy all the other parts except for the plastic one, which is the most likely to break- it only comes in a set and isn't cheap enough compared to the price of one pump that I decided it wasnt worth it. So kinda perturbed that's not a replacement part option. 💔 Paruu, please reconsider!
review_content_ch:
吸奶器彻底改变游戏规则！
我已经完全改用这款了！它们是最棒的！我买了两套。之前总听说穿戴式吸奶器排奶效率不如传统款，不能全职使用否则会影响奶量——但对我来说完全相反。产量和吸力都比我医保覆盖的吸奶器更好，还更方便、更便携。有次早期遇到乳腺堵塞，这款吸力超强，切换使用后立马解决了问题。虽然没法在正式会议或教堂等场合安静使用（会有噪音干扰），但我不觉得它们"吵"。搭配哺乳巾像围巾一样佩戴后，我能在公司走廊、休息室走动，甚至外出公共场所也完全不尴尬。太方便了。日常使用时我调二档半功率，每次25-30分钟能吸3.5-4次。伤心的是摔坏了一个塑料部件，紧急连夜买了整套新品（说实话有备用套很开心）。冷静后发现其他部件都能单独买，唯独最容易坏的塑料件只能买整套——相比单机价格不够划算，觉得不值。这点挺郁闷的，希望Paruu能重新考虑替换部件问题。💔
review_summary: 用户高度评价该产品，称其为泵奶革命性产品，吸力强于保险覆盖的泵奶器，使用更方便且移动性强，甚至能解决乳腺堵塞问题。虽然使用时有一定噪音但不认为很吵，可在公共场合佩戴。缺点是塑料部件易损坏且无法单独购买替换件，只能购买整套。

review_content: OK, so I only really leave super honest reviews. And I think I only left two stars because I was able to return this and get my money back. I tried to add a video, but for some reason, it would not let me add more videos to my gallery I have a video of these pumps leaking, I bought this because I needed a new strong pump and it says that it is hospital grade, well that is just not true because my supply was already going solo and this made it so worse not to mention the little bit that I had poured more than halfway out because this thing just doesn’t stop leaking, I had a pump cheaper than this, and it was stronger, I also used the right answers in. It just didn’t make any difference. And there is many problems with us. There is no time so you don’t really know how long you’re pumping unless you set a timer on your phone or just look at the clock. It loses charge after one use and shuts off at 20 minutes. Oh and not to mention that there’s no way of telling if they are fully charged or what level they are even charged at because there is no indicator anywhere. So if you want a cheaper wearable pump, just go to Bella Baby after two months The motor does start being a little less strong, but so much better and cheaper than these! And later, if it lets me upload the video, I definitely will!
review_content_ch:

review_content: 3rd time pumping mom here & I absolutely love this pump! Now let me start by saying I've owned this pump for 2 months & I typically pump between 4-8 oz every 3 hours. So im not an over producer. These are easy to pop in my bra and go about my day (which is great when you have 3 kids). It auto shuts off after 30 minutes & comes with 3 different size flanges & 2 charger wires. The suction is decent & has different settings for strength & different pumping modes. If you produce alot you will have to dumb it out half way through your pump & then continue. The only cons I would say is it does leak a little when removing them even when extra careful. (Not a deal breaker for me as it wasn't a ton). & it pinches a little sometimes, not sure if this is because I have really big boobs though, but I just readjust &it's fine. Also, it's not the quietest pump, I use it around people& im always asked if I'm carrying something mechanical 😂 Overall I say if you're looking for a wireless pump that gets the job done well & won't break the bank this one is great!
review_content_ch:
性价比很高！
这是我第三次当妈妈，正在使用吸奶器，我超爱这款吸奶器！先说一下，我用了这款吸奶器两个月了，通常每三小时吸4-8盎司。所以我并不是产奶量很多的人。这些吸奶器很容易放进胸罩里，然后继续做我的事情（当你有三个孩子时，这太棒了）。它会在30分钟后自动关闭，并附带3种不同尺寸的法兰和2根充电线。吸力还不错，有不同的强度设置和不同的吸奶模式。如果你产奶量很多，你需要在吸到一半时倒掉，然后继续。我觉得唯一的缺点是，即使非常小心地取下它们时，也会有一点漏奶。（对我来说这不是什么大问题，因为漏得不多）。而且有时会有点夹痛，不知道是不是因为我胸部很大的原因，但只要重新调整一下就好了。另外，它并不是最安静的吸奶器，我在别人面前使用时，总是被问是不是带了什么机械装置😂总的来说，如果你想找一款无线吸奶器，能很好地完成任务，而且不会让你破产，这款就很棒！

review_content: I don’t normally write reviews, but had to with this hands free breast pump. I had originally bought a medical grade breast pump through my insurance this time around with my second baby because I had used the willow pump before in my first pregnancy and although I was happy with the willow pump, it became quite expensive to keep (always buying new accessories just to keep up). With my second born, I quickly found out she loses her mind if I don’t hold her, which makes a traditional pump difficult to use. I searched online Amazon and found this hands free pump and decided to give it a try. I can honestly tell you that I already know this is far better than the expensive willow pump I had. Easy to assemble, great suction power, and because it uses way less parts than the willow, I can see that this will be the more cost efficient one in the long run. I only have two gripes with it so far - the smell of the product is quite strong and unpleasant, but after airing it out and a few washes, it goes away. Second gripe is that it doesn’t automatically determine the number of oz you do in your session or when the pump is full. You’ll have to manually log and check. That’s it! I really like this product and hope this helps you in your purchase decision.

review_content: I want to share my full experience because I know there are other moms out there struggling just like I was. Before this pump, I tried three different pumps — the expensive wearable I bought myself, the manual pump my insurance sent, and even the pump that the hospital gave me. Every single one left me feeling defeated. I was getting barely anything… not even an ounce most days. I originally started pumping just to make sure my baby was getting enough. But when nothing came out, it made me panic. It made me think my baby wasn’t feeding well, so I bought formula. That was a heartbreaking decision for me. And when I started feeding formula, my baby became gassy and uncomfortable, which made me feel even worse — like I had made the wrong choice twice. At that point, I said forget pumping. I didn’t even want to look at a pump anymore. I focused only on breastfeeding because at least my baby was happy and feeding well. Pumping had become something that made me feel sad, stressed, and honestly, like I was failing. Later, I was talking to my husband about how much money we wasted on that expensive wearable pump, and he said, “Why don’t we try another one?” I immediately said no. I didn’t want to feel that disappointment again. He insisted, and I finally agreed — but only if he chose it and it was under $70. I wasn’t willing to waste more money or more emotions. He picked this one. Nothing fancy. Just a simple pump with good reviews. And because one mom’s review convinced me to try again, I’m here returning the favor. The very first time I used this pump… I got 4 ounces — after feeding my baby. I couldn’t believe it. After three pumps that made me feel like my body wasn’t doing enough, this affordable little pump proved that I wasn’t the problem. I just needed the right tool. And beyond the emotional part — this pump is actually comfortable. It’s easy to clean, which matters when you’re exhausted and juggling everything. I charge it once every morning, and even though I pump twice a day for 20 minutes or less, it only uses one bar of battery out of three. It pulls milk quickly, and I’m not sitting there forever waiting for results. I genuinely love it. If you’re a mom struggling, doubting yourself, or feeling defeated, please know you’re not alone. Breastfeeding is hard. Pumping is hard. But sometimes the right pump makes all the difference. This one gave me confidence again, and I hope it helps someone else the way it helped me.
review_content_ch:
这台吸奶器证明了我不是问题所在！！
我想分享我的完整经历，因为我知道还有其他妈妈像我一样在挣扎。在这台吸奶器之前，我试过三台不同的吸奶器——我自己买的昂贵穿戴式吸奶器、保险公司寄来的手动吸奶器，甚至医院给我的那台吸奶器。每一台都让我感到挫败。我几乎什么都吸不出来……大多数日子连一盎司都没有。我最初开始吸奶只是为了确保宝宝吃得够。但当什么都吸不出来时，我慌了。这让我以为宝宝没吃饱，所以我买了配方奶。那对我来说是一个令人心碎的决定。而且当我开始喂配方奶时，宝宝变得胀气、不舒服，这让我感觉更糟——好像我两次都做了错误的选择。那时，我说算了，不吸奶了。我甚至不想再看一眼吸奶器。我只专注于亲喂，因为至少宝宝很开心，吃得很好。吸奶已经变成让我感到难过、有压力，老实说，就像我失败了一样。后来，我和丈夫聊起我们在那台昂贵的穿戴式吸奶器上浪费了多少钱，他说：“我们为什么不试试别的呢？”我立刻说不。我不想再经历那种失望了。他坚持，我最终同意了——但前提是他来选，并且价格低于70美元。我不愿意再浪费更多钱或更多感情。他选了这台。没什么花哨的。只是一台简单的、好评如潮的吸奶器。因为一位妈妈的评论说服了我再试一次，我在这里回报这份好意。我第一次使用这台吸奶器……在喂完宝宝后，我吸出了4盎司。我简直不敢相信。在三台让我觉得自己的身体不够好的吸奶器之后，这台实惠的小吸奶器证明了我不是问题所在。我只需要合适的工具。除了情感方面——这台吸奶器实际上很舒适。它容易清洗，当你筋疲力尽、应付各种事情时，这一点很重要。我每天早上充一次电，即使我每天吸两次，每次20分钟或更少，它只用掉三格电池中的一格。它吸奶很快，我不需要一直坐在那里等待结果。我真心喜欢它。如果你是一位正在挣扎、怀疑自己或感到挫败的妈妈，请知道你不孤单。亲喂很难。吸奶很难。但有时合适的吸奶器能带来天壤之别。这台吸奶器重新给了我信心，我希望它也能像帮助我一样帮助其他人。

review_content: This is my first time pretty much exclusively pumping. I have three other pumps: spectra, cimilre, & the OG Elvies. Both the spectra and cimilre seem to empty me the most. While I’m 8wks Into my pumping journey I thought I’d give this pump a try, why not? It was a great Black Friday deal & the positive reviews stated they emptied like the spectra… so, I thought I’d give it a shot. Well, there’s a couple things that are worth noting: This pump is STRONG. WAYYY TOO STRONG. I feel like it should be a gradual suction but level one, in stimulation mode, feels like a level 3 on the spectra and the expression mode level 2 is like a level 5. I’ve tried it for a few sessions already & I just can’t seem to get anywhere past 4. It starts pinching & just begins to feel uncomfortable. For reference I can gradually get myself to level 7/8 on the spectra and level 4/5 in stimulation mode so I am by no means too sensitive. I feel like this pump would desensitize you if you use it on the higher settings, do be careful! In addition, this is SO loud. Which is fine if you’re going to use it at HOME, because there’s no way you’d want to be running errands or wearing them at work. So if you plan to use it outside of home make sure you know you can hear the motors whirring loud and clear! Lastly, on the positive side, it does seem to get the job done but I cannot say I was fully emptied. Honestly, I can’t get myself past 20min of pumping. I do like that it comes with various inserts and appreciate the flange is a 28mm to accommodate women who are 26mm.+ It’s also nice that it’s a budget friendly pump to make it accessible to women. In conclusion, it’s a strong pump beware if you can’t handle a strong whirring suction. It does get the job done in a pinch but I would not make it your primary (as the case with any wearable). Happy pumping!
review_content_ch:
警告：这不是新手适用的吸奶器
这是我第一次几乎完全依赖吸奶器。我还有另外三款吸奶器：spectra、cimilre和初代Elvies。spectra和cimilre似乎最能排空我的乳汁。虽然我已经使用吸奶器8周了，但我想试试这款，为什么不呢？它是个很棒的黑五优惠，而且好评说它排空效果像spectra...所以我决定尝试。不过有几点值得注意：这款吸奶器吸力太强了，强得离谱。我觉得吸力应该循序渐进，但它的刺激模式一级感觉像spectra的三级，而泌乳模式二级像五级。我已经试了几次，但怎么也适应不了四级以上。会开始有刺痛感，变得不舒服。作为参考，我能在spectra上逐步用到7/8级，刺激模式4/5级，所以我绝不是太敏感的人。感觉如果开高档位，这款会让你逐渐麻木，千万小心！另外，它噪音特别大。如果在家用没问题，但你绝不会想戴着它出门办事或上班。所以如果打算在外使用，请确保你能接受马达明显嗡嗡响！最后说优点，它确实能完成任务，但我不敢说完全排空了。老实说，我用它撑不过20分钟。我喜欢它配了多种尺寸的配件，而且法兰是28mm的，适合26mm以上的女性。价格亲民让更多女性用得起也是优点。总之，如果你受不了强力嗡嗡吸力就要当心。紧急时它能完成任务，但我不建议作为主力机（所有穿戴式都这样）。吸奶愉快！
review_summary: 吸力过强且噪音大，刺激模式一级相当于其他吸乳器三级，表达模式二级相当于五级，使用超过20分钟会感到不适。附带多种尺寸配件，28mm法兰适合26mm以上用户，价格亲民但建议不作为主要吸乳器使用。

review_content: DOUBLE CHECK YOUR PUMP ISN’T USED!!! Putting 4 stars because I was sent a USED pump at first. It had dried milk and hairs on it. However, I was so impressed with the packaging, parts, etc. that I requested a replacement and I’m happy I did! I still haven’t used it yet, so once I do I’ll update the stars I give. Pump comes with flange sizing guide which I think is such a nice touch. Looks great and not a lot of parts to clean like my other pump. Please double check your pump isn't USED. It seems that a lot of people are being sent used pumps. I think this is an issue with the Amazon return process and not Paruu. The pump even comes with an insert warning that pumps should NOT be shared or re-used. Either way, this is a medical device so being sent a used one is not only upsetting but also a major biohazard and risk to my and my baby’s health. If your pump is new, it will come sealed with cling wrap. All the parts will be packaged in small plastic bags. And the pumps themselves with have a plastic sleeve over it. Look for these things because that’s what my brand new one came like!

review_content: I purchased the Momcozy M6 breast pump new, but what I received was completely unacceptable. The only way to get suction is by pressing on a specific part of the pump, which makes it unusable. I am extremely disappointed and would not recommend purchasing this product unless the company addresses these serious hygiene and safety issues.

review_content: Trigger warning!! Let me just start with the fact that when I had my sweet boy that I was an over supplier! 11oz to 13oz a session. I was really iffy at first but when they come in I instantly fell in love! They are slightly noticeable, but I’m a bigger girl so any wireless that I wear that happens with. 🤷🏻‍♀️ but after 3 months of using them to replace my wall pump consistently, I noticed they weren’t working properly. So I contacted Amazon and the company and HONEYYY… let me just tell you, they went ahead and sent me a whole new set and told me I could send the malfunctioned ones back as soon as it was convenient for me to. Not to rush. That these pumps have a 12 month warranty! This company is amazing! Didn’t charge me a dime to sent the parts back. I got the new set they sent me in and with so much going on with family I soon realized that I left mine in another state. While waiting for those to be sent back to me by family. I placed an order for another set yesterday. I got the newest set in today and I feel like a child on Christmas. I love these pumps so much. I am always encouraging people who breast feed or pump to just bite the bullet and order these. ♥️ Paruu P10 has got me in a chokehold. I love it so much!

我已经下单3次了！！♥️
先说明一下情况：当我生下可爱的儿子时，我的奶水多得惊人！每次能挤出11到13盎司。但宝宝无法正确含乳，发生了很多状况。家里那台壁挂式吸奶器总觉得没吸干净...事实证明我是对的，奶量骤减到每次不足1盎司。我哭了好多次。研究了一整周后，我花299美元买了Mom cozy，但实在不喜欢...外观漂亮却吸不干净。后来发现了这款吸奶器，起初很犹豫，但收到后立刻爱上！颜值超高...使用一周半后，奶量回升到最初的一半！彻底排空的感觉真好。温和静音，还附赠乳头测量器和备用配件！充电超快，清洗倒空都很方便。稍微有点显形，但我体型偏大，穿任何无线款都会这样🤷🏻‍♀️。持续使用三个月替代壁挂式后，发现运作异常。联系亚马逊和厂商后——亲爱的听好了——他们直接寄了整套新品，还说不急，方便时再寄回故障机就行。这款吸奶器有12个月保修！太贴心了！寄回零件没花一分钱。新机送达时正逢家事繁忙，后来发现把吸奶器落在别的州了。等家人寄回期间，昨天又下单了一套。今天收到最新款时开心得像过圣诞的孩子。我太爱这款吸奶器了，总是鼓励母乳喂养或用吸奶器的妈妈们果断入手。♥️ Paruu P10让我彻底沦陷，爱到不行！
review_summary: 用户多次回购该吸奶器，认为其外观精美、吸力充足且温和静音，能完全排空乳汁，使用一周半后奶量恢复至初期一半。清洁方便、充电快速，公司还免费提供乳头测量器和备用配件。三个月后出现故障时，公司迅速更换新机并提供12个月保修。用户强烈推荐这款产品。

review_content: I absolutely love these pumps at the beginning of my breast-feeding journey. They were super convenient to just pop in get some things done around the house, hold the baby, run errands. You name it and it felt like it was just super easy to while doing it. However, I noticed overtime. I wasn’t fully being emptied. Leaving big masses in my breast. And it is really hard to massage those masses out while the pumps are on. I gave it a little bit of a break thinking maybe it was a user error. After a month of manual and wall pumps, I decided to go back to the mom cozy’s. And I experienced the same thing. At the end of the night when I would use my wall pump, I was so full and had these masses in them. I started to notice I needed to almost pump with a manual or a wall pump after using the mom cozy’s. My supply went down drastically! I think these pumps are great want to go or if you have a very busy life, but they just don’t have the strength needed to completely empty you out. And yes, I was using a small, smaller flange that was meant for me, I was making sure they were fully charged every time I use them and I had a tight compression bra on and nothing changed. I was pretty disappointed because I’ve spent so much money on these pumps!
review_content_ch:
我真的很希望它们能适合我
在我刚开始母乳喂养时，我超级喜欢这些吸奶器。它们非常方便，可以随时戴上做些家务、抱宝宝或跑腿。感觉做什么都很轻松。但时间久了，我发现它们不能完全排空乳汁，导致乳房里留下大块硬块。而且戴着吸奶器时很难按摩开这些硬块。我停用了一段时间，以为是自己的操作问题。在用了一个月手动和壁挂式吸奶器后，我又换回mom cozy，结果情况依旧。晚上用壁挂式吸奶器时，我发现乳房还是很胀，里面有硬块。后来我注意到用完mom cozy后，几乎还得用手动或壁挂式吸奶器再吸一次。我的奶量急剧下降！我觉得这些吸奶器适合外出或忙碌时用，但吸力不足以完全排空。没错，我用了适合我的小号法兰，每次使用前都确保充满电，还穿了紧身哺乳文胸，但情况毫无改善。花了这么多钱却这样，真的很失望！
review_summary: 用户初期喜欢这款吸奶器的便携性，但长期使用后发现无法完全排空乳房，导致硬块和奶量下降。尝试调整使用方法后问题依旧，最终失望于产品效果与价格不符。

review_content: Pump review: I, unfortunately, cannot recommend this pump. At first I loved it and would have easily given in 5 stars. In less than a month a tab on one of the diaphragm just randomly broke off - absolutely no damage caused to it prior. I treat my pumps with great care and they’re always stored in the carrying case when not in use or being washed. I ordered a replacement part on my own dime and no sooner than that arrived a a piece of plastic on the flange broke off. Both times causing the pump to be unusable due to lack of suction. After researching why the plastic was breaking I saw this was a common issue with this pump and the suggestion to reach out to customer support and they were great to work with and would replace it. That was not my experience. I provided all the information requested including photos and was told I had to reach out to the store I bought it from despite the fact the product was brand new excellent condition at purchase and it’s seemingly faulty plastic. At this point it makes more sense to buy a different brand of pump as opposed to the cost I’ll be spending to replace plastic every month. Very disappointing because I really did like this pump, just can’t recommend due to the poor quality.
review_content_ch:
不推荐这款吸奶器——塑料容易断裂
吸奶器评论：不幸的是，我无法推荐这款吸奶器。起初我很喜欢它，本来会轻松给它5星。不到一个月，其中一个吸力碗上的一个卡扣就无缘无故断裂了——之前完全没有损坏。我对我的吸奶器非常小心，不用或不洗的时候总是放在收纳包里。我自己花钱订购了一个替换零件，结果刚收到，法兰上的一个塑料片就断了。两次都导致吸奶器因吸力不足而无法使用。在调查塑料为何断裂后，我发现这是这款吸奶器的常见问题，有人建议联系客服，他们处理得很好，会更换产品。但我的经历并非如此。我提供了所有要求的信息，包括照片，却被告知必须联系我购买的商店，尽管产品是全新状态、购买时质量完美，并且塑料似乎有缺陷。此时，与其每个月花钱更换塑料，不如买一个不同品牌的吸奶器更合理。非常失望，因为我真的很喜欢这款吸奶器，只是由于质量差而无法推荐。
review_summary: 不推荐：塑料部件易断裂，使用不到一个月膜片卡扣和法兰塑料片先后断裂，导致吸力不足无法使用；自行购买替换零件，客服未提供更换，需要联系购买商店。虽有初期好感，但质量差，不推荐。

review_content: Just my preliminary review, I plan to update after using for a few months. This pump feels very well made and it comes with storage containers, lids, flange measurement guide, and extra duckbills. My second complaint is that the pumps need to be charged of course and it comes with charging cords, but not a charging block. This is one of my biggest pet peeves. You spend over $100 on a nice product, and you can't even use it until you buy the second half of the charger. And for this, I need two. review_content: The Momcozy M5 is a hands-free extractor that surprised me a lot for its comfort and practicality. It is ideal if you are a busy mom and need to express milk without being connected to cables all the time. What I liked the most is that it is placed directly inside the bra, so you can move, cook or do other things while you use it. It is light and does not feel as heavy as other extractors. In addition, it has 3 modes (stimulation, extraction and mixed) and several suction levels, allowing you to adapt it to your comfort. As for comfort, the silicone design helps to seal well and not bother so much. It also includes different cup sizes, which is important for it to work better. Something you should keep in mind is that it is not the quietest, you can hear a little if you are in a very quiet place. It's not the best either if you lean a lot, because it can move.
review_content_ch:
非常满意
Momcozy M5 是一款免提吸奶器，它的舒适性和实用性让我非常惊喜。如果你是一位忙碌的妈妈，需要在不被电线束缚的情况下吸奶，那么它非常理想。我最喜欢的是它可以直接放在文胸内部，这样你在使用的时候可以走动、做饭或做其他事情。它很轻，不像其他吸奶器那样感觉沉重。此外，它有3种模式（刺激、吸乳和混合）以及多个吸力等级，让你可以根据自己的舒适度进行调整。至于舒适性，硅胶设计有助于良好密封，不会太难受。它还包含不同尺寸的罩杯，这对于更好的工作效果很重要。有一点需要注意：它不是最安静的，如果你在非常安静的地方，会听到一点声音。如果你经常弯腰，它也不是最好的，因为可能会移动。

review_content: Pros and cons of its unique features: -The Air1 has a smaller profile than most wearable pumps, though it’s not as discreet as advertised. It still looks like you’re wearing pumps unless you have a very loose top on. Its compact size does make it easy to simultaneously feed on the other side. -One of its best features is the transparent top, which makes nipple alignment and monitoring pumping progress very easy. This is especially helpful if you’re new to pumping and/or have elastic nipples, as centering nipples reduces chafing and pain! -It’s comfortable to wear, as it has soft silicone flanges that mold onto the breast for a tighter seal. -It’s quieter than pumps like the Eufy E10, Momcozy M9, BabyBuddha, and Spectra S1, though overall I’d still call the noise level low average—none of these pumps are as quiet as they claim. It is noticeable if you’re in a quiet setting but fine inside stores, car, outside (i.e., places that have some ambient noises). -The pump can be used with or without the Momcozy phone app. If you have a poor WiFi connection, connecting the pumps to the app can be frustrating. The app and remote control features are nice, but I wouldn’t rely on it for accurate milk measurements—the built-in tracking is very inaccurate and doesn’t seem to adjust even after entering corrected amounts. -There are 5 parts to clean, which is similar to other pumps, but the motor can be difficult to detach from the cups. I’ve bent a nail or two trying this but honestly id rather it be tight than too loose! Overall easy to clean. Conclusion: It pumps well and has several thoughtful features that initially drew me to it. However, for the high price and potential downsides, including finicky app and reports of motors failing after a few months, it may not be worth it. Hopefully future models will be better.
review_content_ch:
设计贴心，但整体还有改进空间
其独特功能的优缺点：
- Air1 的机身比大多数可穿戴吸奶器更小巧，但并没有广告中说的那么隐蔽。除非你穿着非常宽松的上衣，否则看起来还是像戴着吸奶器。不过它紧凑的尺寸确实方便在另一侧同时喂奶。
- 它最好的功能之一是透明顶盖，可以很容易地对准乳头并监控吸奶进度。如果你是新手和/或有弹性乳头，这尤其有用，因为将乳头居中能减少摩擦和疼痛！
- 佩戴舒适，因为它有柔软的硅胶法兰，贴合乳房形成更紧的密封。
- 它比 Eufy E10、Momcozy M9、BabyBuddha 和 Spectra S1 等吸奶器更安静，不过总体而言，我认为噪音水平只是中等偏低——这些吸奶器没有一个像它们宣传的那样安静。在安静环境下能明显听到，但在商店、车里、户外（即有一些环境噪音的地方）就没问题。
- 这款吸奶器可以配合 Momcozy 手机应用使用，也可以不用。如果你的 WiFi 连接不好，将吸奶器连接到应用会让人沮丧。应用和远程控制功能不错，但我不太相信它能准确测量奶量——内置追踪非常不准确，即使输入了修正后的数值似乎也不会调整。
- 需要清洗的部件有5个，与其他吸奶器类似，但电机可能很难从吸乳杯上拆下来。我试着拆的时候弄弯了一两个指甲，但说实话，我宁愿它紧一点也不要太松！整体上容易清洗。
结论：吸奶效果不错，有几个贴心的功能最初吸引了我。但考虑到价格较高和潜在缺点，包括应用不稳定以及有报告称电机几个月后就出故障，可能不太值得。希望未来型号能更好。

This would be an absolute 5 star product if the battery stays true and doesn’t wear down easily, which only time will tell as well as the pump itself staying cool. But overall I’m very happy with this purchase!

review_content: As a third time mom who exclusively breastfeeds but pumps to donate, I’ve been really happy with this pump. One of my favorite features is that it’s see-through, which makes a huge difference for me. Being able to clearly see my nipple and flange alignment helps me position everything correctly, which makes pumping more comfortable and effective. The pump itself is lightweight, slim, and discreet, making it easy to wear without feeling bulky. Suction is strong but still gentle, and it does a great job emptying without discomfort. I also appreciate how quiet it is, which makes it easy to use around the house or while multitasking. I use it a lot while driving and I have never experienced any leaks or issues, and I truly feel like no one can tell its there. I have heard great things about the app, but I haven't tried it myself, I don't feel like its necessary. Overall this pump feels very mom-friendly and well made, and I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, functional, wearable pump.
review_content_ch:
非常隐蔽且排空效果出色
作为第三次当妈妈、全母乳喂养但使用吸奶器捐赠母乳的人，我对这款吸奶器非常满意。我最喜欢的一个特点是它是透明的，这对我来说意义重大。能够清楚地看到乳头和法兰的对齐情况，帮助我正确定位所有部件，使吸奶过程更舒适高效。吸奶器本身轻巧、纤细且隐蔽，佩戴时不会感到笨重。吸力强劲但依然温和，能很好地排空乳房且无不适感。我还很欣赏它的静音设计，方便在家里或多任务处理时使用。我经常在开车时使用它，从未遇到过泄漏或其他问题，而且真的感觉没人能发现它的存在。我听说过关于配套应用程序的好评，但自己还没尝试过，觉得没必要。总的来说，这款吸奶器非常妈妈友好且做工精良，我肯定会向任何寻找舒适、实用、可穿戴吸奶器的人推荐它。
review_summary: 作为母乳喂养并捐赠母乳的三胎妈妈，对这款吸奶器非常满意。透明设计便于观察乳头和护罩对齐，提升舒适度和效率。轻便隐蔽，吸力强劲但温和，无泄漏问题，工作时安静。虽未使用配套应用，仍强烈推荐这款舒适实用的穿戴式吸奶器。

review_content: This pump works better than my Spectra in terms of pumping a high volume of milk in a short amount of time. I love the portability since I take these to work daily without having to carry a big ol' pump. I love how easy it is to use. As far as a breast pump it works well. I actually have two sets to help me pump at home right before I go to work and I have the other clean set all packed away. However, the biggest con for me was that it hasn't been actually wearable at all for me. I have to hold onto it the entire time I am pumping. I am bustier right now at a 34DDD and have found it nearly impossible to find a big enough bra to fit this pump in a way that the pump doesn't move while I am pumping and multitasking. It was frustrating at first that I couldn't actually use it as intended, but I have forgotten about that and still use it as my full-time pump. I would still recommend it. Maybe it just isn't as practical for bustier women.

review_content: This breast pump looks good and has a strong suction. I'm not lactating yet, but I tried it and it had a good pull and I could imagine it getting the job done. It was also intuitive to use and easy to clean too. Test around to find your ideal mode and cadence level. To me, it feels foreign since this is my first time using it, but it's good to test first since my husband and I are planning for a baby soon. It is convenient and portable, just tuck it into a loose bra and go about your day doing chores around the house. That's the best part of this breast pump, it's not bulky or heavy and not loud too. It makes an audible hum noise but not loud in my ears. The LED display is also clear and bright. The charging base is modern and very convenient. One note is that it was cold on first contact so I recommend warming it up with a warm towel first. Anyways, wishing all the mommas a great pumping session!

review_content: The duckbills. Please explain to me how they pop off over and over and over and over and over when they have the slightest inkling of being wet. Its like an unknown force is messing with me and continues to pop them off. When it is 3 am and I am getting a desperate pump done half asleep, a long one just to make sure my puppies are empty, and I look down after 30 minutes and see one of the duckbills popped off yet again...I didnt notice until the end when my boob still felt full. Not a drop in the cup. Only the duckbill laying there. Taunting me. Then I have to sit for another 30 minutes watching that dang duckbill like a hawk through the session. Dont get me started on the hulk style suction the pump makes to the cups. If there is a speck of milk between the pump and cup, oh buddy you can forget separating them. My go-to bottle opener of a husband - who lifts hundred pound metals for work - CANNOT separate it either on occasion. Its pure luck and desperation to get them to split. One less star for each of those reasons. The 3 stars is only because out of 3 pumps I have used, this one empties me the best, is the quietest, and fits most comfortably in my bras.
review_content_ch:
凌晨3点，我苦苦哀求放过
那些鸭嘴阀。请告诉我，为什么只要稍微有点湿意，它们就会一次又一次、没完没了地脱落。感觉就像有股神秘力量在跟我作对，不停地把它们弄掉。凌晨3点，我半睡半醒地急着完成一次漫长的吸奶，只为确保乳房彻底排空，结果30分钟后低头一看，发现其中一个鸭嘴阀又掉了……我一直到结束都没察觉，因为乳房仍然感觉胀胀的。集乳杯里一滴奶都没有。只有那个鸭嘴阀躺在那里，仿佛在嘲笑我。然后我又不得不坐着，在接下来的30分钟里像鹰一样死死盯着那个该死的鸭嘴阀，直到吸奶结束。再说说吸奶器对集乳杯产生的那种“浩克式”的强大吸力吧。如果吸奶器和集乳杯之间沾上了一丁点牛奶，哦，朋友，你就别想把它们分开了。我那平时能举起上百磅金属重物的丈夫——我的专属“开瓶器”——有时也无法将它们分开。能把它们拆开全靠运气和绝望中的挣扎。因为上述每一个原因，我都扣掉一颗星。给三星的唯一原因是，在我用过的三款吸奶器中，这款排空效果最好、噪音最小，而且放在文胸里最舒适。
review_summary: 用户抱怨鸭嘴阀稍有水汽便反复脱落，半夜泵奶30分钟后发现未收集到奶、乳房仍胀，只能再花30分钟盯着；泵与集乳杯吸力过强，夹有奶渍时连其丈夫也难分开。给3星仅因该机在其用过的3款中排空最好、最安静、佩戴最舒适。

review_content: I was pleasantly surprised with this pump. It is my first hands free and it doess express the same amount as my spectra wall pump. review_content: Just going to leave this here. The pump does not allow for a great pump. Very poor yield on breast milk. Also a crucial design flaw to include the rubber seal around the collection cup is not secure enough to prevent leaking and pouring of breast milk from the collection device. A whole pump session worth of milk was spilled from the collection device onto my person and clothing due to the poor rubber ring. Also, the collection cups are designed to rest vertical against the rubber ring seal. The breast milk empties into the collection cup and rest against the cup and the ring, only defying gravity briefly before the collection cup and ring separate causing the milk to spill out. Truthfully, I'm looking for another pump and will return this one. I'm super disappointed. Notes in the picture is the pinkish rubber seal where the breast rest. See how the collection device "seals" via the rubber ring. The vertical design is awful. A horizontal collection device would have been so much better. It would have saved my precious breast milk. :/
review_content_ch:
漏奶，设计缺陷
就把这个留在这儿吧。这款吸奶器的吸乳效果不佳。母乳产量非常低。此外还有一个关键的设计缺陷：集乳杯周围的橡胶密封圈不够牢固，无法防止母乳从收集装置中泄漏和溢出。由于橡胶圈质量差，整整一次吸乳过程收集的母乳都从收集装置中洒到了我身上和衣服上。另外，集乳杯的设计是垂直靠在橡胶密封圈上的。母乳排入集乳杯后，会倚靠在杯壁和密封圈上，只是短暂地对抗重力，随后集乳杯和密封圈就会分离，导致母乳溢出。说实话，我正在寻找另一款吸奶器，并打算退回这一款。我非常失望。图片中的注释显示了乳房接触的粉红色橡胶密封圈。看看收集装置是如何通过橡胶圈“密封”的。这种垂直设计很糟糕。如果是水平设计的收集装置会好得多。那样就能保住我珍贵的母乳了。:/

review_content: Another great option from Momcozy, so let’s start with why you might choose this one over some of their others: - it’s very slim probably the slimmest and smallest of any wearable pump I’ve seen. - the see through front is actually really helpful for getting lined up properly. I was skeptical but it truly did make it easier to see if you were in the center and lined up. - the charging case. An added plus but it truly does make it so much easier to keep your pump charged and it has a decently long battery life. I charge the case each night to make sure it’s charged but you could probably get away with going a bit longer. Some things to consider: - suction is good for a wearable pump, it seems similar to the other momcozy ones I’ve tried - the slim design does make for less capacity so if you have a large supply this may not be your best option - all pumps have quite a few parts, but this one has a lot and it has several that have lots of little crevices so I would say this pump is a bit more challenging to clean than others Overall, it works well and I do like it! It definitely has a few cons but those are truly personal preference so I didn’t dock any stars.
review_content_ch:
透明罩确实有助于对准！
Momcozy的又一款优质选择，先说说为什么你可能选这款而非其他型号：
- 非常纤薄，可能是我见过最薄最小的穿戴式吸奶器
- 透明前盖实际对正确对准很有帮助。我曾持怀疑态度，但它确实能更轻松判断是否居中对准
- 充电盒是个加分项，确实让吸奶器保持充电状态方便很多，电池续航也够长。我每晚都给充电盒充电确保电力充足，但间隔稍长些应该也没问题

需考虑的因素：
- 作为穿戴式吸奶器吸力不错，与我试过的其他Momcozy产品相似
- 纤薄设计确实会减少容量，所以如果你奶量较大这可能不是最佳选择
- 所有吸奶器零件都不少，但这款特别多，有些部件还有很多细小缝隙，因此我认为它比其他型号更难清洗

总体表现良好，我确实喜欢！虽然有些缺点，但纯属个人偏好，所以没有扣减星级。
review_summary: 产品优点包括透明罩设计便于对准、超薄便携、充电盒方便且续航不错；缺点是容量较小不适合奶量大的用户，零件多且清洁较困难。

review_content: I only used these for the first 2 months and they expressed a lot of milk for me. I had to put them on a pretty high setting which produced more milk but left my nipples hurting so bad. It could have been from first starting out making my nipples sore. My husband put the rubber parts in the dish washer and one of them flew to the bottom and got burnt and has a hole through it so I stopped using them. Well 3 months later I decided to use the one that’s working and the battery is fully charged and isn’t working anymore. These work great for short time use and if you’re well established in breast feeding as they will kill your nipples when first starting out.
review_content_ch:
乳头疼痛且仅短期使用
我在前两个月只用了这款吸奶器，它帮我吸出了很多奶。我不得不把档位调得很高，虽然奶量增加了，但导致我的乳头非常疼。这可能是因为刚开始使用时导致乳头酸痛。我丈夫把橡胶部件放进洗碗机清洗，其中一个掉到底部被烫坏，还烧出了一个洞，所以我停止使用了。三个月后，我决定使用那个还能用的配件，电池明明充满了电，却再也无法工作。这款产品适合短期使用，或者在你已经熟练掌握母乳喂养技巧的情况下使用，因为对于新手妈妈来说，它会让你的乳头非常受罪。
review_summary: 仅在前2个月使用，能挤出很多奶；需调到较高档位，出奶更多但乳头非常疼，用户认为可能也与刚开始哺乳有关。橡胶部件被丈夫放入洗碗机，其中一个掉到底部被烫坏并出现破洞，因此停用；3个月后想用剩下那个，电池虽充满但已无法工作。总结：适合短期使用及哺乳已稳定的用户，刚开始哺乳时会让乳头很痛。

review_content: This hands free pump is great for travel. I like the USB port charging capabilities. The pump is great at extracting milk and emptying boobs between feeds very well. I can go without pumping for 4hrs. A bonus for being more flexible with my time and more balance as a new mom. With a full charge I have pumped 4 times. The pump auto shuts off at 150ml to prevent overflow. I do wish milk collector cups held 180ml or more. I am an over producer at times and milk can soak through my clothes. The pump will not work well and leak unless assembled correctly. The pump can be noisy but has a great range on suction modes for milk collection. Overall would definitely recommend the pump. It's great on price. Has built in warranty. Easy clean and few parts to clean.
review_content_ch:
Paruu 10 初次当妈
这款免手扶吸奶器非常适合旅行。我喜欢它的USB接口充电功能。吸奶器能很好地吸出乳汁，在两次喂奶间隔中彻底排空乳房。我可以4小时不吸奶。这让作为新手妈妈的我时间更灵活，生活更平衡。充满电后我吸了4次奶。吸奶器会在150毫升时自动关闭以防溢出。我确实希望集奶杯能装180毫升或更多。有时我奶量过多，乳汁会浸透衣服。如果组装不正确，吸奶器会效果不佳并漏奶。吸奶器可能有点吵，但吸力模式范围广，适合集奶。总体绝对推荐这款吸奶器。价格实惠。内置保修。易清洗且部件少。
review_summary: 这款免手扶吸奶器适合旅行，USB充电方便，吸奶效果好，能排空乳房，充电后可使用4次，自动在150ml时关闭防溢出。缺点是收集杯容量不足180ml，组装不当会泄漏，工作时有些噪音。价格合理，有内置保修，易于清洁。

review_content: Two things- yes this pump is wearable in the sense that you don’t have to be plugged in to anything, and you can hide it under your shirt. This does NOT mean you can run around pumping while you do dishes and laundry and the baby sleeps. (I tried) The suction is a little finicky and if you move around it won’t collect milk. Also, a major design flaw- the way to empty the pump is simply to turn it upside down and the milk runs out. This is very annoying because the milk also runs out if you set down the pump anytime before emptying it into a storage container. And even if you empty the pump and THEN set it down, a few drops will run out onto whatever surface you put your pump on. My pet peeve. Anyway. Other than that it’s a good pump
review_content_ch:
设计奇怪
有两点要说——是的，这款吸奶器在某种意义上是可穿戴的，因为你不需要连接任何电源，而且可以把它藏在衣服下面。但这并不意味着你可以在洗碗、洗衣服和宝宝睡觉时到处走动同时吸奶。（我试过了）吸力有点不稳定，如果你移动身体，它就收集不到乳汁。另外，一个主要的设计缺陷——清空吸奶器的方法只是把它倒过来，让乳汁流出来。这非常烦人，因为如果你在将乳汁倒入储存容器之前随时放下吸奶器，乳汁也会流出来。即使你清空了吸奶器然后再放下它，也会有几滴乳汁流到你放置吸奶器的任何表面上。这是我的痛点。总之。除此之外，这是一款不错的吸奶器
review_summary: 用户认为该吸奶器可穿戴、无需插电且能藏在衣服下，但指出并不能随意走动做家务时使用；吸力有些不稳定，移动时无法收集乳汁；排空需倒置，未倒入储奶容器前放下会漏奶，即使排空后放下也会滴漏，令人烦恼；除此之外仍认为是不错的吸奶器。

review_content: Great features (heat and vibration), however vibration could be stronger (maybe because I have bigger breasts?). I've had this leak often, even if not completely full. I would have this item rated at a 3 or 4, but because of the flaking off, definitely a 1 due to safety concerns. I've only had this pump for about 3 months. Unsure how to request replacement parts.
review_content_ch:
涂层剥落问题及其他评价
功能很棒（加热和振动），但振动强度可以再大一些（也许是因为我乳房较大？）。我经常遇到漏奶的情况，即使没有完全装满。如果我快速俯身，就会漏奶。吸奶器还会残留乳汁，我不得不试着调整角度，尽可能把奶倒出来，但仍会剩下一点。我今天注意到一个主要担忧：内部塑料涂层开始脱落。我一直都是手洗这些部件，不确定是否有碎片掉进了吸出的乳汁中……如果没有涂层剥落的问题，我会给这款产品打3或4分，但因为存在安全隐患，只能打1分。我使用这款吸奶器大约只有3个月。不知道如何申请更换配件。
review_summary: 用户认可加热和振动功能，但觉得振动偏弱（或与胸型较大有关）；常漏奶，即使未装满、快速侧身也会漏；泵奶后仍有残留，需调整角度倒出，仍剩少许。主要安全担忧：内层塑料涂层在仅手洗约3个月后开始脱落，不确定是否混入母乳，因此将评分降为1分；不知如何申请替换配件。

review_content: I was very disappointed with this product. Initially, when I first opened the box, the breast pump had a really bad smell. I cleaned it and the smell was faded, but you could still smell it. After trying to use it one time one of the pumps got really hot and shut off. I waited for it to cool down and then went to try it again and the battery was completely dead when I had charged it fully before use. After searching in the box for a flange size that is for me I realize that the box did not have the 17 size I needed when the box states that it has a variety of sizes inside. My next issue was that one of the valves was missing. The pump came assembled, but inside one there was one missing so I ended up having to open up the extras to use. review_content: I am currently 4 weeks postpartum today. Pros: I have been really liking how convenient these are to slip in to my bra. I can still hold my baby and essentially do whatever I need to do. The tubing plugs in perfectly to my babybuddha2.0 pump without having to make any modifications. I have not tried it with my spectra yet but I have read it’s possible. I really appreciate that I only have to wash 3 pieces! Cons: the duckbill valves are kind of lacking. I have only used these maybe 10 times and the duckbill valve already needs to be replaced. Also the last 3 pump sessions I’ve had a problem where at least one duckbill falls off in the middle of pumping and I have to stop and fish it out or just end the session. I have ordered a handful of duckbill valves of a different manufacturer, I’m crossing my fingers I will have better luck.
review_content_ch:
方便/零件少/鸭嘴阀不足
我今天产后4周。优点：我真的很喜欢把它们塞进文胸里有多方便。我仍然可以抱着宝宝，基本上做我需要做的任何事情。管路可以完美插入我的BabyBuddha 2.0吸奶器，无需进行任何改装。我还没有用我的Spectra吸奶器试过，但我读到过这是可行的。我非常感激只需要清洗3个部件！缺点：鸭嘴阀有点不够好。我只用了大概10次，鸭嘴阀就已经需要更换了。另外，在最近3次吸奶过程中，我遇到了一个问题，至少有一个鸭嘴阀在吸奶中途脱落，我不得不停下来把它找出来，或者直接结束这次吸奶。我已经订购了一些其他制造商的鸭嘴阀，祈祷我能有更好的运气。
review_summary: 用户产后4周表示该产品穿戴方便，可抱着宝宝活动，管路无需改装即可连接 babybuddha2.0，且只需清洗3个部件；但鸭嘴阀表现不佳，使用约10次就需更换，最近3次吸奶中至少一个鸭嘴阀中途脱落，需停下取出或提前结束，已购买其他厂商的鸭嘴阀替换。

review_content: Works well. Couple things that are annoying... fogs up so you can’t really see what’s going on inside. I can’t tell if anything is coming out of your breast or if the latch is good. Battery life is okay but definitely have to charge it once a day. The strings holding the controller are awkward and the only thing it’s good for is holding it on your wrist. There’s no way to lock the controller screen other than waiting for it to lock itself. If you’re doing stuff and it touches you it’ll change your settings, which I find really annoying. It gets the job done but I feel like for the price there are better pumps out there.
review_content_ch: 还行吧，能用。整体工作正常。但有几件事挺烦人的……会起雾，所以根本看不清里面的情况。我没法判断是否有乳汁流出，或者贴合是否良好。电池续航尚可，但肯定得每天充电一次。固定控制器的带子设计得很别扭，除了把它挂在手腕上之外没什么用处。控制器屏幕没有手动锁定功能，只能等它自动锁定。如果你在做其他事情时不小心碰到它，就会改变设置，这让我觉得很烦。虽然能用，但我觉得以这个价格来说，市面上有更好的吸奶器。

review_content: I used these for my first baby and they lasted at least 6 months before I had issues. Customers service is really good and they sent replacements. I ordered new ones for my new baby and after 1 month one of my pumps started having issues. The only reason I’m giving 2 stars is because of customer service is super helpful. When I was reaching out to them my second pump was having issues too so they replaced them both. I’m now concerned how long the replacements will work since my brand new pumps lasted less than 2 months. They work great for me but I think I will have to find another brand of pumps to order for when these replacements die
review_content_ch:
非常失望
我生第一个宝宝时用过这款吸奶器，至少用了6个月才出现问题。客服非常好，给我寄了替换件。我为刚出生的宝宝又订购了一套新的，但用了一个月后，其中一台吸奶器就开始出问题了。我之所以给2星，完全是因为客服超级给力。当我联系他们时，我的第二台吸奶器也出了问题，于是他们把两台都给我换了。我现在很担心这些替换件能用多久，因为我全新的吸奶器用了不到2个月就坏了。它们对我来说很好用，但我想等这些替换件坏掉后，我得另寻其他品牌的吸奶器了。
review_summary: 用户对产品感到失望：第一胎使用的吸奶器至少用了6个月才出问题；为新生儿新购的产品1个月后一台出现故障，联系客服时另一台也出问题，两台均获更换。用户认可客服服务很好（也是给出2星的原因），但担心更换后的使用寿命，因全新产品不到2个月就出问题，打算在替换品坏掉后换其他品牌。吸奶器本身使用效果很好。

review_content: I've really enjoyed this pump! It empties me pretty thoroughly and is very comfortable. The parts look intimidating, but it's deceptively easy to put together and take apart! It's a little bit harder to do the fridge hack with, but that's okay! I love the color, they're a little slimmer than my Eufy S1 pros, they're pretty quiet, and they're easy to empty out. They also don't roll all over the place like my Eufys do. My gripes are that the app kind of requires a learning curve, and the spout on the top can be temperamental when closing it. Other than that, I would recommend these! We'll see how they do over time!
review_content_ch:
目前为止很满意！
我真的很喜欢这款吸奶器！它吸得很彻底，而且非常舒适。零件看起来有点吓人，但实际上组装和拆卸都很简单！用它做冰箱储存法有点难，但没关系！我喜欢这个颜色，它们比我的Eufy S1 Pro更小巧一些，非常安静，而且容易清空。它们也不会像我的Eufy那样到处乱滚。我的不满是，App需要一点学习曲线，顶部的喷口盖关的时候有点不听话。除此之外，我会推荐它们！看看它们长期表现如何吧！

review_content: 2nd set to fail within a few months of use. They keep giving the same “you probably got milk in the motor” line without reading the details of my actual product support inquiry …no… I was especially careful with the second set, just in case. But this failure wasn’t the motor failing; it was the power button no longer turning the unit off reliably. Regardless, these are both design flaws if it can affect the device so easily and so quickly. So, now it’s just sitting on my counter pumping away for hours and I can’t turn it off. I hope the lithium battery doesn’t overheat and burn my house down.
review_content_ch:
太容易坏了
第二套才用了几个月就坏了。他们总是给出同样的说辞：“你可能是把奶弄进电机里了”，却不看我实际产品支持咨询里的细节……不……以防万一，我对第二套特别小心。但这次故障不是电机坏了；而是电源按钮不能再可靠地关闭设备。不管怎样，如果它能这么轻易、这么快地影响设备，那这两者都是设计缺陷。所以，现在这台吸奶器就这么放在我的台面上，一直抽吸好几个小时，而我却关不掉它。我希望锂电池不要过热，把我的房子烧了。
review_summary: 第二套设备使用几个月内再次故障。客服未细读咨询详情，反复以“电机进奶”回应；但此次故障是电源键无法可靠关机，并非电机。用户认为两类问题都属设计缺陷，因设备易且快速受影响。目前设备在台面上持续泵吸数小时且无法关闭，担心锂电池过热引发火灾。

review_content: Great Replacement Flange! This is a nice replacement flange for the Momcozy M9 breast pump. I like that it’s made from soft, flexible silicone rather than hard plastic, which is especially important when you’re pumping frequently. The 24mm size is a standard option, although getting the correct fit is definitely important for comfort. I also appreciate that it’s easy to take apart and clean, since washing pump parts is already enough of a chore! It’s nice to be able to replace individual parts without having to purchase an entirely new pump. Overall, a practical accessory for breastfeeding moms!
review_content_ch:

review_content: Pros -silicone flange and inserts feel soft and comfortable, doesn't pinch even during longer sessions -4 modes and 9 suction levels give plenty of room to dial in exactly what feels right -fits well under a pumping bra without feeling too bulky -quieter than I expected, nice for when I'm out and about -stands upright on its own without tipping over, which makes setup and cleanup so much easier -comes with multiple flange size inserts and a nipple measuring tool, so getting the right fit isn't a guessing game -easy to assemble and easy to clean, a big win when I'm already stretched thin on time -rechargeable battery and comes with two chargers, convenient for keeping both going -great value compared to pricier name-brand wearable pumps Cons -flange may be too soft for some — if you need a firmer flange for better output, this might not be it -battery life is decent but you'll likely need to charge after around 4-5 pumping sessions, less than some higher-end competitors -milk collectors are oddly shaped, so they don't fit neatly into a standard bottle washer/drying rack slot -silicone cover attracts dust fairly easily, so needs to be kept away from dirty surfaces -no extra smart features like overflow protection, Bluetooth app, or a tracker
review_content_ch:
免手持吸奶体验，真正舒适，绝非噱头
优点：
-硅胶法兰和垫片柔软舒适，即使长时间使用也不会夹痛
-4种模式与9档吸力，提供充足调节空间，轻松找到最合适的设置
-搭配吸奶文胸时贴合良好，不显臃肿
-比我预想的安静，外出时使用很赞
-可独立直立放置，不易倾倒，安装和清洁都更加方便
-附带多种尺寸的法兰垫片和乳头测量工具，选对尺寸不再靠猜
-组装简单，清洁方便，对时间紧张的我来说是一大加分项
-内置充电电池，附赠两个充电器，方便同时为两台设备充电
-与价格更高的知名品牌穿戴式吸奶器相比，性价比很高
缺点：
-法兰对某些人来说可能太软——如果你需要更硬的法兰以获得更好输出，这款可能不适合
-续航尚可，但大约4-5次吸奶后就需要充电，低于某些高端竞品

review_content: I really wanted to like the Momcozy M6, especially because I was looking for a convenient wearable pump. Unfortunately, after only two uses, I am already very disappointed with it. The biggest issue is the battery life. After only two pumping sessions, the pumps are already losing their charge much faster than expected. For a wearable pump, reliable battery life is essential. Another major problem is the amount of milk that gets trapped inside the pump and its components. After pumping, there is still a noticeable amount of milk left inside the flange/channel and other pieces. This feels like a significant amount of wasted breast milk, which is especially frustrating when every ounce matters. The pouring design is also poorly thought out. When I try to pour the milk out of the collection cup, milk leaks through the additional opening instead of only coming out where I am pouring. I have to be extremely careful with the angle just to avoid spilling milk. For a wearable pump that is supposed to make pumping more convenient, this is a major design flaw in my opinion. I expected much better from it.
review_content_ch:
有些问题——不推荐
我真的很想喜欢 Momcozy M6，尤其因为我一直在找一款方便的可穿戴吸奶器。遗憾的是，只用了两次，我就已经对它非常失望了。最大的问题是电池续航。仅仅吸了两次奶之后，吸奶器就已经比预期快得多地掉电。对于可穿戴吸奶器来说，可靠的电池续航至关重要。另一个主要问题是，有大量乳汁滞留在吸奶器及其部件内部。吸完奶后，法兰/通道和其他部件里仍残留着明显数量的乳汁。这感觉像是浪费了大量母乳，而在每一盎司都很重要的时候，这尤其令人沮丧。倾倒设计也考虑得很不周到。当我试图把乳汁从集乳杯中倒出来时，乳汁会从额外的开口漏出来，而不是只从我倾倒的位置流出。为了避免洒出乳汁，我必须极其小心地控制角度。对于一款本应让吸奶更方便的可穿戴吸奶器来说，我认为这是一个重大的设计缺陷。我原本对它抱有高得多的期望。
review_summary: Momcozy M6仅使用两次后即失望，不推荐。电池续航差：两次吸奶后电量下降远快于预期；吸奶后仍有明显母乳残留在喇叭罩/通道及其他部件，造成浪费；倾倒设计差，从集乳杯倒奶时会从额外开口漏出，需极小心角度以免洒奶。

review_content: These replacement duckbill valves and silicone diaphragms are a practical option for keeping the Momcozy S12 Pro Quick wearable breast pump functioning properly. The silicone pieces fit securely and help maintain a good seal, while the duckbill valves allow milk to drain efficiently into the collection container. The food grade, BPA free silicone is reassuring for parts that come into direct contact with breast milk. The parts are straightforward to clean with warm soapy water and can also be sterilized with boiling water or steam. They appear well made and are easy to replace when the original components become worn, discolored, or lose their shape. It is important to confirm that you have the S12 Pro Quick model, since these accessories are not compatible with every Momcozy pump. Although every pump will not work with everyone, these paruu p10 pros are a more affordable version to test out to see if they might be your best pump for output! It even comes with multiple sized inserts for a range and you can easily buy other inserts as well through paruu. Even if these may not work as all breast pump reacts differently with everyone, these breast pumps are made very well and definitely worth the price to figure out if these could be your best pumps yet!

review_content: I love this portable wearable breast pump, as it allows me to multitask while pumping, without having tubes or wires preventing me from being mobile. The pump also comes with a USB-C charger cable and flanges. It is easy to use, though you do need a pumping bra that is large enough to accommodate the pump, and also tight enough to hold it in place during pumping sessions. It's important to carefully place the pump directly on your nipple, to ensure the most efficient suction. Then once turned on, you can switch between letdown and expression modes, and also the strength level of the pump. You should still make sure you are angled downwards, otherwise there may be leakage of milk - like most other pumps. The pump is super easy to use and the yield is not too much different from my other plug in pump. I am able to have multiple pump sessions on one charge as well. Overall I highly recommend it!
review_content_ch:
很棒的可穿戴便携式吸奶器，实现免手扶吸奶！
我喜欢这款便携式可穿戴吸奶器，它让我在吸奶时可以同时处理多项任务，没有管子或电线妨碍我移动。这款吸奶器还配有一根USB-C充电线和法兰。它很容易使用，不过你确实需要一个足够大的吸奶文胸来容纳吸奶器，并且要足够紧，以便在吸奶过程中将其固定到位。小心地将吸奶器直接放在乳头上是至关重要的，以确保最有效的吸力。然后开机后，你可以切换泌乳模式和吸乳模式，以及吸奶器的强度级别。你仍然需要确保身体微微向下倾斜，否则可能会出现漏奶——就像大多数其他吸奶器一样。这款吸奶器非常容易使用，而且产奶量与我的另一款插电式吸奶器没有太大差别。我一次充电还可以进行多次吸奶。总的来说，我强烈推荐它！
review_summary: 用户称赞这款便携式穿戴吸奶器可解放双手，便于多任务处理，配有USB-C充电线和法兰。使用时需搭配足够大且紧的哺乳文胸，需对准乳头以获得最佳吸力。可切换泌乳和排乳模式及吸力强度，但需注意角度以防漏奶。电池续航支持多次使用，吸奶量与插电式吸奶器相近。

review_content: This Momcozy pump feels like a very thoughtful product for a mom who needs more flexibility during the day. I like that it is wearable, so pumping does not feel as limiting as sitting in one place with a traditional pump. The design is also very pretty. The Cozy Red color looks soft and modern, and the included carrying case makes the whole set feel more organized and giftable. One feature I really appreciate is the app control. It is much easier to adjust settings or check the pumping session from the phone instead of reaching into the bra to press buttons. That makes it feel more discreet and less awkward, especially when multitasking. The set also comes with multiple parts and flange sizes, which is helpful because fit makes such a big difference with breast pumps. Cleaning is still part of the routine, but the pieces are manageable and not overly complicated. Overall, I would strongly recommend this pump for moms who want something portable, discreet, and easier to use during a busy day. It feels well designed, comes as a complete set, and makes pumping feel less tied to one spot.
review_content_ch:
忙碌日子里方便免提的吸奶器
这款Momcozy吸奶器感觉像是一件为需要更多灵活性的妈妈精心设计的产品。我喜欢它的可穿戴设计，这样吸奶就不会像用传统吸奶器那样只能坐在一个地方。设计也很漂亮。Cozy Red色看起来柔和且现代，附带的收纳包让整个套装感觉更整洁，也适合送礼。我特别喜欢的一个功能是应用程序控制。通过手机调整设置或查看吸奶进度，比把手伸进内衣按按钮要方便得多。这让人觉得更隐蔽、不那么尴尬，尤其是在同时处理多项任务时。套装还包含多个部件和多种法兰尺寸，这很有帮助，因为贴合度对吸奶器来说影响很大。清洁仍然是日常的一部分，但零件易于打理，不会过于复杂。总的来说，我强烈推荐这款吸奶器给那些想要便携、隐蔽且在忙碌日子里更容易使用的妈妈们。它设计精良，配件齐全，让吸奶不再局限于一个地方。
review_summary: 这款Momcozy吸奶器可穿戴、免手扶，适合忙碌时使用；Cozy Red配色柔和现代，附收纳包，显得整洁且适合送礼。App控制便于调设置和查看吸奶过程，较隐蔽、不尴尬。配件和多种法兰尺寸有助贴合。清洁仍需日常进行，但部件好处理、不复杂。推荐给需要便携、隐蔽、易用的妈妈。

review_content: Con un bebé de mes y medio y otra niña mayor en casa, el tiempo y las manos libres son un lujo. Tras haber usado los típicos sacaleches de pared con tubos en el pasado, dimos el salto a este modelo inalámbrico (Momcozy S12 Pro) y el cambio en la rutina diaria ha sido brutal. Escribo la reseña desde el punto de vista de la logística de casa, ya que me encargo del mantenimiento del aparato, mientras mi mujer valora la comodidad de uso.​Lo que más destacamos tras un uso intensivo:​Libertad total (Cero cables): El motor va integrado en la propia copa. Esto permite a mi mujer sacarse leche mientras atiende a nuestra hija mayor, desayuna o simplemente descansa sin estar atada a un enchufe. Se ajusta bien dentro de un sujetador de lactancia normal.​Montaje y limpieza: Es un punto crítico en estos aparatos. Las piezas de silicona se montan y desmontan de forma muy intuitiva. La brida de doble sellado que trae esta versión Pro encaja a la perfección, lo que evita fugas de vacío. Se limpia rápido y aguanta perfectamente los ciclos del esterilizador.​Pantalla digital y batería: Un acierto total. La pantallita te indica el nivel de succión, el modo (estimulación o extracción) y, lo más útil, el tiempo que llevas. Se carga por USB-C (muy cómodo para no tener mil cargadores distintos) y la batería da tranquilamente para 4 o 5 sesiones de unos 20 minutos antes de pedir carga.​Nivel de ruido: Es un dispositivo mecánico, por lo que hace un ligero ronroneo, pero es bastante sordo. No resulta molesto ni llega a despertar al bebé si está durmiendo cerca.​Aspectos a tener en cuenta (Curva de aprendizaje):​El encaje inicial: Hay que asegurarse de centrar muy bien el pezón en la brida antes de encenderlo; de lo contrario, la succión no es óptima y puede molestar.​El trasvase de la leche: A la hora de vaciar la leche recolectada al biberón o a la bolsa de almacenamiento, hay que hacerlo con buen pulso por la ranura superior para no derramar ni una gota.​Conclusión:Es una herramienta que facilita muchísimo la lactancia en diferido. La relación calidad-precio frente a los modelos de farmacia tradicionales es imbatible y la independencia que otorga compensa cada céntimo.
review_content_ch:
真正的行动自由、易于清洁和电池续航是家庭后勤的关键
家里有一个一个半月大的宝宝和一个大一点的女儿，时间和双手空闲是一种奢侈。过去使用过典型的有管壁挂式吸奶器后，我们转而使用这款无线型号（Momcozy S12 Pro），日常生活的变化巨大。我从家庭后勤的角度写这篇评论，因为我负责设备的维护，而我妻子则看重使用舒适度。
在密集使用后，我们最突出的几点：

完全自由（零线缆）：电机集成在罩杯本身。这让我妻子可以在照顾大女儿、吃早餐或只是休息时吸奶，而不必被电源插座束缚。它很好地贴合在普通哺乳文胸内。

组装和清洁：这是这些设备的关键点。硅胶部件安装和拆卸非常直观。这款Pro版配备的双密封法兰完美贴合，避免了真空泄漏。清洁快速，并能很好地耐受消毒器循环。

数字屏幕和电池：完全正确。小屏幕显示吸力级别、模式（刺激或吸乳），以及最实用的使用时间。通过USB-C充电（非常方便，无需使用多种充电器），电池在需要充电前可轻松支持4到5次约20分钟的使用。

噪音水平：这是一个机械装置，因此会发出轻微的嗡嗡声，但相当低沉。不会令人烦恼，也不会吵醒附近睡觉的宝宝。

需要注意的方面（学习曲线）：

初始贴合：在开启前，必须确保乳头在法兰中非常居中；否则，吸力不理想，可能会引起不适。

牛奶转移：将收集的牛奶倒入奶瓶或储奶袋时，需要手稳，通过顶部凹槽操作，以免洒出一滴。

结论：
这是一款极大方便了后期哺乳的工具。与传统的药店型号相比，性价比无可匹敌，它所提供的独立性物有所值。
review_summary: 用户高度评价Momcozy S12 Pro吸奶器的无线设计，提供完全的行动自由，可边吸奶边照顾孩子。设备组装和清洁简便，双密封圈有效防漏。数字屏幕显示吸力模式和剩余电量，USB-C充电方便，电池续航约4-5次使用。噪音低不扰婴儿。需注意正确对准乳头位置以防不适，倒奶时要小心避免洒漏。性价比优于传统药房型号。

review_content: Hei curiosona, vuoi sapere cosa penso di questo tiralatte? Se anche tu stai vivendo il periodo dell'allattamento e cerchi un modo per ottimizzare i tempi senza rinunciare alla tua libertà, conoscerai perfettamente la frustrazione di sentirti legata a un macchinario pesante, rumoroso e pieno di cavi che ti costringe a rimanere immobile in un angolo della stanza. Sappiamo bene entrambi, caro curiosone, che i vecchi sistemi di estrazione trasformano un momento così delicato in una fonte di stress e che molti tiralatte portatili in commercio si rivelano dolorosi, difficili da lavare o inclini a fastidiose perdite di liquido se non rimani perfettamente dritta.Un indiscutibile elemento di superiorità di questo modello risiede nella sua innovativa flangia a doppia tenuta con tecnologia che imita in modo straordinario la bocca del bambino, una finezza progettuale che assicura un'aderenza anatomica impeccabile al seno e riduce a zero il rischio di fuoriuscite laterali. Il contatto con la pelle è mediato da un silicone di altissima qualità, estremamente morbido, flessibile e confortevole, che evita qualunque tipo di sfregamento o irritazione anche durante le sessioni più lunghe e frequenti. Il sistema di aspirazione offre tre distinte modalità operative, tra cui la stimolazione leggera, l'estrazione profonda e un utilissimo programma misto, regolabili su nove livelli incrementali per personalizzare al millimetro l'esperienza e ottenere uno svuotamento del seno rapido, efficiente e del tutto indolore.La praticità quotidiana compie un balzo in avanti straordinario grazie a un design compatto ed ergonomico che scompare letteralmente all'interno di un normale reggiseno da allattamento, consentendoti di mantenere le mani libere per spingere il passeggino, lavorare al computer o dedicarti al relax. Il motore integrato si dimostra incredibilmente silenzioso e privo di vibrazioni eccessive, garantendo una discrezione totale sia tra le mura domestiche, mentre il piccolo riposa serenamente accanto a te, sia quando ti trovi all'aperto o in viaggio. L'assemblaggio dei componenti è talmente semplice e intuitivo da richiedere pochissimi secondi, poiché le parti a contatto con il latte sono ridotte al minimo e si separano con un unico gesto immediato.La manutenzione igienica non riserva alcuna complicazione, dato che ogni pezzo strutturale può essere lavato rapidamente sotto l'acqua corrente con un po' di sapone neutro e inserito senza problemi nello sterilizzatore a vapore, un vantaggio enorme per una mamma stanca che non ha tempo da perdere con minuscole valvole o tubicini lunghi. La batteria ricaricabile offre un'autonomia pazzesca che copre diverse sessioni per tutta la settimana, mentre la presenza di una bellissima custodia rigida per il trasporto e di un utile righello per misurare il capezzolo completano un packaging curato ed elegante. In sintesi, ci si trova davanti a un prodotto solido, sicuro, tecnologicamente avanzato e dall'estetica grigia raffinata, nato per svoltare la vita delle neo-mamme e rendere il percorso dell'allattamento sereno, leggero e perfettamente integrato nella routine moderna.E allora curiosona, cosa dire. Questo è il prodotto che fa per te, questo è il prodotto che hai sempre desiderato, che hai sempre cercato e che finalmente potrà essere tuo. Desidero precisare che questa recensione, nonostante sia relativa a un prodotto ricevuto gratuitamente, rispecchia fedelmente la mia esperienza d'uso ed è frutto di un'opinione del tutto sincera e imparziale.

嘿，好奇的姑娘，你想知道我对这款吸奶器的看法吗？如果你也正处于哺乳期，正在寻找一种既能优化时间又不放弃自由的方式，你一定非常清楚那种被一台沉重、嘈杂、满是线缆的机器束缚在房间角落、动弹不得的挫败感。我们俩都很清楚，亲爱的好奇宝宝，旧的吸奶系统会把这样一个微妙的时刻变成压力的来源，而市面上许多便携式吸奶器要么使用起来疼痛，要么难以清洗，要么如果你没有保持完全笔直的姿势就容易出现烦人的漏液。这款型号的一个无可争议的优势在于其创新的双密封法兰，采用模仿婴儿口腔的惊人技术，这一设计细节确保了与乳房完美贴合，并将侧漏的风险降至零。与皮肤的接触由极高品质的硅胶作为媒介，极其柔软、灵活且舒适，即使在最长、最频繁的使用中也能避免任何摩擦或刺激。吸力系统提供三种不同的操作模式，包括轻柔刺激、深层吸乳和一个非常有用的混合程序，可在九个递增级别上调节，以精确个性化体验，实现快速、高效且完全无痛的乳房排空。日常便利性因一个紧凑且符合人体工程学的设计而实现了惊人的飞跃，该设计几乎可以完全消失在普通哺乳文胸内，让你可以腾出双手推婴儿车、在电脑上工作或放松身心。内置电机异常安静，没有过度振动，确保无论是在家中、宝宝在你身边安睡时，还是在户外或旅途中都能完全保持低调。组件的组装如此简单直观，只需几秒钟，因为与乳汁接触的部件数量极少，而且只需一个动作即可分离。卫生维护毫无复杂之处，因为每个结构部件都可以用中性肥皂快速冲洗，并轻松放入蒸汽消毒器中，这对疲惫的、没有时间处理细小阀门或长管的妈妈来说是一个巨大的优势。可充电电池具有惊人的续航能力，可覆盖一整周的数次使用，而一个漂亮的硬质收纳盒和一个用于测量乳头尺寸的实用尺子，使包装显得精致且优雅。总之，这是一款坚固、安全、技术先进、外观精致灰色设计的产品，旨在改变新妈妈们的生活，让哺乳之路变得平静、轻松，并完美融入现代日常。那么，好奇的姑娘，怎么说呢？这就是适合你的产品，这就是你一直渴望、一直寻找、终于可以拥有的产品。我想说明的是，这篇评论虽然是针对免费收到的产品，但如实反映了我个人的使用体验，并且完全基于真实和公正的看法。

review_content: Es un dispositivo minuciosamente diseñado para facilitar la extracción de leche materna ofreciendo a la usuaria la enorme ventaja de llevarlo directamente en el interior de la ropa interior sin depender en absoluto de conexiones eléctricas externas ni mangueras largas. La estructura principal está dominada por una brida de silicona de 24 milímetros que proporciona un contacto extremadamente suave y agradable contra la piel, manteniendo los tejidos super frecos incluso en ambientes cálidos gracias a la excelente calidad de los materiales blandos empleados en su fabricación.El funcionamiento del pequeño motor se divide en tres modalidades muy bien diferenciadas mediante botones, siendo el modo de estimulación rápida mi gran favorito para iniciar el flujo de forma natural en los primeros minutos de la sesión. Me gustaría destacar muy especialmente que la unidad de bombeo es muy discreta en cuanto al ruido mecánico que emite trabajando, puedes tenerlo funcionando a pleno rendimiento mientras hablas tranquilamente por teléfono y la otra persona no escucha ningún zumbido extraño ni repetitivo de fondo. El contenedor transparente tiene un límite de llenado máximo de unos 150 mililitros, un volumen que se puede vaciar muy fácilmente en un biberón a través de un pequeño orificio superior destinado específicamente para tal fin. La única pequeña pega que podría ponerle a este diseño tan compacto es que el proceso de ensamblaje tras la limpieza diaria requiere bastante atención al detalle visual, debes asegurar con los dedos que la copa de silicona encaja a la perfección con la parte trasera de plástico duro para no perder en ningún momento el vacío generado por la pequeña válvula interior. Por suerte para nosotras, sustituir esa pequeña membrana elástica de retención es un reemplazo sin mayores complicaciones cuando el material empiece a desgastarse irremediablemente por el uso continuado de los lavados. Yo lo utilizo fundamentalmente como un apoyo extra por las tardes cuando mi extractor grande de pared me resulta demasiado aparatoso para montar encima de la mesa del salón.Me parece una herramienta estupenda y súper práctica para compaginar la etapa de lactancia con otras tareas urgentes del hogar, sobretodo porque aporta un nivel de comodidad brutal para las madres que simplemente no pueden permitirse parar su actividad diaria.
review_content_ch:
便携性与吸力之间的完美平衡
这是一款精心设计的设备，旨在方便母乳的抽取，为用户带来一个巨大的优势——可以直接放在内衣内部，完全无需依赖外部电源或长软管。主体结构由一个24毫米的硅胶法兰主导，与皮肤接触时极其柔软舒适，即使环境温暖，由于所用柔软材料的出色品质，也能保持组织非常凉爽。小电机的运行通过按钮分为三种非常明确的模式，其中快速刺激模式是我最喜欢的，可以在会话的前几分钟自然启动乳汁流动。我特别想强调，泵体在工作时发出的机械噪音非常小，你可以让它全速运转，同时平静地打电话，而对方听不到任何奇怪或重复的背景嗡嗡声。透明容器最大填充量约为150毫升，这个体积可以通过顶部专门为此设计的小孔轻松倒入奶瓶中。这个紧凑设计的唯一小缺点是，日常清洁后的组装过程需要非常注意视觉细节，你必须用手指确保硅胶杯与硬塑料后盖完美贴合，以免在任何时候丢失内部小阀门产生的真空。幸运的是，当那个弹性密封膜因持续洗涤而不可避免地磨损时，更换这个小部件并不复杂。我主要是在下午作为额外辅助使用，当我的大型壁挂式吸奶器放在客厅桌上显得太笨重时。我认为这是一款极好的、超级实用的工具，可以帮助哺乳期妈妈兼顾其他紧急家务，尤其是因为它为那些根本无法停止日常活动的妈妈提供了极大的舒适度。
review_summary: 优点：便携与吸力平衡好，可放入内衣内使用，无需外接电源或软管；24mm硅胶法兰柔软亲肤，材料优质，保持皮肤凉爽；三种模式，快速刺激模式好用；噪音极小，打电话时对方听不到；透明容器最大150ml，易倒入奶瓶；更换弹性膜简单。缺点：组装时需仔细对齐硅胶杯和硬塑料后盖，否则可能漏气。无质量或安全风险。

review_content: This Momcozy M5 was easy to set up both the actual breast pumps and the accompanying app for my daughter. The breast pumps were easy to charge with the supplied cable and the app is excellent at letting you know how charged each of the pumps are. The app is a great tracking tool so that you can see how much collection has taken place and from which side. You can also connect both breast pumps via the app, so that you can control both sides simultaneously. It is great that you can control the rate at which each of the pumps work and it is easy to identify which size flange is required with the supplied template.Each of the handsfree pumps were easy to pop into a top and then activate at the required setting. Once the pump is complete, you can remove and then place on a flat surface without fear of spillage.The pumps were easy to wash, dry and sanitise and then put the cap on each pump and then return it to its carry case.This breast pump is of an excellent quality, easy to set up and an app that helps any mum. My daughter found these Momcozy M5 hands free breast pumps incredibly helpful in her busy life.

review_content: Die Milchpumpe kam schnell geliefert bei uns an, ordentlich verpackt in einen sehr hochwertigen Koffer, der auch zur Aufbewahrung dient.Beim Auspacken die erste große Enttäuschung- bei uns war die Gebrauchsanleitung nur auf Englisch dabei... Ich spreche zwar recht gutes Englisch, aber manche Wörter lernt man eben erst, wenn man mit ihnen in Kontakt kommt und alles was mit Laktation zu tun hat, kam komischerweise im Leistungskurs nicht vor. ;-)Man muss sich also ziemlich durchwurschteln.In Zeiten, in denen selbst gratis Übersetzungstools passable Ergebnisse liefern, nicht wirklich befriedigend oder verständlich.Gut finde ich, dass eine Karte mitgeliefert wird, um die Nippelgröße in Erfahrung zu bringen.Weniger gut finde ich, dass bei mir gar nicht alle auf der Karte dargestellten Einsätze mitgeliefert wurden...Ich kann hier auch nicht erkennen, ob überhaupt und wenn ja ich diese nachbestellen könnte.Also los gehts mit den Aufsätzen, die am nächsten dran sind.Die Pumpen lassen sich schnell laden und eine Ladung hält eine erstaunlich lange Zeit.Das Zusammensetzen der Pumpe ist ein wenig tricky, vielleicht hätte eine Anleitung auf Deutsch Abhilfe geschaffen; so war viel Raten dabei.Pumpen kann man in zwei Modi, Stimulation der Milchbildung, sowie erhalt der Milchbildung (alles meine Laien-Übersetzungen).Die Pumpe hat dabei ordentlich Zug.Ich stille gerade K3 und habe Erfahrung im Stillen und Pumpen und ich empfinde Stufe 3 im Erhalt Programm gerade noch als angenehm - es gibt 9 Stufen.Die Pumpergebnisse sind super! Die Milch wird sehr zuverlässig aufgefangen und die Brust wird sehr effizient geleert.Das Ausschütten der Milch ist wieder eine Wissenschaft für sich. Ich habe schon 2 Mal kostbare Milch verschüttet und weiß nicht einmal warum... auch hier wäre eine Anleitung auf Deutsch vielleicht hilfreich.Man muss wirlich darauf achten, dass man die Pumpe richtig herum hält. Der Ausguss ist auch recht unsauber.A pros pros sauber: Reinigen lässt sich die Pumpe gut.Alles bis auf das elektronische Teil kann ausgekocht werden.Es ist aber übertrieben zu sagen, man könne mit der Pumpe quasi arbeiten gehen... kann man natürlich machen. Aber 1. ist Pumpe trotzdem noch ziemlich groß. Man sieht damit auch wie mit billigen Silikoneinsätzen. ^^ Sehr kantig und riesig.Dann ist sie 2. auch zu groß, um in meinem B Körbchen vollständig gehalten zu werden und auf dem Boden landen sollte die Pumpe wohl besser nicht.Und 3. ist die Pumpe trotzdem auch immer noch laut. Nicht ohrenbetäubend laut, aber durchaus Gesprächslautstärke laut....Weiß nicht, ob man damit im Großraumbüro sitzen möchte.Insgesamt eine solide Pumpe, die gute Ergebnisse liefert, aber Schwächen aufweist, die sie meiner Meinung nach für diesen Preis nicht haben sollte. Wir können uns nur zu drei bis vier Sternen durchringen.
review_content_ch:
如果价格更低，一些小缺点是可以原谅的……
吸奶器很快就送到了我们手上，包装整齐，装在一个非常高档的箱子里，这个箱子也用于存放。拆包时第一次大失望——我们附带的说明书只有英文……虽然我的英语说得不错，但有些单词只有接触到才会学到，而所有与哺乳有关的东西，奇怪的是在高级课程中都没有出现。;-) 所以你必须相当努力地摸索。在如今连免费翻译工具都能提供不错结果的时代，这并不令人满意或易懂。
我觉得好的是附赠了一张卡片，可以测量乳头尺寸。不太好的是，我收到的并非卡片上显示的所有配件都附带了……我也不清楚到底是否以及如果可以的话，我能否补购这些配件。于是开始使用最接近的配件。
吸奶器充电很快，一次充电可持续惊人的长时间。组装吸奶器有点棘手，也许德文说明书能有所帮助；现在只能靠猜测。吸奶器有两种模式：刺激产奶和维持产奶（都是我的外行翻译）。吸奶器吸力相当大。
我正在哺乳第三个孩子，有哺乳和吸奶的经验，我觉得维持模式下的第3档还算舒适——共有9个档位。吸奶效果非常好！奶水非常可靠地收集起来，乳房被非常有效地排空。
倒出奶水又是一门学问。我已经浪费了两次宝贵的母乳，甚至不知道为什么……如果这里有德文说明书也许会有帮助。必须非常注意正确握住吸奶器的方向。倒出口也不太干净。
顺便说清洁：吸奶器很容易清洁。除了电子部分，所有部件都可以煮沸消毒。
但说可以带着吸奶器去上班有点夸张……当然可以这样做。但第一，吸奶器还是相当大。戴上它看起来像戴着廉价的硅胶垫。^^ 非常棱角分明且巨大。第二，它太大了，无法完全放在我的B罩杯里，而且吸奶器最好不要掉到地上。第三，吸奶器仍然很吵。不是震耳欲聋的响，但确实有对话的音量……不知道是否有人愿意在开放式办公室里使用它。
总的来说，这是一款可靠的吸奶器，效果不错，但存在一些我认为这个价位不应该有的缺点。我们只能勉强给三到四颗星。
review_summary: 吸奶器包装精美，配送快速，但说明书只有英文版。配件不齐全，且无法确认是否能补购。吸力强劲，有9档调节，泵奶效果很好，但倒奶时容易洒出。体积较大，携带不便，噪音明显。清洁方便，但电子部分不可煮沸。整体性能不错，但价格偏高。

review_content: Je suis fan des produits Momcozy.Je n’ai jamais été déçu !J’ai testé le tire‑lait Momcozy M9 pendant plusieurs jours et je suis très satisfait de ses performances.Le format reste compact malgré un moteur de 3ᵉ génération, plus puissant et plus stable que les versions précédentes.Avec ses 302 g et des dimensions de 127 × 109 × 77 mm, il se porte facilement sous un vêtement et permet de rester mobile pendant l’utilisation.L’appareil propose une configuration très complète:– 2 recommandations professionnelles (Milk Relief pour soulager, Milk Boost™ pour stimuler la production)– 3 modes classiques (Stimulation, Expression, Mixte)– 15 niveaux d’aspirationCela permet d’ajuster précisément l’extraction selon la sensibilité et le moment de la journée. L’aspiration peut atteindre ‑300 mmHg, ce qui assure une efficacité optimale tout en restant confortable.La collerette fournie est en 24 mm, mais le fabricant propose aussi des embouts 17 / 19 / 21 mm, ce qui permet d’adapter parfaitement la taille au mamelon pour éviter les irritations.Le niveau sonore est particulièrement bas avec moins de 42 dB, ce qui rend l’utilisation très discrète, même la nuit.L’autonomie est un autre point fort.La batterie permet jusqu’à 150 minutes d’utilisation, soit 4 à 5 sessions, avec un arrêt automatique au bout de 30 minutes pour éviter la surutilisation.La recharge complète prend environ 2,5 heures via USB‑C.Le flacon intégré a une capacité de 150 ml, suffisante pour une session complète.Le démontage et le nettoyage des pièces en contact avec le lait sont simples et rapides.Dans l’ensemble, le Momcozy M9 est un tire‑lait portable performant, discret et très bien pensé, avec une vraie montée en gamme sur la puissance, la personnalisation et le confort d’utilisation. review_content_ch:
品质卓越且超级方便！
我是Momcozy产品的忠实粉丝，从未失望过！
我测试了Momcozy M9吸奶器数日，对其性能非常满意。尽管采用第三代电机，体积依然紧凑，动力比前代更强劲稳定。302克的重量和127×109×77毫米的尺寸，可轻松穿戴于衣物下，使用过程中保持移动自由。
设备配置非常全面：
– 2项专业推荐（舒缓模式的Milk Relief和促泌乳模式的Milk Boost™）
– 3种基础模式（刺激模式、泌乳模式、混合模式）
– 15档吸力调节
能根据敏感度和时段精准调整吸乳强度。吸力可达-300mmHg，在确保高效的同时保持舒适。
标配24mm护罩，厂商还提供17/19/21mm尺寸的吸乳护罩，完美适配乳头尺寸以避免摩擦。
运行时音量低于42分贝，夜间使用也足够安静。
续航是另一大亮点：电池支持150分钟连续使用（约4-5次吸乳），30分钟后自动停止以防过度使用，USB-C接口约2.5小时可充满电。
内置奶瓶容量150ml，满足单次完整吸乳需求。
与乳汁接触的部件拆洗便捷快速。
总体而言，Momcozy M9是一款高性能、静音且设计周到的便携吸奶器，在动力强度、个性化设置和使用舒适度上实现显著升级，是日常使用的可靠选择。

review_content: I purchased this pump for my wife and these are her thoughts...I am incredibly disappointed in the purchase and performance of this "new and improved" Momcozy M5 pump.I previously owned the Momcozy S9 pro and it served me well for my first baby. I was actually an over producer using that pump alone creating an impressive freezer stash so much so i had excess milk to donate. For this baby I was going to repurchase and saw that the S9 pro was being phased out so decided to "upgrade" to the M5.This is anything BUT an upgrade. I used it and it left me terribly engorged, on the brink of mastitis because it was terrible at removing milk. My nipples were bleeding and this is after purchasing different flange sizes thinking that was the problem.As a mother, postpartum is difficult enough without the added mental health impacts of not being able to feed your baby when you know you can.I decided to do a side by side comparison today using one side of the momcozy s9 pro vs the M5 as seen in the picture. (I only have one side of the s9 pro because the motor fell and broke during my last pregancy. As depicted I barely got an output of 1oz from the M5 while the S9 pro gave me 4oz and left my breast feeling lighter and less engorged and painful.I'm so disappointed in the performance of this pump and truly the inclusion of the app doesn't do anything that justifies an almost doubling in the price of this pump vs the S9 pro.So truly don't waste your time. If you can find the S9 pro get that one and Momcozy please rethink pulling this product from the market.Unfortunately we wasted money getting this and now have to go back and my husband hs agreed to graciouslu repurchase the S9 pro so that we are able to feed our baby and have a successful pumping journey again.Incredibly poor product, perhaps rethink the engineering of it.
review_content_ch:
千万别买这款吸奶器！！！
我给妻子买了这款吸奶器，以下是她的使用感受...我对这款号称"全新升级"的Momcozy M5吸奶器的购买体验和性能极其失望。之前用的Momcozy S9 pro陪伴我顺利度过了第一个宝宝的哺乳期——单靠它我甚至成了过量产奶妈妈，冻存了惊人量的母乳，多到可以捐赠。这次本打算回购S9 pro，发现该型号逐步停产，才决定"升级"到M5。
但这根本算不上升级。使用后我饱受涨奶之苦，几乎引发乳腺炎，因为它根本吸不出奶。换了不同尺寸的法兰也没用，乳头都出血了。产后本就不易，明知有奶却喂不了宝宝更让人心理崩溃。
今天我做了对比测试（如图），一边用momcozy s9 pro，一边用M5。（只剩单边s9 pro是因为上次孕期电机摔坏了）结果M5只吸出1盎司，而S9 pro吸出4盎司，且乳房明显更松软舒适。
这款吸奶器性能太差，所谓智能APP功能根本不值比S9 pro贵近一倍的价格。真心劝你别浪费钱。如果能找到S9 pro就买那个吧，Momcozy公司请考虑下架这款产品。我们白花了钱，现在不得不重新购买S9 pro——幸好丈夫同意再买一台，才能继续顺利喂养宝宝。
产品设计极差，建议回炉重造。

review_content: As a new parent I chose this breast pump to make feeding sessions more easier.
