It also feels more hygienic and well designed compared to older style pumps I have used before.Pump is compact, lightweight  and quite discreet under clothing, which makes it easy to use at home or even while out if needed. The battery life lasts through multiple sessions too, reducing the need for constant charging.It runs quietly, which is very helpful, especially during nighttime when the baby is sleeping. Cleaning is also manageable since it only has a few parts to wash and assemble.Overall, this is a modern, comfortable and efficient breast pump with customization options, portability and reliable performance. It makes pumping more flexible and less stressful for daily use. A must have.

review_content_ch:
喜欢它，但不确定为什么右边有泄漏。
它很漂亮。功能很酷。吸奶更快，同时对乳头温和。
用户手册没有提到应用程序，我是在看了YouTube评论后才弄明白的。
它也相当笨重，你需要一个相当大的文胸，所以它不是你工作时在办公室可以谨慎使用的吸奶器。它非常显眼，而且不像你想象的那么安静。
如果你的胸部较大，想象一下还要突出约7厘米。
我真的很想给它打5星，我真的很想向自己证明，我对momcozy产品价格过高的感觉是不对的。
所以我选择了它而不是Eufy，忽略了那些评论。
等到我的乳房相当充盈，我是奶量不足的人，所以需要很长时间才能达到那种状态。
左边感觉和右边不同。我能感觉到左边在排奶，右边则不太明显。而且因为加热和振动是开着的，乳房在漏奶。
结果我的加厚文胸湿透了。对我来说损失太大了！
我重新打开了每个部件，检查为什么奶水只是静止而没有进入收集器，重新组装，仍然无法阻止泄漏。
所以我把左边的换到右边，它就能吸了。然后把不好用的右边换到左边，让它完成吸奶，结果成功了！
所以是我的位置问题吗？那些关于泄漏的评论是真的吗？
图1 泄漏
图2 左边从两边都吸了
图3 右边在右边泄漏严重，但在左边表现还行。然后我再次把它放在右边，它确实能吸，但感觉我必须保持某个姿势。但我已经损失了大约60毫升宝贵的液体黄金。
感觉我必须僵硬地挺直身体，一动就会漏。也许我需要学习它或者买个更好的文胸？但可穿戴式吸奶器应该适合日常穿着，对吧？
它确实感觉笨重，所以我不知道胸部更大的人是否会觉得舒适。
手动按摩到腋下，按摩功能并不是你想象的那样针对乳房较宽的部分，但它可能对我得到的这些奶量有贡献！
加热功能很棒！

review_content:
J’ai testé ce tire-lait électrique Momcozy M5 pendant 10 jours, en l’utilisant 3 fois par jour pour tirer du lait. Le design mains libres a permis une utilisation confortable, même en multitâche (lecture, travail sur ordinateur). Les 3 modes (stimulation, expression, mixte) et les 9 niveaux de succion réglables (jusqu’à 250 mmHg) ont offert une personnalisation adaptée à mes besoins, avec un confort optimal grâce à la bride à double étanchéité de 24 mm.
Le bruit (environ 45 dB) est plutot discret, ce qui évite de déranger le bébé endormi à proximité.
La batterie, rechargée en 2 heures, a tenu 5 séances complètes (soit environ 2,5 heures d’utilisation) avant de nécessiter une recharge. Le réservoir de 150 ml par côté est suffisant pour une session standard, et le système de double pompage a permis de gagner du temps. Les accessoires (bouchons, adaptateurs) sont faciles à monter/démonter et compatibles avec le lave-vaisselle, même si je recommande de laver à la main avec du produit vaisselle sans parfum ni produit controversé.

Ce produit conviendra particulièrement aux mères exigeantes qui recherchent un tire-lait portable, personnalisable et discret pour un usage quotidien, le tout avec une fiabilité de la marque.

Le prix reste élevé par rapport à la concurrence, à voir sur la durée, c'est souvent ça qui va pêcher sur la justification du prix.

非常不错 我测试了这款Momcozy M5电动吸奶器10天，每天使用3次来吸奶。免提设计让使用舒适，即使多任务处理（阅读、电脑工作）也没问题。3种模式（刺激、吸乳、混合）和9个可调节的吸力级别（最高250 mmHg）提供了适合我需求的个性化设置，24毫米双重密封法兰带来了最佳舒适度。

这款产品特别适合那些寻求便携、可定制且低调的日常使用吸奶器的挑剔妈妈，而且品牌可靠。

价格相比竞品偏高，长期使用效果有待观察，这往往是决定价格是否合理的关键。

review_content_ch:
容易漏奶
我已经用了7个月，最终决定给它一个差评。这款吸奶器能用，外观也不错等等。但它并不是最舒适的。- 首先，吸奶器是通过顶部的一个小孔排空的，而且这个小孔从来不会保持关闭状态，因此根据动作的不同，奶水随时可能漏出。- 另一方面，理论上它的容量为180毫升，但实际上，一旦超过150毫升，奶水就会从乳头处的小孔回流。对于奶量不多的妈妈来说，每一滴都很珍贵，无缘无故损失20或30毫升对我来说非常重要。- 最后，它确实可以让你解放双手，但不能有太大的动作。如果你的想法是坐着敲电脑，那还可以；但如果你打算开车或在家里做家务，它最终会发生移动。所以好吧，如果是应急之用，且这是你唯一的选择，那它还能凑合用。但如果让我重新选择，我不会买这款。
review_summary: 用户使用7个月后给出差评：吸奶器能用、外观好看，但不够舒适；顶部小孔始终无法闭合，随动作随时可能漏奶；标称180ml容量，实际超过150ml奶就会从乳头孔回流，对奶量少的人损失20-30ml很重要；虽可解放双手但活动幅度受限，适合坐着打字，开车或做家务时会移动。用户认为仅作应急可用，但若重新选择不会购买。

review_content: First impression: Amazing! First of all, it comes with a little cut out size guide for helping determine what flange size you should be using. I am on my 3rd baby and it turns out I've been using the wrong size for years now. The set includes flange inserts for sizes 19mm, 21mm, and 24mm. The pump itself is 28mm. The flange is silicon and super comfortable. The pump itself feels very good quality, especially for the cheap price compared to the name brand wearable pumps. I decided to test these out before taking them to work with me and accidentally pumped out 3oz in a matter of minutes. This was after nursing my baby too. The suction is strong but comfortable. Compared to my spectra 2 and Ameda Maya, these were way more comfortable. I could forget that I was pumping, it was that comfortable. There wasn't any leakage for me, although I did not pump until I got to 5oz (the capacity for each collection cup). The ability to be hands-free and untethered felt amazing. Makes you feel like superwoman. I wouldn't go doing jumping jacks or handstands, but I could easily fold some laundry or do some computer work with these babies on. The pump itself isn't that loud, it sounds like a pump, but quieter than the Ameda Mya and maybe quieter than the Spectra, I think. I personally don't think I will be wearing these out in public though, because they make me look like I got a ridiculous boob job. They are not very discreet because they are bulky (not sure how it compares in size to other wearables). Maybe if you wore something loose or flowy it would be a little more discreet? Overall, I would say go for it though! If you've only ever used a standard pump, I think the freedom it gives you is worth it.
review_content_ch:
哇！
第一印象：太棒了！首先，它附带了一个小尺寸指南剪裁图，帮助确定应该使用多大的法兰尺寸。我已经是第三个孩子了，结果发现我多年来一直用错了尺寸。套装包含19mm、21mm和24mm的法兰垫片。吸奶器本身是28mm的。法兰是硅胶材质，超级舒适。吸奶器本身感觉质量很好，尤其是与名牌穿戴式吸奶器相比价格便宜。我决定在带去工作前先测试一下，结果几分钟内意外吸出了3盎司。这还是在我刚喂完宝宝之后。吸力强劲但舒适。与我的Spectra 2和Ameda Maya相比，这款舒适多了。我甚至会忘记自己在吸奶，就是这么舒服。虽然没有漏奶情况，但我没吸到5盎司（每个收集杯的容量）。无需手持和不受束缚的感觉太棒了。让你感觉自己像个女超人。虽然我不会穿着它做开合跳或倒立，但可以轻松叠衣服或用电脑工作。吸奶器本身噪音不大，听起来像吸奶器，但比Ameda Mya安静，可能比Spectra还安静。我个人不打算在公共场合穿戴，因为它们让我看起来像做了夸张的隆胸手术。不太隐蔽，因为体积较大（不确定与其他穿戴式产品相比尺寸如何）。也许穿宽松飘逸的衣服会稍微隐蔽些？总的来说，我会说买它吧！如果你只用过标准吸奶器，我认为它带来的自由感绝对值得。

这是个礼物，我真的很想喜欢它😫 我喜欢它的紧凑性。说明书清晰，附带了3种不同尺寸的插入件和乳头尺寸测量工具。首先，吸力只有在良好的紧身哺乳内衣支撑下才很好。其次，如果你想使用它们，你最好坐直，不要做任何需要弯腰或甚至抱宝宝的事情，或者试图把他们放下来睡觉，它们会关掉，即使是最轻微的倾斜动作也会关闭，这在我试图在宝宝睡着时吸奶和清洁时变得很烦人。第三，如果你把它拆开，你的手必须非常干燥，因为拆开清洗会变得很困难。我发现没有应用程序也很没用，一开始我不明白按钮的区别，但也觉得必须拿出手机才能启动到我喜欢的设置并追踪吸奶时间很烦人。我也觉得应用程序在追踪奶量方面没用，尤其是如果它不是我实际吸出的奶量，所以我停止使用它，甚至不再追踪我的奶量。我在住院期间使用医院提供的那台吸奶器时奶量很好，而使用这个我感觉我的奶量下降了，我低调地放弃了它😭 第一次当妈妈，你吃一堑长一智，但这台吸奶器不行。

review_content: I want to start by saying that I'm absolutely amazed in the advancements in baby care and breast pumps in the past 10 years. I think these wearable pumps are incredible to be honest. We are no longer saddled up to giant, heavy, noticeable backpacks/bags that made it almost impossible to do anything else while pumping. These wearable pumps have made it easier for us to do anything we want, while pumping which adds an extra layer of productivity to our day. It's no wonder the market is literally flooded with wearable pump options, ranging from very affordable (like this one) to astronomical. It is overwhelming and beyond stressful to pick not just the 'right one' but the 'right one for you'. I've been very fortunate in that (thanks to the Vine program) I've been able to try a few different wearable pumps. I also compare notes with my friends who are also using devices like this to see what they really think about the device they have. I've noticed a very common thread between about a dozen different brands that all drastically range in price- Not one of these pumps is 'Perfect'. While some may be better than others in the suction department, weight or the biggest variable of them all, battery life, one thing is clear to me...you really have to figure out what will work for your own personal needs because I've yet to use or find the perfect wearable pump. Before I get into product details I want to mention a few more things. My reviews are quite long and often read more like a blog than a short summary of my thoughts. I'm very opinionated and incredibly detail oriented, so I never want to leave anything out. I'm also an avid reader of reviews myself and rely on them heavily before I spend my hard earned coins. I like to include all the details I would want to read in a review in my own. I also take my responsibility as a Viner seriously. With that I want to mention that I am not owned or indebted to any company. I'm not here to sell you anything or make a commission. These are my honest thoughts. My goal is to make your decision to purchase easier and, if you do, you will know EXACTLY what to expect- no surprises. -THE PRODUCT- It is worth a mention that this pump is part of the P Series made by Paruu. They consider this the smallest and quietest series of pumps best for 'outdoor and work' and has the biggest suction (more milk, less time). According to the details on the box, this pump is designed in Germany and made in Hong Kong. -ARRIVAL AND PACKAGING- This pump set arrived super quick. The white, somewhat weighty branded box has a photo of the pump set on the front and is completely sealed in plastic. The box opens on a hinge to revel the pump set, all neatly packed and properly protected/wrapped inside. In the box are the set of pumps, each with its own charging cord, two separate sets of flanges (19mm and 21mm), a ruler to measure/find the right flange size, 2 valves, and an instruction manual. The instructions are well written and easy to follow. I will note that one of the other Paruu wearable pumps I tried came with a bra extender and I found that so thoughtful and useful. I was hoping one was included in this box, but sadly it wasn't. I believe it is probably because this pump is a slimmer profile/doesn't take up as much space. Even with that, I'm grateful I have that extender because it does come in handy with this pump. -ASSEMBLY, USAGE & CLEANING- These are pretty easy to put together, but If your dead tired or just distracted it can be a bit annoying- not because it's overly complicated rather because the pieces need to be just so. Once you get used to it, it gets easier- just like everything else. This is a VERY easy pump to use. The controls are on the top of the pump and I was a bit worried that they would be difficult to read/push, but that isn't the case at all. These are very easy to control. Plus, they have a memory function so if you like a certain combo you can set it to start that way from then on. The digital LCD screen is very easy to read. At first I thought that the screen was overkill/not necessary, but I quickly realized with all the different modes and strengths, the screen is a major help. There IS a very noticeable difference between the modes, and what you use is based on your preferences and time you have to pump. The different pump strengths (12 in this case) are a bit ridiculous, especially because 5-9 are basically the same. But, all these choices DO make for comfortable and effective collection. These also have a 30min off timer which can not be bypassed. In a way it's a nice function, but it can also be a pain. I feel like the off timer on this model can malfunction sometimes, shutting down the pumps all together. This is really a 'feature' that is quite unnecessary and I could do without. The collection container is pretty small (2oz), so if you are a high volume pumper, you will have to stop, empty and put the pump back together again. A big issue for me is that the pump is NOT spill proof, so if you are a heavy pumper, and you are distracted, plan on leaks and spills. You also can't lay down while pumping, which is really a big ask/stretch, but worth a mention. I really wish this had a cover (like the P10) to keep everything contained. Sure, that would be another part to clean, but for me it would be worth it. These pumps do not stay on the breast on their own, rather they have to be held in place with a bra. They are very comfortable to wear and lightweight too. I feel like the construction (although a bit complicated) is strong and durable. The P16 has a much slimmer profile than the P10 and some of the other brands that my friends have, so it is a nice option when you are at work or somewhere else and don't want to make it obvious that you are pumping. The pumps are definitely quiet. Sure, your partner will hear it if you are in bed next to them, but it is a quiet, rhythmic sound. With a bulky sweater/sweatshirt on over the pumps, they are barely audible. Like the P10 pump, this model is also a real pain to clean. I think that this is easily my biggest complaint about this pump. There are a lot of channels and groves that just are not easy to access and thoroughly clean. I get them clean (like...OCD clean) but it does take more time than I really would like to invest and it's another thing to stress out about. I watch in awe as one of my girlfriends takes apart her pump and has it sparkling clean in minutes- so easy, no stress. Her pump cost $200+ and while cleaning is a breeze, she gets just 1 single pump sesh per charge. So as I mentioned earlier, there is always a trade off it seems. -BATTERY- Each pump needs to be plugged in separate (Side note- I would seriously consider a USB charging tower if you are considering ANY wearable dual breast pump). Here is where this pump really shines- Each pump charges up in just under 2 hours, which is excellent (the friend with the one pump per charge takes about 4 hours to charge! 4!!). Depending on the mode and speed used (lower/mid speed= more pumps) I can get 4-5 pumps per single charge. Now, that is honestly incredible. I truly feel like the Paruu pumps have the absolute BEST batteries (charging time and life). It is a trade off i'm willing to make with the less than stellar cleaning. I want to be able to travel with my pumps (which I do) and not have to worry about them dying over the course of a day, a long flight or while i'm at work. These 100% deliver that to me and makes any of the other less than stellar qualities non-issues. -VALUE- This set of wearable pumps is VERY affordable! It's interesting because there is such a massive stretch between these types of pumps and price. I have noticed that sometimes with the more well known name brands, you are literally paying for the name and the quality is just NOT there. I think that is one of the things that makes Paruu pumps different- they have the quality and they are affordable and accessible to everyone. I feel that the price tag of this pump is quite reasonable, but as I write this, this unit is actually on sale for $50 and I can't even believe my eyes! Even at $70, I feel this is a good buy all around. One thing I am unable to comment on is customer service. I haven't needed to reach out to them yet (that is a good thing!), so I can't comment on how helpful they are. It seems to be the only way to contact them is through email (or Amazon customer service) so you really don't have many options and are left waiting for them to respond. I also want to mention that there is no warranty with these pumps and the Paruu return criteria is quite strict (returns within 30 days, no late returns accepted. Must be in original box, unopened and unused). You also don't have Amazon or the prime membership backing you on this purchase either, so you are at the mercy of Paruu. Again, I thankfully haven't had any issues with either of my pumps so far, so I can't really complain. This is just another example of the whole trade off thing again- low price = little to no support. -FINAL THOUGHTS- I do like this pump and I feel it is a very nice, affordable option. I do prefer the P10, which is a bit larger (more bulk, less spills, no shut off) but they are similar for the most part. This IS a great option when you want to pump almost completely undetected and while it is marketed for outside the home (where it really is super useful) it is great for in home use too.
review_content_ch:
值得喜欢的地方很多，但是……
首先我想说，过去10年里婴儿护理和吸奶器的进步让我无比惊叹。说实话，我觉得这些可穿戴吸奶器简直不可思议。我们终于不用再被那些又大又重又显眼的背包/袋子束缚着，用它们吸奶时几乎什么都做不了。这些可穿戴吸奶器让我们在吸奶的同时也能做任何想做的事，给一天增加了额外的工作效率。难怪市场上到处都是可穿戴吸奶器的选择，从非常实惠（比如这款）到天文数字都有。选择不仅是“对的”，更是“适合你的”，这让人压力山大。我非常幸运（多亏了Vine计划），能试几款不同的可穿戴吸奶器。我也会和也在用类似设备的朋友交流，看看她们对自己设备的真实看法。我注意到大约十几个不同品牌之间有一个非常普遍的共同点，这些品牌价格差异巨大——没有一款吸奶器是“完美”的。虽然有些可能在吸力、重量或最大的变量——电池续航上比别的更好，但有一点很清楚：你真的需要弄清楚什么适合你自己的需求，因为我还没用过或找到完美的可穿戴吸奶器。在进入产品细节之前，我想再提几件事。我的评论通常很长，读起来更像一篇博客，而不是简短的想法总结。我很有主见，而且非常注重细节，所以不想漏掉任何东西。我自己也是评论的忠实读者，在花辛苦钱之前非常依赖它们。我喜欢把自己想看的细节都写进自己的评论里。我也认真对待自己作为Viner的责任。我想说明的是，我不受任何公司的控制或恩惠。我不是来推销东西或拿佣金的。这些都是我真实的想法。我的目标是让你更容易做购买决定，如果你买了，你会确切知道能期待什么——没有意外。

——产品——
值得一提的是，这款吸奶器是Paruu生产的P系列的一部分。他们称这是该系列中最小巧、最安静的吸奶器，最适合“外出和工作”，并且吸力最大（更多奶，更少时间）。根据盒子上的信息，这款吸奶器在德国设计，在香港制造。

——到货和包装——
这套吸奶器到货超级快。白色的、有点沉的品牌盒子上正面有吸奶器套装的图片，完全用塑料密封。盒子通过铰链打开，露出吸奶器套装，所有东西都整齐地包装好，内部有适当的保护/包裹。盒子里有吸奶器套装，每个都有自己的充电线，两套独立的法兰（19mm和21mm），一把用于测量/找到合适法兰尺寸的尺子，两个阀门，以及一本说明书。说明书写得很好，容易理解。我要指出的是，我试过的另一款Paruu可穿戴吸奶器附赠了一个文胸延长扣，我觉得非常贴心且有用。我本来希望这款盒子里也有，但可惜没有。我相信可能是因为这款吸奶器更薄、不占太多空间。即便如此，我很感激我有那个延长扣，因为用它来配这款吸奶器确实很方便。

——组装、使用和清洁——
这些组装起来相当容易，但如果你累得要死或分心了，可能会有点烦——不是因为太复杂，而是因为零件需要安装得刚刚好。一旦习惯了，就会变得容易——就像其他事情一样。这是一款非常容易使用的吸奶器。控制按钮在吸奶器顶部，我有点担心它们难以看清或按下，但事实并非如此。这些非常容易控制。另外，它们有记忆功能，所以如果你喜欢某种组合，可以设置成以后从那个模式开始。数字液晶屏非常容易阅读。起初我觉得屏幕有点多余/没必要，但我很快意识到，有了这么多不同的模式和强度，屏幕帮了大忙。模式之间确实有非常明显的区别，你使用哪种取决于你的偏好和吸奶时间。不同的吸力强度（这款有12个）有点离谱，尤其是因为5到9基本上是一样的。但是，所有这些选择确实让吸奶变得舒适且高效。它们还有一个30分钟的自动关闭定时器，无法跳过。从某种意义上说，这是一个不错的功能，但有时也很烦人。我觉得这款型号的自动关闭定时器有时会出故障，导致吸奶器完全关闭。这真是一个相当不必要的“功能”，我宁愿没有。集奶容器相当小（2盎司），所以如果你是奶量大的妈妈，你不得不停下来，倒空，然后重新组装吸奶器。对我来说一个大问题是吸奶器不防漏，所以如果你奶量大，又分心，就要准备好漏奶和洒奶。你也不能在吸奶时躺下，这其实是个很大的要求/过分了，但值得提一下。我真希望这款有一个盖子（比如P10那种）来保持所有东西不洒出来。当然，那会多一个要清洗的部件，但对我来说值得。这些吸奶器不能自己固定在乳房上，而是需要用文胸固定住。它们佩戴起来非常舒适，也很轻。我觉得构造（虽然有点复杂）很坚固耐用。P16比P10和我朋友用的其他一些品牌薄得多，所以当你在工作或其他地方，不想让别人明显看出你在吸奶时，这是一个很好的选择。吸奶器确实很安静。当然，如果你躺在床上的伴侣在旁边，他会听到，但那是一种安静的、有节奏的声音。如果外面套一件厚毛衣/卫衣，几乎听不见。和P10吸奶器一样，这款型号清洗起来也很麻烦。我认为这很容易成为我对这款吸奶器最大的抱怨。有很多通道和凹槽不容易触及和彻底清洁。我能把它们洗干净（像……强迫症一样干净），但确实需要比我愿意投入的时间更多，而且这是另一件让人焦虑的事。我羡慕地看着我的一个朋友拆开她的吸奶器，几分钟内就洗得闪闪发光——如此容易，毫无压力。她的吸奶器花了200多美元，虽然清洗轻松，但每次充电只能吸一次奶。所以正如我之前提到的，似乎总是有取舍。

——电池——
每个吸奶器需要单独插电（顺便说一句，如果你考虑任何可穿戴双吸奶器，我真的会考虑一个USB充电塔）。这是这款吸奶器真正出色的地方——每个吸奶器充电只需不到2小时，这非常棒（那个每次充电只能吸一次奶的朋友大约需要4小时充电！4小时！）。根据使用的模式和速度（较低/中速=更多次吸奶），我一次充电可以吸4到5次奶。说实话，这真的太棒了。我真的觉得Paruu吸奶器有绝对最好的电池（充电时间和使用寿命）。这是我愿意接受的取舍，尽管清洗不那么出色。我希望能够带着吸奶器旅行（我确实这么做了），而不用担心它们在一整天、一次长途飞行或工作中没电。这款吸奶器100%满足了我这个需求，也让其他不那么出色的品质变得无关紧要。

——价值——
这套可穿戴吸奶器非常实惠！有趣的是，这类吸奶器之间价格差异巨大。我注意到有时那些更知名的品牌，你基本上是在为名字付费，而质量却根本不在那里。我认为这也是Paruu吸奶器与众不同的原因之一——它们有质量，而且价格实惠，人人都能买得起。我觉得这款吸奶器的价格相当合理，但在我写这段时，这款实际上正在促销，只要50美元，我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛！即使是70美元，我也觉得这是一笔划算的买卖。有一件事我无法评论，那就是客户服务。我还没有需要联系他们（这是好事！），所以我无法评论他们有多乐于助人。似乎联系他们的唯一方式是通过电子邮件（或亚马逊客服），所以你真的没有太多选择，只能等待他们回复。我还想提一下，这些吸奶器没有保修，Paruu的退货条件相当严格（30天内退货，不接受逾期退货。必须原盒、未开封、未使用）。你也没有亚马逊或Prime会员的支持来保障这次购买，所以你只能听Paruu的。再说一次，幸运的是，到目前为止我的两个吸奶器都没有任何问题，所以我真的没什么可抱怨的。这只是另一个关于取舍的例子——低价=几乎没有支持。

——最终想法——
我确实喜欢这款吸奶器，我觉得它是一个非常好、实惠的选择。我更喜欢P10，它稍微大一点（更笨重，更少洒漏，没有自动关闭），但它们在大多数方面是相似的。当你想几乎完全不被察觉地吸奶时，这款是一个很好的选择，虽然它被宣传为适合外出使用（在那里它确实非常有用），但它在家中使用也很棒。

review_content: I bought the nude. Wish I had bought the champagne as I didn’t realize the nude doesn’t have a way to stand on its own (champagne comes with covers that work as stands). I have the Eufy pump and wanted a secondary pump that was inexpensive so I bought this. It works but you definitely get what you pay for. It is louder than my Eufy but not terrible. It pumps, wish it would stand on its own. The duck bill and diaphragm are very cheap material. I have used this pump 3 times and one duck bill already needs to be replaced. This pump gets the job done. You get what you pay for. I don’t see this pump lasting long and for that reason I would not buy it again. If you want a cheap pump as an extra this is good. If you want a pump for daily use and longevity I’d look elsewhere. The suction is good and I have had no problem with milk production. Though it has leaked on me (user error in not ensuring the back was fully on). I would go on to say that clearly Paruu has spent a lot of money on advertising. I would suggest the “Nicegreen” pump sold on Amazon over this pump. It is $50 the diaphragm is easier to install, clean, and dry, it comes with a case and extra diaphragm and duckbills and over all seems much better than the Paruu. Trust me it’s worth checking out.
review_content_ch:
忘掉这个，去买 NiceGreen 吸奶器。
我买了裸色。真希望我买了香槟色，因为我没意识到裸色没法自己立起来（香槟色配有能当底座用的盖子）。我有 Eufy 吸奶器，想要一个便宜的备用吸奶器，所以买了这个。它能用，但确实一分钱一分货。它比我的 Eufy 声音大，但也不是很糟糕。能吸奶，真希望它能自己立起来。鸭嘴阀和吸力碗材质非常廉价。我用这个吸奶器3次，已经有一个鸭嘴阀需要更换了。这个吸奶器能完成工作。一分钱一分货。我觉得这个吸奶器用不了多久，因此我不会再买它。如果你想要一个便宜的备用吸奶器，这个还行。如果你想要日常使用且耐用的吸奶器，我会另找别家。吸力很好，我产奶没有任何问题。虽然它漏过奶（是我自己的失误，没有确保背面完全安装好）。我还要说，很明显 Paruu 在广告上花了很多钱。我建议买亚马逊上卖的“Nicegreen”吸奶器，而不是这个。它50美元，吸力碗更容易安装、清洗和干燥，还配有收纳盒、额外的吸力碗和鸭嘴阀，整体上似乎比 Paruu 好得多。相信我，值得去看看。
review_summary: 用户购买了裸色款吸奶器，发现无法独立站立（香槟款配有可作支架的盖子）。吸奶器能用但噪音较大，鸭嘴阀和隔膜材质廉价，使用三次后已有部件需更换。虽然吸力足够且不影响产奶量，但发生过漏奶（因后盖未完全闭合）。用户认为该产品适合作为备用机，不建议长期使用，并推荐亚马逊上另一款性价比更高的Nicegreen吸奶器。

review_content: I love Momcozy products. I have purchased pumping bras, maternity post delivery kits, postpartum products, pumps, milk coolers/warmers, I am totally in love with the innovation and the items that they produce. However, out of the three pumps that I have owned from Momcozy, (M5, M9, Air 1) 2/3 of them have failed on me super early. I am an under producer, and I have to pump literally every hour to produce at least 17.9fl oz of milk for my 8 week old newborn. It has been this way since week 5 postpartum. So I am back to back with the pumps and power pumping, it is my main pump because I have a Spectra S2 and even with the proper fitting flanges-- my breasts just DO NOT respond to it the same way they do to the Air 1. What is even more awesome for me is the fact that the case recharges the pumps. I never have to worry about charging the pumps with a cord, I charge the case once a week and I am good! It is truly a blessing. The pump empties me perfectly for what I put out. I haven't felt like splurging and trying the eufy it is more expensive than the Momcozy and does not have as many positive reviews for the price. But one thing I cannot abide by is the longevity of the pumps once I have them for more than a couple of months. With my M5, it failed on me after two weeks. They refused to turn on, show a display light, or show any sign of life for THREE WHOLE MONTHS. I had to order another set of pumps on short notice which were the M9s, and I never had that issue with those. It was the first pump at the time to connect to the app and you could control it from the app which was so so helpful. Then after I had ordered the new M9 pump, literally two days later they started working again after three months of no life. I hadn't got water in the motors or suction functions, it just refused to work! Then, I upgraded from the M9 because I did not want to rely solely on a momcozy pump as my main pump because of a 50/50 chance it might fail on me with consistent use-- then I got the Air 1. I've been using it for five months and all of a sudden the case was only charging on one side and wouldn't charge for days. Then it started working all of a sudden again, and charging on both sides. But then my left breast pump which is the pump for my highest producing breast went out. It wouldn't make any suction just clicking noises. It will show that the pump is on but it won't pump!! It'll start working at random times and it is not what I need! I need consistency! It's been out for five days only randomly powering on 1-2 times in that time frame! I care for my pumps very carefully never dropped them never got water in the suction points or anything like that so I am disgusted. Come on momcozy we are paying so much money for these pumps the least we could do is get a year of use out of them at LEAST. I am so disappointed.
review_content_ch:
很失望。
我非常喜欢 Momcozy 的产品。我购买过哺乳文胸、产后护理套装、产后用品、吸奶器、母乳冷藏/加热器，我完全着迷于他们的创新和所生产的产品。然而，在我拥有的三台 Momcozy 吸奶器（M5、M9、Air 1）中，有三分之二很早就坏了。我的奶量较少，为了给我8周大的新生儿提供至少17.9液盎司的母乳，我真的必须每小时吸奶一次。从产后第5周开始就是这样。所以我接连不断地使用吸奶器和强化吸奶模式，它是我主要的吸奶器，因为我有一台 Spectra S2，但即使使用了合适尺寸的法兰，我的乳房对它的反应就是不如对 Air 1 那样好。更让我觉得棒的是，充电盒可以为吸奶器充电。我再也不用担心用线缆给吸奶器充电了，我每周给充电盒充一次电就够了！这真的是一种福音。这台吸奶器能完美地排空我产生的乳汁。我一直没舍得花钱去尝试 eufy，因为它比 Momcozy 更贵，而且就价格而言，好评也没有那么多。但我无法忍受的一点是，这些吸奶器在我使用几个月后的耐用性。我的 M5 在使用两周后就坏了。整整三个月，它们拒绝开机，不显示屏幕灯光，也不显示任何生命迹象。我不得不紧急订购另一套吸奶器，也就是 M9，而我没有遇到过那些问题。当时它是第一款可以连接应用程序的吸奶器，你可以通过应用程序控制它，这非常非常有帮助。然后，在我订购了新的 M9 吸奶器后，仅仅两天后，它们在沉寂了三个月后突然又开始工作了。我的电机或吸力功能并没有进水，它就是拒绝工作！后来，我从 M9 升级了，因为我不想仅仅依赖一台 Momcozy 吸奶器作为我的主要吸奶器，毕竟它有50%的几率会在持续使用中坏掉——然后我得到了 Air 1。我已经使用了五个月，突然之间充电盒只能为一侧充电，并且几天都无法充电。然后它又突然开始工作，两侧都能充电了。但随后我的左侧吸奶器（用于我产奶量较高的那一侧乳房）坏了。它没有任何吸力，只有咔哒声。它会显示吸奶器已开启，但它不吸奶！！它会随机时间开始工作，而这并不是我需要的！我需要稳定性！它已经坏了五天，在这段时间内只随机开机了一两次！我非常小心地爱护我的吸奶器，从未摔落过它们，吸力点也从未进过水或类似情况，所以我感到厌恶。拜托了 Momcozy，我们花了这么多钱买这些吸奶器，我们至少应该能让它们使用一年吧。我太失望了。
review_summary: 用户对Momcozy失望：虽喜爱品牌并购买多款产品，但三个吸奶器中两个过早故障。M5用两周后无法开机/显示，三个月后才恢复；Air1用五个月后充电盒仅单侧充电，左侧泵无吸力只咔哒响、随机恢复，已故障五天。M9曾正常，App控制有用。用户需稳定，认为高价应至少用一年。充电盒一周一充方便，排空效果好。

review_content: I have not gotten to use the product yet, but reviews are positive. I will update when I can use them. As for negative reviews, these are exactly what they are advertised to be. They are REPLACEMENT PARTS. They REPLACE your current cups. They are advertised to work with MULTIPLE different pumps. THEY ARE NOT ADVERTISED TO COME WITH A PUMP. THEY DO NOT COME WOTH A PUMP, for those complaining about the price. Look in the the price of replacement collection cups for Momcozy, medela or many other brands. You’ll see they are between $80-$100. So the price isn’t expensive in comparison, if you look up the price of wearable pumps. You’ll find them to be around $200 when they are hospital grade, and have a separate motor/ hoses. This is not a pump, as long as you go in with the expectation that it is a set of replacement parts it is advised to be. NOT A WEARABLE PUMP, then you won’t be disappointed.
review_content_ch:
别指望它是它本身不是的东西，你就不会失望。

导致乳腺堵塞
我因为这款吸奶器的按摩和加热功能而购买，希望找到一款更舒适的吸奶器。然而，“按摩”功能只是振动，我原以为它会像滚珠一样转圈来刺激乳汁流动。此外，加热功能并没有真正热起来，或者几乎不热。最后，因为使用这款吸奶器，我出现了乳腺堵塞，奶量也减少了。总的来说，这款吸奶器用起来很舒服，但要注意它可能会导致乳腺堵塞和奶量减少。在继续使用我的 Eufy 吸奶器后，我的奶量恢复了，也没有再出现乳腺堵塞。
review_summary: 用户因按摩和加热功能购买该吸奶器，希望更舒适；但按摩仅为振动，并非循环揉动刺激奶流，加热功能几乎不升温。使用后出现堵奶且奶量下降。用户认为吸奶器舒适，但提醒可能堵奶和减少奶量；换回Eufy吸奶器后奶量恢复且不再堵奶。

review_content_ch:
比微波炉加热的凝胶袋麻烦少
我有两台吸奶器，分别是 Leneige 和这一台。用 Leneige 时，我买了需要在微波炉里加热的乳房热敷袋，它们也挺有用，但耗时更长，而且我得小心别加热过度，否则就得等一会儿才能用。用我的 Momcozy 吸奶器时，我用了 Leneige 提供的同款加热凝胶袋，过程同样烦人。现在换了这个法兰，情况就不一样了。它可能没有微波炉加热的那种热，但温度足够让我舒适地吸奶，而且没那么麻烦。它由耐用材料制成，便于携带，轻松就能放进我的妈咪包，适合公路旅行时使用。它看起来就像普通的法兰，只是更先进一些。我买的是 24mm 尺寸，稍微有点小，但还是能完成任务。由于硅胶材质非常柔软，我没有感到任何不适。如果你不确定自己的尺寸，我觉得 24mm 是个不错的选择：如果太大，它依然能用，只是覆盖面积更大；如果太小，它肯定也能覆盖宝宝通常吮吸的乳头区域。对我来说，它覆盖的范围反正比乳头大得多。价格很划算，我想知道价格是否会保持这样。鉴于这是新产品，我猜想过段时间价格可能会上涨。
review_summary: 该吸乳护罩比微波加热凝胶包更省事；加热温度虽不如微波款，但足够舒适。产品材质耐用、便携，可放入尿布包用于自驾出行，外观像普通护罩但更先进。24mm尺寸略小仍能完成吸奶，硅胶柔软无不适；认为尺寸不确定时24mm是不错选择，偏大也能用且覆盖范围更大。价格实惠，但担心新品之后可能涨价。

review_content: It’s ok… I’ve exclusively pumped with both my boys and have owned 4 pumps so I’d like to think I have a good idea of a good and bad pump. This one in particular is soooo loud. I won’t be able to use them when I go back to work and am on meetings (I work remote). The suction is quite strong which can either be a good or bad thing. I wish pump companies would come out with a dual charging cord with one wall plug in, would make charging so much more efficient! I do like that the fact that this pump can hold a lot of milk! I’m an over suppler so that’s a huge plus for me. I don’t have to stop a pump session half way through, dump it out and keep going so I love that. And super easy to clean which is a huge plus. Overall, it’s ok. There’s better options out there but for the price, it’s ok.

还行……我两个儿子都是纯瓶喂，用过的吸奶器有4台了，所以我觉得自己对吸奶器的好坏还是有点概念的。这款特别吵。我回去上班后没法用，因为我在家远程办公，经常要开会。吸力挺强的，这既是优点也是缺点。吸力强有助于提高出奶量，但有时候会有点不舒服。如果我刚生完宝宝就用这款，可能会太疼了。真希望吸奶器厂商能推出那种带一个墙插的双头充电线，这样充电效率会高很多！我确实喜欢这款吸奶器的集乳容量很大！我是奶量过剩的妈妈，所以这对我来说是个很大的加分项。我不必在吸奶中途停下来倒掉乳汁再继续，这一点我很喜欢。而且超级容易清洗，这也是个大优点。总的来说，还行。虽然市面上有更好的选择，但考虑到价格，还算可以。

review_content: I have had this pump now for a couple of months. At first, I hated this pump. I was used to my wall pump and this one hurt me, but I have figured it out. Try multiple flange inserts until you find the correct one. My wall pump I would pump at a level 6, the wearable I only pump at highest of level 3. I also use the pulse feature… I have no clue what it is called. I believe it gives me the same output as the wall pump. I actually started using this as my main pump. I thought I would like the case but I actually don’t use it. Once it is used I keep it in a bag in the fridge or cooler and wash twice a day. I can get 24 hours out of the battery life.
review_content_ch:
全天候使用吸奶器
我使用这款吸奶器已经有几个月了。起初，我很讨厌它。我之前习惯用壁挂式吸奶器，而这款让我感到疼痛，但我后来摸索出了方法。多尝试几种法兰内衬，直到找到合适的那一款。我用壁挂式吸奶器时开到6档，而用这款穿戴式吸奶器时最高只开到3档。我还使用脉冲功能……我不确定它具体叫什么名字。我觉得它的出奶量和壁挂式吸奶器一样。实际上，我现在把它当作我的主力吸奶器。我原以为我会喜欢那个收纳盒，但实际上我并没有使用。使用后，我把它放在冰箱或冷藏袋里的袋子中保存，每天清洗两次。电池续航可以达到24小时。
review_summary: 使用可穿戴吸奶器数月，初期因疼痛很讨厌，后通过尝试不同法兰插件找到合适尺寸而适应。墙式吸奶器需开到6档，这款最高只用3档，并使用名称不清楚的脉冲功能，产出与墙式吸奶器相同，现已作为主力吸奶器。本以为会喜欢收纳盒，但实际不用；使用后放进冰箱或冷藏包中的袋子，每天清洗两次，电池续航可达24小时。

review_content: I would love to give this 5 stars but unfortunately after a couple weeks one of the motors went haywire. It started increasing suction on its own causing pain and would make a buzzing noise even after it was turned off. The motor clearly malfunctioned. The first couple weeks were great. It was easy to use and extremely convenient. You have to wear a sturdy bra to hold it in place and don’t bend over while pumping or your milk will spill out. It’s also not the easiest to pour out after pumping , milk drips out of the intake and you have to maneuver the pump correctly to get all the milk out.
review_content_ch:
电机故障
我很想给这款产品打五星，但不幸的是使用几周后其中一个电机失控了。它会自动增加吸力导致疼痛，甚至在关闭后仍会发出嗡嗡声。电机明显故障了。前几周使用体验很棒，操作简单且非常方便。使用时必须穿稳固的文胸固定吸奶器，且挤奶时不能弯腰否则会洒奶。挤奶后倒出乳汁也不太方便，乳汁会从吸入口滴落，必须正确操作吸奶器才能倒干净。
review_summary: 使用几周后电机故障，自行增加吸力导致疼痛，关闭后仍有嗡嗡声。前期好用方便。需穿结实胸罩固定，弯腰会漏奶；倒奶时奶从进气口滴出，不易倒净。

review_content: I was needing a hands free pump and decided on this one instead of the more expensive name brands. I don’t regret it. I would say my only complaint is the battery life. That’s what drops it to 4 starts. After just two sessions they’re needing to recharge or they won’t pump as strong. I highly recommend for pumping moms on a budget.

review_content: I like it, but don’t love it. Pros: easy to clean and put together. I feel like the pump gives me decent output for a wearable. It sits up, which I do love. My last wearable did not and I lost a lot of milk. Some people have great output with it, but I personally get more with my spectra, so I only use these when driving to and from my job. The battery lasts for a few uses before needing charging and I like that you can see in it to make sure your nipple is aligned. It’s not very loud, which is great. Also, the numbers on the side showing the amount is nice. Cons: The massage is a vibration, not a massage and the heat is barely warm. I can’t even feel it. Not sure if it makes a difference at all I output/preventing clogs, but I guess it’s a good feature. It’s bulky and heavy, so you need a bra with a good support on the bottom to hold it up and you can’t wear it discreetly, if that’s your goal. Overall, it’s convenient, but I don’t think it’s worth the price.
review_content_ch:
不错，但对我来说不值这个价。
我喜欢它，但谈不上爱。优点：易于清洁和组装。我觉得这款吸奶器作为穿戴式产品，出奶量还算可以。它能直立放置，这点我很喜欢。我上一款穿戴式吸奶器不能直立，导致我浪费了很多奶。有些人用它出奶量很好，但我个人用我的 Spectra 吸奶器出奶更多，所以我只在上下班开车时使用这款。电池在需要充电前可以使用几次，而且我喜欢它可以透明观察，确保乳头对齐。噪音不大，这点很棒。另外，侧面显示奶量的数字也很实用。缺点：按摩功能是振动式的，并非真正的按摩，而且加热功能 barely warm（几乎感觉不到热度）。我甚至感觉不到它在加热。不确定这是否对出奶量或防止堵奶有任何影响，但我想这算是一个不错的功能。它体积大且重，所以需要一件底部支撑力好的文胸来托住它，如果你希望隐蔽佩戴，那这款做不到。总的来说，它很方便，但我觉得不值这个价。
review_summary: 用户认为产品方便但对本人不值这个价：易清洁组装，穿戴式吸奶量尚可，坐姿设计减少漏奶，可查看乳头对齐，噪音低，侧面有容量数字；但按摩仅振动、加热几乎无感，机身笨重需强支撑内衣且无法隐蔽佩戴，个人用Spectra吸得更多，仅在通勤时使用，电池可用几次。

review_content: I actually love these pumps. They are handsdown the best designed pumps I’ve ever had. It actually made pumping milk and creating my freezer supply accessible during this second pregnancy. Especially with a toddler, it’s important to have a hands free portable option. However, we are now at 12 weeks of use and the charging mechanism has broken. The case is not charging the pumps and it looks like the right pump can’t charge at all. I woke up enraged about this, especially as I’m trying to get my supply up for daycare and returning to work in 3 weeks I don’t have much time to waste. And those of us that have figured out the formula of increasing breastmilk know that pumping on a schedule is key. Now i will have to spend time getting a new pump hopefully through customer service. For the price these pumps should LAST. Every mother AND infant deserves a pump that will last and not some marketing scheme. Thank god my child takes a breast and bottle otherwise running into these types of challenges would hit a lot harder. Momcozy you make great products just make sure they’re durable and last
review_content_ch:
本来很喜欢，直到充电出现故障
我真的很喜欢这款吸奶器。它们绝对是我用过的设计最好的吸奶器。在第二次怀孕期间，它确实让挤奶和建立冷冻母乳储备变得可行。尤其是要照顾一个蹒跚学步的孩子时，拥有一个解放双手的便携式选项非常重要。然而，我们使用了12周后，充电机制坏了。充电盒无法给吸奶器充电，而且看起来右边的吸奶器完全无法充电。我醒来时对此感到愤怒，尤其是因为我正试图为3天后送托儿所和重返工作岗位增加奶量，我没有太多时间可以浪费。那些掌握了增加母乳分泌秘诀的人都知道，按时挤奶是关键。现在我不得不花时间通过客服去获取一台新的吸奶器。以这个价格，这些吸奶器应该更耐用。每一位母亲和婴儿都值得拥有一台经久耐用的吸奶器，而不是某种营销噱头。谢天谢地，我的孩子既吃母乳也接受奶瓶，否则遇到这类挑战会让我更加难受。Momcozy，你们的产品很棒，但请确保它们耐用且持久。
review_summary: 用户曾很喜欢这款吸奶器，认为设计出色、免手扶便携，帮助其在二胎期间吸奶并建立冷冻母乳储备；但使用12周后充电机制损坏，收纳盒无法充电，右侧吸奶器完全无法充电。用户对此非常愤怒，因为正需按计划吸奶以提高奶量并为3周后返岗做准备，还要花时间联系客服换新；认为按此价格产品应更耐用，并希望品牌确保产品耐用。

review_content_ch: 除非你的老板特别通情达理，否则你没法坐在办公桌前用吸奶器。听说过“只闻其声，不见其人”吗？用这款吸奶器时，我在办公室往往是先被听到，才被看到。我收到的根本不是那种超静音的款式……第一天在办公桌旁使用时，所有同事都问：“那是什么声音？”太搞笑了。我还让老板的上司尴尬不已，他过来问我问题，结果话说到一半停下来问：“那是什么声音？”我告诉了他，他脸红着迅速离开了，哈哈。撇开这点不说，我确实喜欢它的易用性，而且吸出的奶量似乎也不错。但我发现有些部位很难清洗，而且电池续航也不怎么样。真希望不用像现在这样频繁充电。我觉得充一次电大概只能用1.5次。

review_content: My daughter was in the picu for almost a month and I was using hospital grade pumps when my milk started to tank. I bought this in attempt to be able to care for her in the hospital while not being attached to a machine. Not only did I get more milk out it changed my whole experience in being able to physically care for my baby while pumping milk for her at the same time. There were times where she would fuss in her crib because she was attached to monitors and wanted to be held but I was pumping with the hospitals pump which was plugged in and kept me limited. Overall awesome for the price.
review_content_ch:

review_summary: 产品帮助用户在住院期间同时照顾婴儿和吸奶，解决了医院吸奶器限制行动的问题，提高了产奶量，性价比高。

review_content: I absolutely love this product! After having two kids, I was a little worried that I would not have time to pump for my third child. However, with this product, I’m able to to my two elders, wash, dishes, fold laundry, run around the house with my head, cut off, and also make dinner! I would definitely recommend to purchase this if you’re looking to jump into the hands-free pumping world but don’t want to spend hundreds of dollars on brand-name pumps. My only concern is that one of the pumps stopped working after using it for about a month. I’m not too sure why or what happened one day it was fine and then the next following morning it just would not turn on for me. However, the pump does come with a 12 month warranty inside of the box so I am hoping that the company will help me either replace the parts or send me a new pump. I will update this post once I have more details as to how that replacement goes. And that will determine if my three stars turn back to five.
review_content_ch:

review_content: My babe is 2 months old now. I got this pump early on because someone gave me an Amazon gift card and I was contemplating it already.. I went back to work after 6 weeks (thanks America) but I needed a pump that I could still work while pumping or I would gl crazy! So I purchased this! First impression I LOVED it! After about 2-3 weeks I noticed there was this strange sound. I assumed it was one of the motors... I was bummed. BUT, I was still in the return/replace window so I decided to do a replacement. So for a small window I had 2 full sets. I used the new motors with the original parts and I still heard the sound! I figured I got another faulty motor... so as I was trying to figure out which motors were faulty to send back, I made the realization it wasn't the motors after all! I did not trouble shoot to see which part was faulty but it wasn't the motors. New realization.... the past few days I've been using my spectra a bit just because of cleaning convenience and long story short... the paruu is superior! I had a clogged duct and the paruu got it out with a higher suction and a little help from a massager! I've sent the link to this thing to all my pregnant and new mommy friends! 10/10!
review_content_ch:
哇！你真的需要这个！
我的宝宝现在2个月大了。我很早就买了这款吸奶器，因为有人给了我一张亚马逊礼品卡，而且我之前就在考虑买它...我在6周后重返工作岗位（感谢美国），但我需要一个可以边工作边使用的吸奶器，否则我会疯掉的！所以我买了这个！第一印象我超爱它！大约2-3周后，我注意到有一种奇怪的声音。我以为是其中一个电机的问题...我很沮丧。但是，我还在退换货期限内，所以我决定换一个。所以有一小段时间我有两套完整的设备。我用新电机搭配原来的部件，还是能听到那个声音！我以为又拿到了一个有问题的电机...就在我试图找出哪个电机有问题要退回时，我意识到根本不是电机的问题！我没有排查是哪个部件有问题，但肯定不是电机。新发现...最近几天我偶尔会用我的spectra吸奶器，主要是为了方便清洁，长话短说...paruu更胜一筹！我有一次乳腺管堵塞，paruu用更强的吸力和按摩器的一点帮助就解决了！我已经把这个链接发给了我所有怀孕和新手妈妈的朋友们！10/10满分！
review_summary: 优点：吸力大，能解决堵奶问题，比Spectra吸奶器表现更好。缺点：使用2-3周后出现不明异响（非电机问题），原因未明确。

review_content: I truly wish I had known about this the first time I breastfed. I always felt like my pump never fit quite right, but I now realize my flanges were slightly too large and likely impacted my comfort and pumping experience. I highly recommend purchasing this sizer and measuring toward the end of pregnancy, since sizing can change throughout pregnancy and postpartum. I also recommend rechecking your size after birth to ensure you have the best possible fit once your milk comes in. I’m so glad I saw an influencer recommend this tool — it’s such a simple thing that can make a huge difference, and I wish more new moms knew about it before starting their breastfeeding journey.

review_content: Tengo 6 meses usando este extractor y honestamente, ha sido la peor compra durante mi lactancia. Las bridas se rompen aproximadamente cada mes y las gomas comienzan a separarse, incluso siguiendo cuidadosamente todas las instrucciones de uso, limpieza y esterilización. Además, el diseño no es práctico: si te inclinas mientras te estás extrayendo, la leche se derrama fácilmente, además si se llenan los recipientes también comienza a derramarse, no para la extracción. El armado también es incómodo, ya que tiene demasiadas piezas y la unión entre el recipiente y la brida es difícil de poner y quitar. En cuanto al funcionamiento, la situación empeoró recientemente: hace 3 días comenzó a fallar uno de los motores (dejó de succionar y solo hacía un sonido tipo “clic”) y hoy el segundo motor presenta exactamente el mismo problema. Quiero aclarar que soy muy cuidadosa con mis equipos, por lo que considero que se trata de un problema de calidad del producto más que de uso. Como punto positivo, el servicio al cliente de la marca ha respondido cada vez que reporté fallas y actualmente están gestionando un reembolso completo. Sin embargo, debido a la cantidad de problemas en un periodo tan corto, no es un producto que recomendaría.
review_content_ch:
不到6个月频繁故障 – 质量差
我已使用这款吸奶器6个月，老实说这是哺乳期最糟糕的购买。法兰垫每月都会断裂，密封圈也开始脱落——即便严格遵循使用、清洁和消毒说明。设计也不实用：吸奶时稍前倾就会漏奶，储奶瓶装满后还会继续抽吸导致溢出。组装也很麻烦，零件过多且储奶瓶与法兰垫的连接部位难以拆装。性能方面近期恶化：3天前一个电机开始故障（停止抽吸仅发出咔嗒声），今天第二个电机出现完全相同的问题。需要说明我对设备非常爱惜，因此认为这是产品质量而非使用问题。唯一优点是品牌客服响应及时，目前正在处理全额退款。但由于短期内问题频发，我不会推荐该产品。
review_summary: 用户使用6个月后反馈吸奶器质量差：每月需更换绑带，橡胶易分离，设计不实用易漏奶，组装复杂。近期两个马达相继故障停止工作。虽客服处理退款积极，但因故障频发不推荐该产品。

review_content: Was very hopeful that this could replace a pump or two a day from my spectra and I could also use it in the car on my drive to work. I was very disappointed. I got so little output with this pump it’s crazy - I would get maybe 40-60ml on each side with this, then put on my spectra and get another 100ml off of each side in the same session. Just SO much milk left behind. I tried troubleshooting with positioning, flange size, pump settings all with no luck. One of the reasons I went with this pump initially was because I liked the idea of the clear tunnels so you could confirm correct nipple placement - don’t waste your time. You still can’t really see anything except when your nipple is suctioned out toward the end of the tunnel, not helpful. The massage feature is just vibration, fine but not groundbreaking. The warmth was nice, I liked that part.
review_content_ch:
一般般。省省钱吧。
本来满怀希望，觉得这款吸奶器能替代我每天用 Spectra 吸奶器的一两次吸奶，而且我还能在开车上班的路上使用它。结果非常失望。这款吸奶器的出奶量少得离谱——每次每侧大概只能吸出 40-60 毫升，然后换上我的 Spectra 吸奶器，在同一次吸奶过程中每侧又能再吸出 100 毫升。剩下的奶量真的太多了。我尝试了调整姿势、更换法兰尺寸、调节吸奶器设置等各种方法来排查问题，但都没用。起初选择这款吸奶器的原因之一是我喜欢它的透明通道设计，想着可以确认乳头位置是否正确——别浪费时间了。除了看到乳头被吸力吸向通道末端之外，你其实什么也看不清，没什么帮助。按摩功能只是振动而已，还行，但没什么惊艳之处。加热功能不错，我喜欢这部分。
review_summary: 用户表示失望，建议省钱，认为不值得购买。原本希望该吸奶器能替代每天1-2次Spectra吸奶，并可在开车通勤时使用；但使用时每侧仅吸出约40-60ml，随后用Spectra同一轮每侧还能再吸出100ml，残留很多奶。尝试调整姿势、喇叭罩尺寸和吸奶设置均无效。透明喇叭罩本想确认乳头位置，但实际只能看到乳头被吸到管末端，不实用；按摩功能只是振动，无突破；加温功能不错，用户喜欢。

review_content: I initially was super excited to receive this item, as I'm an exclusive pumper and have other pumps such as the Eufy, Spectra, and Elvie. I was interested due to the slim size. I'm also a nurse on a busy floor, so pumping with a more discreet pump was a huge selling point. However, since using this product, I've been so disappointed. The flanges are uncomfortable. I've tried using the item many times with the same flange insert size I use on my other pumps and pumping is always painful. I've tried troubleshooting this myself with no success.. Additionally, suction is poor, I find myself taking apart the entire unit sometimes, trying to find where the air leak is located. Usually I don't find it and by just luck it starts working again. I also don't get as much output as I do with my other pumps. I notice a significant difference, up to 5 ounces / day difference if I am just using the Air 1. Then, tonight, I noticed that the motors aren't charging properly only 2 and a half weeks after purchasing . The right motor won't charge in the case, even with the case fully charged. The left motor charges without issue. However, if I use the cord to charge the right motor, it charges just fine. This makes it super inconvenient though to charge one at a time, and not be able to use the case as it is intended. I wish I could receive a refund. Highly disappointed for the amount of money spent on these pumps. It has so much potential with some of the features but falls short on others. Not worth the money. Not worth the hype. I'll be sticking with my Eufy S1. Might be a bit bulkier, but at least its been reliable and comfortable to use.
review_content_ch:
极度失望
最初我对收到这款产品超级兴奋，因为我是一名全泵妈妈，已经拥有如Eufy、Spectra和Elvie等其他吸奶器。吸引我的是它纤薄的尺寸。作为一名忙碌病房的护士，使用更隐蔽的吸奶器是个巨大卖点。然而使用后我非常失望。法兰很不舒适。我多次尝试用与其他吸奶器相同尺寸的法兰，但每次泵奶都很疼痛。自己排查问题也无果...此外吸力很差，有时不得不拆开整个设备寻找漏气点，通常找不到，只能靠运气恢复工作。产量也明显不如其他吸奶器，仅使用Air 1时日均差异高达5盎司。更糟的是，购买才两周半就发现电机充电异常：右侧电机无法在充电仓充电（即便仓体满电），左侧正常。虽然用线充右侧没问题，但逐个充电极其不便，完全违背充电仓的设计初衷。希望能退款。花这么多钱买这些吸奶器实在太失望了。某些功能很有潜力，但其他方面严重不足。不值这个价，更不值那些炒作。我会继续用可靠的Eufy S1，虽然笨重些，但至少用着舒适可靠。
review_summary: 用户对产品非常失望，指出吸乳器法兰不舒适导致疼痛，吸力差且经常漏气，每日产奶量比其他品牌少约5盎司。购买仅两周后右电机无法在充电盒中充电，只能单独用线充，使用不便。认为产品不值这个价格，不如Eufy S1可靠舒适。

review_content: I’m unfortunately on the larger size chest and when I was looking for pumps most didn’t fit or were extremely uncomfortable and kept giving me clogged ducts and just weren’t draining me completely even with the correct flange size . These however are perfect for larger size *ahem* honkers .. anyways here are some things that I appreciate about these pumps . 1.) the suction is super powerful so it empties you out pretty good , because of that my milk supply started going up quite a bit . 2.) because of it’s design it’s super easy to walk around and get things done and even bend over without worrying of it spilling or leaking (especially helpful when you have a toddler ) 3.) it’s surprising quite, keep in mind it is a pump so it’s going to make noise but it’s not that loud and my baby falls asleep to the sound of it. 4.) the different settings are super convenient and there’s even a setting for if you have inverted nipples so it’s not as painful while pumping, I haven’t tried all of them yet but it’s a nice variety if you do need it . Only con is they don’t have an automatic timer so you’ll have to set one each time you pump. Other than that I really have no complaints. These pumps are excellent and for the price definitely worth it .
review_content_ch:
超棒的吸奶器！
不幸的是，我的胸部尺寸偏大，我在找吸奶器的时候，大多数都不合适，或者极其不舒服，还老是堵奶，就算用对了法兰尺寸也不能完全排空。但这些吸奶器对尺寸偏大的“大胸”来说简直完美……总之，我说说我喜欢这些吸奶器的几点：1.) 吸力超强，所以能排空得相当好，因为这样，我的奶量开始明显增加了。2.) 设计上，它非常方便走动做事，甚至弯腰都不用担心洒出来或漏出来（尤其是有个蹒跚学步的孩子时特别有用）。3.) 声音出奇地安静，请记住它是个吸奶器，所以会有声音，但声音不大，我家宝宝听着这个声音就睡着了。4.) 不同的档位非常方便，甚至还有一个针对内陷乳头设置的档位，这样吸奶时就没那么疼，我还没试过所有档位，但如果你需要的话，选择还挺丰富的。唯一的缺点是它没有自动计时器，所以每次吸奶都得自己设一个。除此之外，我真的没什么可抱怨的。这些吸奶器非常棒，而且就这个价格来说绝对物有所值。
review_summary: 吸奶器吸力强能排空乳汁增加奶量，设计方便活动且防漏，噪音小不打扰宝宝，多种模式适合不同需求包括乳头内陷情况。唯一不足是没有自动定时功能。

review_content: I got this for my girlfriend after we just had a baby, and honestly it’s been a really good upgrade from the other pumps she was using. She already had two different ones from another brand, but she said these are noticeably better. The biggest thing is she’s actually able to produce more milk with these, which was the main reason we were looking for something new in the first place. She also likes how convenient they are since they’re wearable, makes things a lot easier to manage during the day instead of being stuck in one spot. Only small thing we didn’t realize at first is that the production tracking in the app has to be entered manually. Not really a flaw with the pump itself, just something we overlooked when buying. Overall though, definitely worth it and she’s been really happy with them so far.

review_content: This pump is not for people with long nipples or elastic nipples; which I don’t realize I had before I used this pump. I pumped with a spectra s1 for my last baby with no issue or pain but I wanted something more hands free and portable. The membrane for suction is at the end of the flange; making the flange much shorter. My nipple would start getting sucked into this compartment and looked like a mushroom top when it came out. Only uses 4 times and couldn’t figure out how to not have this happen. It was so painful! Such a big disappointment because it has a good design for use clean and pouring milk into bags and bottles
review_content_ch:
法兰长度短，直接连接到隔膜
这款吸奶器不适合乳头较长或弹性乳头的人；在使用这款吸奶器之前，我并没有意识到我有这种情况。我上一个宝宝用的是 Spectra S1，没有任何问题或疼痛，但我想要一款更解放双手且便携的产品。产生吸力的隔膜位于法兰的末端，使得法兰变得非常短。我的乳头会被吸入这个腔室，取出来时看起来像蘑菇头一样。只用了4次，我也没找到避免这种情况的方法。太疼了！真是令人非常失望，因为它在清洁以及将母乳倒入储奶袋和奶瓶方面的设计很好
review_summary: 用户想要免手扶便携款而购买，但该吸奶器法兰较短、吸力膜位于法兰末端，不适合乳头较长或弹性乳头者；使用4次乳头被吸入腔体、取出呈蘑菇状且很痛，无法避免。此前用Spectra S1无不适。优点是设计便于清洁及将奶倒入储奶袋或奶瓶，但整体令人失望。

review_content: This pump can be descreste for work or public spaces. I like the different speeds or pump features however the motor is very weak. I understand it is not hospital grade and it is a wearable pump therefore the motor is not as strong or big but this pump does not come close to emptying me out like my spectra. review_content: This is a good pump of you are looking for a cheaper option that still provides high output. For around the first 6 months it pumped similar amounts as my Medela swing pump, although it took a little longer. However after that I had problems with in consistent sunction and now at almost 8 months I have had to order new diaphragms as somehow they have split and now let milk in which can get into the motor!!! The replacements are expensive and I honestly didn't think I'd need them so soon! Positives: - Cheaper that most pumps - Good output for 6 months Negatives: - Need to buy replacement parts after 6 months - Difficult to position as you can't see if the nipple is in the right place - Takes a long time to pump high volume and can get uncomfortable

review_content: I was doing triple feeding and was getting really tiered of being tied to my breast pump after already nursing for sometime 30-60 minutes. I need to eat and use the bathroom! My friend had a willow she let me try out and it was horrible. Super heavy, hard to use, painful, and it was so bulky under my shirt I couldn’t hold my baby or do anything that involved moving my arms. I gave this pump a try and I was so excited. Lower profile, great suction, easy to wash and put together, the cups stand up on their own so less chance of spilled milk, shows how much time has gone by ( I can’t tell you how many times I forgot to set a timer with my symphony), and pretty quiet (see video). This pump is awesome! The only down side is replacement parts are out of stock right now.
review_content_ch:
非常适合外出使用
我之前进行三重喂养，在已经亲喂30-60分钟后，真的厌倦了被吸奶器束缚住。我需要吃饭和上厕所！朋友让我试用了她的Willow，但体验很糟糕。它非常重，难以使用，让人疼痛，而且穿在衬衫下太 bulky，导致我无法抱宝宝或做任何涉及手臂活动的动作。我试了这款吸奶器，感到非常兴奋。它更薄，吸力很棒，易于清洗和组装，集乳杯可以独立站立，减少了牛奶洒出的风险，还能显示已过去的时间（我都不知道用Symphony时有多少次忘记设定时器），而且相当安静（见视频）。这款吸奶器太棒了！唯一的缺点是替换零件目前缺货。

review_content_ch:

首先，我确实想说我喜欢这款吸奶器，它非常方便，尤其是无线设计。坐着不动就很累人了，我生第一个孩子时用过那种（有线）的，体验很不好，甚至导致我在宝宝3个月大时就停止了母乳喂养，而我本希望能喂更久。但我还是给这款打4星，因为我希望他们能改进出奶口的设计。当我想把吸奶器放下、去准备待产包时，它会漏奶；或者即使我还戴着它，只是在清洁时稍微弯腰，奶水就会流出来，弄脏我的衬衫和内衣，这真的让我非常恼火。可以说这是我对这款吸奶器唯一的不满，我觉得这一点特别烦人。我上传了一张照片，以便大家了解开口的位置以及奶水是多么容易洒出来。
review_summary: 用户喜欢这款吸奶器，认为使用方便；但不满出奶口位置，放下吸奶器或弯腰时容易漏奶、洒到衣服和内衣上，这是唯一槽点，因此评4星。

review_content: I like that this pump doesn’t have a bunch of parts, and it’s really easy to assemble and use. But I will say the suction is very strong and is really painful the first few days when your milk is just coming in and you’re sore. Even with the proper flange size it will still sort of “pinch” here and there if it’s not on perfect, but overall it’s a pretty decent pump for the price. I only give it 4 stars for the little “pinch” it gives me here and there. I’m changing my review now to only 2 stars. After using it for about a week my supply has dropped so bad. I went from making around 9oz total to getting 4 oz 5 if I’m very lucky. I pumped for 30 minutes and got 3 and half oz combined, and there was nothing else coming out. Then I used my Motif Luna because I was curious if it was the pump or me and I was able to get 2oz in 10 minutes. Not sure if it’s just because the pump doesn’t really stimulate a let down or maybe it just wasn’t working for me but personally I would not recommend it. I’m going to be returning it and getting a SpeCtra.
review_content_ch:
不太理想
我喜欢这款吸奶器没有太多零件，组装和使用都非常简单。但我要说，它的吸力非常强，在最初几天乳汁刚分泌、乳房胀痛时，用起来真的很痛。即使使用了合适尺寸的法兰，如果佩戴不够完美，它仍然会时不时地“夹”到肉。不过总体而言，考虑到价格，这还是一款相当不错的吸奶器。因为这种时不时的“夹”感，我只给了4星。我现在把评价改为2星。使用了大约一周后，我的奶量大幅下降。我从之前总共能产约9盎司，降到只能产出4盎司，运气好的话也就5盎司。我吸了30分钟，总共只吸出3.5盎司，之后就再也吸不出来了。然后我用了我的Motif Luna，因为我好奇是吸奶器的问题还是我自己的问题，结果我在10分钟内就吸出了2盎司。不确定是不是因为这款吸奶器无法有效刺激喷乳反射，或者只是不适合我，但就我个人而言，我不推荐它。我打算退货，然后去买一台SpeCtra。
review_summary: 吸奶器零件少、易组装使用，但吸力过强，开奶头几天疼痛；即使法兰尺寸合适，位置不完美时也会偶尔夹痛。原评4星，因夹痛改为2星。使用约一周后奶量从约9oz降至4oz（好运5oz），泵30分钟仅3.5oz，换用Motif Luna 10分钟得2oz。用户不确定是否因未刺激奶阵或不适合，不推荐，将退货并购买SpeCtra。

review_content: Seeing others reviews about using this pump when others weren't working ultimately led me to purchase this. It is very quiet, comfortable, easy to clean, and has all these settings. However, no matter how many times I tried, I am not getting a single drop in output even though I have the correct flange size and settings. I use the S9 which has been the most effective for me -but still doesn't "empty" me.I can nurse. Pump -1 oz each breast in the morning- And still have milk to nurse immediately after pumping ( this is only with the S9). Whenever I use any pump after my morning pump, I never get any output. So I mainly just nurse bc manually stimulating my breast, and seeing my child have milk leak from their mouth during feeds, it's obvious I have milk but no pump has been great for me . So frustrating spending money on these items and they aren't refundable.
review_content_ch:
完全吸不出奶
看到其他人的评论说，在其他吸奶器不好用时这款还能用，这最终促使我购买了它。它非常安静、舒适、易于清洁，并且具备各种设置。然而，无论我尝试多少次，即使法兰尺寸和设置都正确，我也吸不出一滴奶。我使用 S9 时效果最好——但仍然无法“排空”乳房。我可以亲喂。早上用吸奶器每侧乳房只能吸出 1 盎司——而且吸完后立刻亲喂仍有奶水（这仅针对 S9）。每当在晨间吸奶后使用任何吸奶器，我都吸不出任何奶量。所以我主要只是亲喂，因为通过手动刺激乳房，以及看到孩子在喂奶时嘴角漏奶，很明显我有奶，但没有哪款吸奶器对我真正有效。花钱买了这些不可退货的物品却没用，真让人沮丧。
review_summary: 用户因看到该吸奶器在别的吸奶器无效时仍可用的评价而购买。它安静、舒适、易清洁、模式多，但法兰尺寸和设置正确仍吸不出奶、无法排空；S9最有效但早晨每侧仅吸1盎司，之后仍能亲喂，早晨泵后使用任何吸奶器都无输出。用户主要亲喂，因有奶却无吸奶器好用、花钱且不可退货而沮丧。

review_content: Love love looove these breast pumps. I have so much to do in my day & these make my life so much easier. The portable aspect of them is just heaven sent. I use every few hours no matter what I’m doing. I’ve even worn them while out running errands. Fits perfect fine in my bra. The battery life is awesome & they use same charger as my iPhone (usb c). They’re really easy to operate & I like the different settings. One for let down & one for like actual pumping. It has different suction intensity levels too. Super easy to take apart & put back together after cleaning. It hasn’t leaked on me either which I appreciate. This makes my life so much easier. Best purchase I’ve made in a while.
review_content_ch:
真是救星！！强烈推荐
超级喜欢这款吸奶器。我每天要处理的事情太多了，它让我的生活轻松了许多。便携设计简直是天赐之物。无论我在做什么，每隔几个小时就会使用一次。我甚至穿着它出门办过事。完美贴合地放在我的文胸里。电池续航很棒，而且和我的 iPhone 使用相同的充电器（USB-C）。操作非常简单，我喜欢不同的模式设置：一个用于刺激泌乳反射，一个用于实际吸乳。它还有不同的吸力强度档位。拆卸和清洁后重新组装都非常简单。也没有发生过漏液，这点我很感激。它真的让我的生活轻松了许多。这是我近期最满意的一次购物。
review_summary: 用户强烈推荐该吸奶器：便携、可穿在文胸内外出使用，续航好且用USB-C充电，操作简单，有催乳和吸奶模式及多档吸力，拆洗方便且未漏奶，让日常更轻松，称其为近期最佳购买。

review_content: The transparent feature fails to be helpful when condensation clouds your view after milk starts to flow. I personally can’t tell if alignment is proper until then and still find myself shifting the pump while struggling to see nipple through shield. The noise level is louder than expected, a non discreet volume for being marketed as a discreet pump. I have found the pump auto pauses at an angle, such as leaning while changing a diaper and standing up from the toilet. The app has been difficult to connect on multiple occasions and there’s no way of knowing the settings without a display on the pump if manually adjusting. There is a significant discrepancy in pumped volume when finalizing a session and if you’re not near a flat surface (say in a car) it doesn’t accurately measure upon completion. I have less output with this than the M5, which is now appreciate more for its simplicity in assembly. The air 1 is obnoxious to assemble and requires super cautious handling to avoid getting the charging port wet. I spent a long time researching options and am quite disappointed by this pump. After using only a handful of times I’m not sure I want to rely on it for sessions at work.
review_content_ch:
令人沮丧
当乳汁开始流动后，冷凝水雾会遮挡视线，透明设计完全失去作用。在此之前我根本无法判断是否对准，仍要不断调整吸奶器位置，同时费力地透过护罩观察乳头位置。噪音比预期大得多，根本达不到宣传所说的静音效果。我发现吸奶器会在倾斜角度自动暂停，比如换尿布时前倾或从马桶上站起来时。多次出现应用连接困难的情况，而且手动调节时若吸奶器没有显示屏，根本无法知道当前设置。结束吸乳时显示的奶量与实际存在显著差异，若不在平坦表面（比如在车里）完成，测量结果就不准确。与M5相比，这款的产量更低，现在反而更欣赏M5组装简单的优点了。Air 1组装过程令人抓狂，必须极度小心避免充电口沾水。我花了很长时间研究各种选项，对这款吸奶器相当失望。仅使用几次后，我就不确定能否信任它在工作场合的表现了。

review_content: 🏎️ Quick Rec: The Momcozy Wellness 1 Wearable Breast Pump is worth buying for daily, on-the-go pumping if you want the convenience of built-in warming and massage, as its superior build quality outweighs its premium price tag. 📝 Additional Notes: While competitor brands beat Momcozy to market with heated wearable pumps (regardless of what is said in their marketing), the Momcozy Wellness 1 Wearable Breast Pump sets a high standard for overall execution and refinement. Combining warming, vibration, and pumping into a single hands-free unit eliminates the need to prep separate heating pads before a session, a huge convenience boost for mothers pumping on the move or at work. The warmth takes a few moments to ramp up compared to dedicated warmers, but having all-in-one functionality right inside the bra makes up for the slight delay. The overall fit, material comfort, and structural quality match the high standards Momcozy is known for, surpassing the cheaper-feeling materials found on earlier rival models. It sits at a higher price point, but for anyone pumping daily who needs reliable performance and maximum mobility, the refined execution makes it worth the investment. ✅ Pros - Integrated heating and vibration provide all-in-one comfort and convenience during hands-free pumping - High-grade build quality and comfortable flange fit - Wearable, cord-free design - Eliminates the extra step of using separate heating pads prior to a pumping session ❌ Cons - Premium price tag makes it pricey compared to standard wearable pumps - Integrated heating element takes a moment to warm up rather than heating instantly - Heavy reliance on marketing claims like "industry-first" despite similar features existing on the market

为那些一直忙碌的人设计的可靠吸奶器

📝 附加说明：尽管竞争品牌抢先推出了加热可穿戴吸奶器（无论其营销宣传如何），Momcozy Wellness 1 可穿戴吸奶器在整体执行和精炼方面树立了高标准。将加热、振动和吸奶功能集成到一个免手持设备中，无需在吸奶前准备单独的加热垫，为移动中或工作时吸奶的妈妈带来了极大的便利。与专用加热器相比，加热需要几秒钟才能升温，但将一体式功能直接放入文胸内弥补了轻微的延迟。整体贴合度、材料舒适度和结构质量符合 Momcozy 闻名的高标准，超越了早期竞品型号上感觉更廉价的材料。它的价格更高，但对于任何每天需要可靠性能和最大移动性的吸奶人士来说，其精炼的执行使其值得投资。

- 集成的加热和振动在免手持吸奶过程中提供一体式的舒适和便利
- 高品质的制造质量和舒适的喇叭罩贴合度

- 高昂的价格标签使其与标准可穿戴吸奶器相比价格昂贵

review_content: The Momcozy M9 is a great wearable pump, but apparently one tiny plastic piece decided it wanted to be the main character of this entire operation. The 24mm flange is an important replacement part, and having a fresh one helps keep everything working as intended. The silicone is comfortable, the design is easy enough to clean, and I appreciate being able to replace individual parts instead of buying an entirely new setup. Because apparently breastfeeding wasn’t already expensive enough. My biggest concern is the small plastic connection that attaches to the collection cup. That area seems like a weak point because it has to withstand repeated snapping and unsnapping during normal use. Over time, it can break, even when you’re not treating your breast pump like construction equipment. That’s something Momcozy really should improve, especially considering how often these parts need to be handled and cleaned. I understand that pump parts need periodic replacement, and after three or four months, replacing worn components isn’t unreasonable. But there’s a difference between replacing something because it’s worn out and replacing it because a tiny piece of plastic has decided to resign without notice. Overall, the M9 is a convenient pumping system, and replacement flanges are necessary to keep it going. I just wish Momcozy would reinforce that connection so the most dramatic part of my pumping routine could go back to being my milk supply instead of the equipment.
review_content_ch:
吸奶器很棒，但这块小塑料件总是“掉链子”
Momcozy M9 是一款很棒的穿戴式吸奶器，但显然有一块小塑料件非要当整个使用过程中的“主角”。24毫米法兰是重要的替换件，换上一个新的有助于让一切保持正常运转。硅胶材质很舒服，设计也很容易清洁，我很感激能够单独更换零件，而不是买一整套全新的设备。毕竟母乳喂养显然还不够烧钱。我最担心的是连接集奶杯的那个小塑料连接件。那个区域似乎是个薄弱点，因为在正常使用中它必须承受反复的扣合与拆卸。时间长了它可能会坏，即使你没有把吸奶器当成工地设备那样粗暴使用。这是Momcozy真的应该改进的地方，尤其是考虑到这些零件需要多么频繁地被操作和清洁。我理解吸奶器配件需要定期更换，三四个月后更换磨损的部件并非不合理。但因为磨损而更换，和因为一小块塑料决定“不告而辞”而更换，这两者是有区别的。总的来说，M9是一个方便的吸奶系统，替换法兰是让它继续运转所必需的。我只希望Momcozy能加固那个连接处，这样我吸奶日常中最“抓马”的部分就能回归到奶量本身，而不是设备问题上。
review_summary: Momcozy M9 可穿戴吸奶器整体方便，24mm 法兰作为替换件重要；硅胶舒适、设计易清洁，可单独换零件而非买整套。最大问题是连接集乳杯的小塑料件，需反复拆装，正常使用也会随时间断裂，即便小心使用亦然。作者认为三到四个月更换磨损件可接受，但该塑料件无故断裂应改进；希望加固连接处。

review_content: I get super picky when it comes to pumping bras, especially when it comes to material and this is one of the softest most tolerable fabrics where I don’t recoil from nip pain. I still wear nursing pads with this and it actually isn’t too bad. I can even use my wearable M6 pumps in these! The flanges I use are Medela and they fit perfectly fine, there’s lots of ample space. It comes with a bra mesh bag (so considerate!) and also an extendable strap for moms whose ribcages have beautifully extended (temporarily or not) from pregnancy or postpartum. This is absolutely worth the value and I love the fit and feel of it. It has a beautiful stretch but also a decent snugness. I think the only issue for me is that the snugness is a little more relaxed and I still need to hug the flanges against my breast if I’m moving too much. But in a more stationary position it stays well just not super snug, which is good because you don’t want it to squeeze engorged breasts! Overall definitely recommend if you’re looking for a comfortable and casual pumping bra that can be worn on the daily, at night, and while pumping that won’t hurt your nips!

spu_name: Paruu P21 穿戴一体式电动吸奶器
review_content: I’ve used Paruu pumps before, so I was curious to try this updated P21 model with the baby‑mouth flange design and multiple modes. The suction pattern feels smooth and controlled: it starts gently, then builds in a steady rhythm instead of jumping straight to a strong pull. That pacing makes it easier to settle into a session and keeps the pump feeling comfortable over time. The capacity and shape of the stand‑up milk bowl are genuinely practical. The cup is designed to hold up to about 6 oz, and the measurement markings are easy to read while pumping. Being able to set the pump upright on a table without it tipping over makes it much easier to pause and then pour. You do need to remove the motor before pouring, but once you do, the wide opening and stable base make transferring milk feel simple and controlled rather than awkward. Cleaning is one of the biggest advantages of this pump. The P21 breaks down into just a few main parts. That means everything rinses clean quickly, and reassembly is straightforward. For frequent use, not having to scrub around a lot of small components is a real time saver. Battery performance has been consistent. The upgraded battery and Type‑C charging let me use the pump for multiple sessions on a single charge; in my experience, it comfortably supports two to three 30‑minute sessions before the battery level drops noticeably. I’ve been able to rely on it during days when I’m away from outlets, and it works well with standard charging cubes I already own. The extra details and accessories add to the overall experience. The different flange inserts help with getting a better fit, the protective covers keep the breast‑contact area cleaner between uses, and the compact storage bag keeps all the parts together and protected in one place. It makes the pump feel like a complete, ready‑to‑go kit rather than a loose collection of pieces. After using the P21 regularly, it comes across as a well‑designed wearable pump: comfortable suction pattern, practical capacity, easy cleaning, dependable battery, and thoughtful accessories that make everyday use smoother.
review_content_ch:
贴心的配件与稳定的性能
我曾使用过Paruu吸奶器，因此对这款升级版P21型号充满好奇，它采用婴儿嘴型法兰设计和多种模式。吸力模式感觉流畅且可控：开始时轻柔，随后以稳定节奏增强，而非直接跳到强力抽取。这种节奏让使用过程更易适应，并保持长时间舒适。立式奶瓶的容量和形状非常实用，杯子设计可容纳约6盎司，且测量刻度在吸乳时清晰易读。吸奶器能稳固直立放置于桌面不倒，便于暂停后倾倒。倾倒前需取下马达，但宽口设计和稳固底座使倒奶过程简单可控，毫无笨拙感。清洁是这款吸奶器的最大优势之一。P21仅由几个主要部件组成，所有部件都能快速冲洗干净，组装也很直观。频繁使用时，无需费力清洁众多小部件，节省大量时间。电池性能稳定，升级电池和Type-C充电支持单次充电多次使用——根据我的经验，可轻松支持2-3次30分钟使用后电量才明显下降。远离电源时也能可靠使用，且与我已有的标准充电器兼容。额外细节和配件提升了整体体验：不同法兰衬垫帮助更好贴合，防护罩保持接触部位清洁，紧凑收纳袋将所有部件集中保护。这使吸奶器成为一套完整即用的装备，而非零散部件集合。长期使用P21后，它展现出精心设计的穿戴式吸奶器特质：舒适的吸力模式、实用容量、易清洁性、可靠电池，以及让日常使用更顺畅的贴心配件。
review_summary: 吸力模式舒适，从轻柔逐渐增强；直立奶瓶容量约6盎司，刻度清晰，底座稳定不易倾倒，但需先取下电机才能倒奶。清洁方便，部件少，冲洗快且易于组装。电池续航稳定，支持2-3次30分钟使用，Type-C充电便捷。配件包括不同尺寸喇叭罩、保护盖和收纳袋，整体设计贴心实用。

review_content: After having tried three different breast pumps I’d like to share my thoughts on this one in particular. It gets 5 stars for power and portability, BUT it’s many parts to wash every time, with many small books and crannies. I have used a spectra s2 pump (more traditional with hose and pump into bottle base), as well as the Medela hands free in bra pump. The other two you have to worry about hoses being caught on things as well as carrying the motor around. With the paruu, you just place it in your bra and turn it on. I notice because they are bulky I am slightly limited in my movement, and you CANNOT bend over or you will spill milk out of the top. The Medela also has this problem of no bending over. The paruu, while it has close to 2x the parts needed to wash, are better quality and more comfortable against the skin, and the adjustment rings included make the sensation less uncomfortable during pumping. The paruu parts are silicone and a thicker plastic, I don’t have to worry about putting them in the bottle washer. I use these while I work, and even if I look a little funny, I appreciate the freedom these allow me.
review_content_ch:
质量不错，活动自由，但零件太多。
在尝试了三款不同的吸奶器后，我想特别分享一下对这款的看法。它的吸力和便携性绝对值得5星好评，但是每次清洗的零件太多，而且有很多小缝隙和死角。我用过Spectra S2吸奶器（比较传统的那种，带软管，马达连在奶瓶底座上），还有美德乐的免提穿戴式吸奶器。用另外两款时，你得担心软管被东西挂住，还得随身带着马达。用Paruu的话，直接把它放进内衣里打开开关就行。我发现因为它们体积较大，我的活动稍微受限，而且绝对不能弯腰，否则奶会从顶部洒出来。美德乐那款也有不能弯腰的问题。Paruu虽然需要清洗的零件数量差不多是两倍，但质量更好，贴肤更舒适，而且附赠的调节环让吸奶时的感觉没那么难受。Paruu的零件是硅胶和较厚的塑料制成的，我不用担心把它们放进奶瓶清洗机里。我工作时就用它，就算看起来有点滑稽，我也很感激它带给我的自由。
review_summary: 吸力强、便携，放入文胸开机即用，无需导管和手持电机，工作时使用活动自由。硅胶与加厚塑料部件质量好、亲肤舒适，附带的调节环可减轻吸奶不适，且能直接放进奶瓶清洗机。缺点是零件多、小缝隙多，每次清洗麻烦；机身笨重略限制活动，弯腰会使奶从顶部溢出。

review_content: If you use the Momcozy M6, you know how crucial it is to replace the duckbill valves regularly. My suction was starting to feel a bit weak, so I picked up this 4-pack, and it completely restored my pump's performance back to day one. The silicone quality feels identical to the original parts that came with the pump—soft, durable, and BPA-free. They snap into place easily, form a tight seal without leaking, and stand up well to frequent steam sterilizing without warping or losing their shape. Having four in a pack is great so you always have spares on hand when one inevitably disappears during washing. Essential maintenance item if you pump daily!
review_content_ch:
完美的替换阀——立即恢复吸力！
如果你使用Momcozy M6，就会知道定期更换鸭嘴阀有多重要。之前我的吸力开始感觉有点弱，于是买了这套4个装的，它完全把吸奶器的性能恢复如初。硅胶材质感觉和吸奶器原装的部件一模一样——柔软、耐用、不含BPA。它们很容易卡入到位，形成紧密密封不泄漏，而且经得起频繁蒸汽消毒，不会变形或失去形状。一包有四个非常好，这样某个在清洗时不小心失踪时，你手头总有备用件。如果你每天泵奶，这是必备的维护配件。
review_summary: 替换用鸭嘴阀完全恢复了吸力，硅胶材质与原装一致，柔软耐用、不含BPA，安装简便且密封无泄漏，可反复蒸汽消毒不变形。四只装方便备用，是每日泵奶的重要维护件。

review_content: This worked great, until it broke 5 days into use. And let me tell you, being postpartum with all the hormones coming along with that and having extremely chafed, raw nipples from challenging latches and a strong suckle, having such an important device fail was such a disappointment in the middle of the night. The motor first went out in one of the devices and then the other gave out not 24 hours later. Now I am panicking trying to replace it because I don’t know that I can realistically feed from my chest directly all the feeds needed until replacement parts arrive. And who knows if I can even trust those.
review_content_ch:
大失所望（双关语，故意这么说的）。5天电机就坏了。
本来用得挺好的，结果用了5天就坏了。我跟你说，产后本来就激素翻涌，再加上衔乳困难、吸吮又猛，乳头被磨得又红又破，这么重要的设备偏偏大半夜坏了，真是太让人失望了。先是其中一台的电机停了，不到24小时，另一台也彻底不行了。现在我正手忙脚乱地想换一台，因为我不知道在替换配件到货之前，我是不是真能靠直接亲喂喂完所有需要的奶。而且谁知道这些配件我还能不能信得过。
review_summary: 产品最初好用，但使用5天后电机故障，两个设备在24小时内相继失效，导致产后乳头疼痛的母亲无法正常吸奶，非常失望，对产品质量产生信任危机。
